(نصير): one of the intensive forms, on the pattern فعيل, from the transitive verb نصر ينصر.

safi-cedvel:108-108.t:
* I'rab:
(أم): a particle of beginning; it is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) أم, in the sense of بل and the hamza, the interrogative being in the sense of disapproval. (تريدون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (أن): a maṣdar particle causing the accusative. (تسألوا): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (رسول): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from (أن) and the verb is in the position of accusative as direct object, its governor being تريدون.
(الكاف): a preposition «[Note: Or a noun meaning مثل ("like"), in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, since it is its description.]». (ما): a maṣdar particle. (سئل): past verb, passive. (موسى): nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما سئل) is in the position of genitive by the kāf, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e., «that you ask your Messenger with a questioning like the questioning of Moses' people of their prophet Moses».
(من): a preposition. (قبل): a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (سئل). (الواو): resumptive. (من): a conditional noun causing the jussive, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (يتبدّل): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), given a kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (الكفر): direct object, accusative. (بالإيمان): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يتبدّل). (الفاء): connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (قد): a particle of realization. (ضلّ): past verb; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (سواء): direct object, accusative. (السبيل): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); it is an annexation of the adjective to the noun it describes.
The clause «تريدون ...»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «تسألوا ...»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «سئل ...»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «من يتبدّل ...»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يتبدّل ...»: in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) «[Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».
The clause «ضلّ ...»: in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition.

* Morphology:
(تريدون): it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by conversion; its origin is ترودون, because it is from راد يرود. The vowel of the wāw was transferred to the rāʾ, then the wāw was converted into a yāʾ because the letter before it has a kasra while it is quiescent. Its pattern is تفعلون.
(السبيل): a noun treated as masculine and feminine; its pattern is فعيل. Its plurals are سبل with two ḍammas, or with ḍamma and sukūn, أسبل with ḍamma on the bāʾ, أسبله with kasra on the bāʾ, and سبول with ḍamma on the sīn.

safi-cedvel:34-34.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (إذ قلنا للملائكة) the i'rab of its counterpart has preceded «[Note: See verse (20) .]» «[Translator's note: so in the source; the counterpart «وإذ قال ربّك للملائكة» is at verse 30.]» (اسجدوا) an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). (لآدم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اسجدوا), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, because it is a diptote on account of being a proper name and foreign. (الفاء) resumptive; (سجدوا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (إلا) a particle of exception; (إبليس) excepted by (إلا), accusative, barred from nunation on account of being a proper name and foreign. (أبى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو), i.e. Iblīs; (الواو) conjunction; (استكبر) a past verb, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he"; (الواو) parenthetical or circumstantial; (كان) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he"; (من الكافرين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of kāna, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قلنا ... » is in the position of genitive by the annexation of (إذ) to it.
The clause «اسجدوا ... » is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «سجدوا» has no grammatical position, being resumptive, linked with what precedes it by a causal link.
The clause «أبى» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), with «قد» implied, i.e. he left off prostrating, refusing it «[Note: It may be parsed as resumptive, coming to emphasise the exception of Iblīs; or it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) coming as an answer to an implied question.]» .
The clause «استكبر» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause «أبى».
The clause «كان من الكافرين» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical, or is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl with «قد» implied.

* Morphology:
(قلنا) in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion on account of the indeclinability on the sukūn; this is regular in every hollow weak verb; its pattern is فلنا, with its ʿayn deleted.
(إبليس) it is a foreign word, its pattern إفعيل; it was also said that it is Arabic, derived from الإبلاس, which is despair, and that it is a diptote for being a proper name only, irregularly.
(أبى) , in it there is an iʿlāl by conversion: the alif was originally a yāʾ; the verb is originally أبي يأبى of the class of فتح, or أبي يأبى of the class of ضرب; the yāʾ came vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into alif.
(كان) , in it there is an iʿlāl by conversion: the alif is converted from a wāw; its imperfect is يكون, and its origin is كون with fatḥa on the wāw; the wāw came vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into alif.

safi-cedvel:35-35.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (قلنا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (نا) is the fāʿil (agent); (يا) a vocative particle; (آدم) the one addressed, a singular proper noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative; (اسكن) an imperative verb, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "you" (أنت); (أنت) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent fāʿil; (الواو) conjunction; (زوج) conjoined to the latent pronoun, following it in the nominative «[Note: This parsing is valid on the basis of the rule that says: what is tolerated in second elements is not tolerated in first ones.. because in principle it is not valid in prose, for example, to say: اسكن زوجك - with ḍamma on the jīm - taking it as fāʿil; rather one says: لتسكن زوجك. Accordingly, (زوجك) in the noble verse]» «[Translator's note: the footnote breaks off here in the source.]» and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi, in the position of genitive; (الجنّة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (كلا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and (الألف) an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in [the position of] nominative as fāʿil; (من) a preposition and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كلا) (رغدا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), standing in for the maṣdar because it is its adjective, i.e. «أكلا رغدا» (a plentiful eating) «[Translator's note: the source has «أكلا رغد».]» «[Note: It may be a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. eat, finding it pleasant and wholesome.]» (حيث) an adverb of place, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative, attached to (كلا) , (شئتما) a verb and its fāʿil.. (التاء) is the fāʿil, and (ما) a supporting particle (ḥarf ʿimād) indicating the dual; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) of prohibition, jussivizing; (تقرب) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and (الألف) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil «[Translator's note: so in the source, «(تقرب)», for «تقربا».]»; (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذه) a demonstrative, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (الشجرة) a badal (substitute) of «ذه» «[Note: Or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of it.]» following it in the genitive «[Translator's note: so in the source; since «ذه» is in the position of accusative, "accusative" is presumably meant.]»; (الفاء) the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya); (تكونا) a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative by (أن) concealed after the fāʾ of causation, and (الألف) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of «تكون»; (من الظالمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of «تكون», the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قلنا ... » is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «قلنا للملائكة» in the previous verse.
The clause «يا آدم اسكن» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اسكن ... » has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «كلا منها» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause that is the response to the vocative.
The clause «شئتما» is in the position of genitive by the annexation of (حيث) to it.
The clause «لا تقربا ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the vocative clause.

* Morphology:
(كلا) , in it the fāʾ of the word, which is the hamza, is deleted; its past is أكل..
its pattern is علا.
(رغدا) an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb رغد يرغد, of the class of فرح, its pattern فعل with two fatḥas.
(حيث) , an adverb of place, indeclinable on the ḍamma; it may also come for time; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn, then indeclinability on the ḍamma.
(شئتما) in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: its ʿayn was deleted because of the attachment of the tāʾ of the agent and the verb's being indeclinable on the sukūn; the deletion took place because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; its pattern is فلتما with kasra on the fāʾ.
(الظالمين) plural of الظالم, an active participle of the triliteral ظلم, its pattern فاعل, and the plural فاعلين.

safi-cedvel:36-36.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (أزلّ) a past verb, and (هما) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الشيطان) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (عن) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أزلّهما) , (الفاء) conjunction; (أخرجهما) like «أزلّهما»; (من) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive by (من) «[Note: Or it is an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, meaning "bliss" or "living", in the position of genitive, and the clause after it is a naʿt (adjective) of it.]» attached to (أخرجهما) . (كان) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and (الألف) a pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of kāna; (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of kāna; (الواو) conjunction; (قلنا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (اهبطوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بعض) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (لبعض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of «عدوّ» - a naʿt that has been placed before the word it qualifies - (عدوّ) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «بعضكم»; (الواو) conjunction or resumptive; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar; (مستقرّ) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (متاع) conjoined by the wāw to «مستقرّ», nominative like it; (الى حين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of (متاع) «[Note: Or attached to (متاع), because it has the status of a maṣdar.]» .
The clause «أزلّهما الشيطان» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «أخرجهما» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «كانا فيه» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما) .
The clause «قلنا ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «اهبطوا» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «بعضكم لبعض عدو» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. go down, being enemies to one another «[Note: Or it is resumptive, with no grammatical position.]» .
The clause «لكم في الأرض مستقرّ» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the ḥāl clause, or it is a fresh (resumptive) clause.

* Morphology:
(بعض) a noun for the part, or the group, or the individual of a thing; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; its plural is أبعاض.
(عدوّ) , a noun that resembles the maṣdar in its pattern; some counted it a maṣdar; its pattern is فعول; the wāw and the lām have been assimilated together because they are of the same letter.
(مستقرّ) , a noun of place from the six-letter verb استقرّ, so it is on the pattern of the passive participle. It may be a mīmī maṣdar meaning "settling" (al-istiqrār).
(متاع) , a noun for what is benefited from; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ; it may be a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the verbs تمتّع and استمتع بكذا..
(حين) , a noun meaning time and period; its pattern is فعل with kasra on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn; the plural is أحيان and the plural of the plural أحايين.

safi-cedvel:37-37.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (تلقّى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (آدم) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تلقّى), and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (كلمات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the kasra; (الفاء) conjunction; (تاب) a past verb, its fāʿil "he" (هو), i.e. Allah; (على) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تاب) .
(إنّ) a particle of emphasis and accusative, and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna; (هو) a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: Or a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is «التّواب», and the clause is the khabar of inna.]» (التوّاب) the khabar of inna, nominative; (الرحيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «تلقّى آدم ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause in the previous verse.
The clause «تاب عليه» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «تلقّى آدم».
The clause «إنّه هو التوّاب» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(تلقّى) , in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion: its origin is تلقّي with fatḥa on the yāʾ; the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into alif; its pattern is تفعّل.
(كلمات) , plural of كلمة, a noun for what a person utters, whether single or compound; its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa, then kasra, then fatḥa; or with kasra, then sukūn, then fatḥa; or with fatḥa, then sukūn, then fatḥa.
(تاب) , in it there is an iʿlāl by conversion: its origin is توب with fatḥa on the wāw, because the imperfect is يتوب; the wāw was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into alif and one said تاب.
(التوّاب) , derived from تاب يتوب of the class of نصر; it is an intensive form (mubālagha) of the active participle, its pattern فعّال with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(الرحيم) , see al-Fātiḥa, verse (1)

safi-cedvel:38-38.t:
* I'rab:
(قلنا) a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (اهبطوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (من) a preposition and (ها) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اهبطوا) . (جميعا) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, i.e. "all together"; (الفاء) resumptive; (إن) a jussivizing conditional particle; (ما) redundant (zāʾida); (يأتينّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (النون) the heavy nūn of emphasis, and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من) a preposition and (النون) for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يأتينّ) , (هدى) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of «إن»; (من) a jussivizing conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (تبع) a past verb, its fāʿil "he" (هو); (هدى) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied on the alif, and (الياء) muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) connecting the second apodosis; (لا) negative, inoperative (muhmala) «[Note: Or operating like laysa, «خوف» being its noun and «عليهم» its khabar.. Moreover, when (لا) is repeated by conjunction, the following cases are valid in the conjoined and the word conjoined to: 1- If the word conjoined to is nominative - by leaving lā inoperative or by making it operate like laysa - two options are permissible in the conjoined:
a- indeclinability on the fatḥa. b- the nominative. 2- If the word conjoined to is accusative, or indeclinable on the fatḥa, three options are permissible in the conjoined: a- the accusative. b- indeclinability on the fatḥa - c- the nominative.]» .
(خوف) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (على) a preposition and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant, for emphasising the negation; (هم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (يحزنون) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and (الواو) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil.
The clause «قلنا ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «اهبطوا» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يأتينّكم» has no grammatical position, being resumptive «[Note: It may be the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. if you go down from it, then I shall bestow guidance upon you.]» .
The clause «من تبع هداي» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition «إن», joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «تبع هداي» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: The khabar may be the two clauses of the protasis and the apodosis together.]» .
The clause «لا خوف عليهم» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition (من), joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «هم يحزنون» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «يحزنون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم) .

* Morphology:
(خوف) an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb خاف يخاف, of the class of فرح, its pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Benefits:
«فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ مِنِّي هُدىً..
1- «ما» frequently occurs after the conditional «إن» and is assimilated into it in pronunciation and writing, as in the words of Allah the Exalted «إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِنْدَكَ الْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُما، أَوْ كِلاهُما فَلا تَقُلْ لَهُما أُفٍّ» and the words of Allah the Exalted: «فَإِمَّا تَثْقَفَنَّهُمْ فِي الْحَرْبِ فَشَرِّدْ بِهِمْ مَنْ خَلْفَهُمْ»; in this form it is called «إن المؤكدة بما» ("in" emphasised by mā).
There are other kinds of «إن», among them «إن» lightened from the heavy (inna), the negative abrogating «إن», the negative «إن» that does not operate, and the conditional «إن» that does not make jussive, which is the least frequent of them in the speech of the Arabs, and it is better to leave it inoperative ...
2- When a conditional noun occurs as mubtadaʾ, as in their saying «مَنْ يَعْمَلْ سُوءاً يُجْزَ بِهِ», there are three views about the khabar: the first, the clause of the protasis; the second, the clause of the apodosis; and the third, the two clauses together, and this is the one we are comfortable with.

safi-cedvel:7-7.t:
* I'rab:
(ختم) past verb. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (على قلوب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ختم); (الهاء) is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and (الميم) is a particle for the masculine plural. (الواو) a conjunction. (على سمع) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ختم), on the basis of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "the places of their hearing"; (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) a conjunction. (على أبصار) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and (هم) is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (غشاوة) postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (الواو) a conjunction. (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and (الميم) is for the masculine plural. (عذاب) postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (عظيم) naʿt (adjective) of (عذاب), nominative like it.
The clause «ختم الله ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
The clause «على أبصارهم غشاوة ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «لهم عذاب ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(قلوبهم) plural of قلب, a primitive (jāmid) noun for the well-known organ.
(سمعهم) maṣdar (verbal noun) of سمع يسمع, of the class of فرح; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn. (أبصارهم) plural of بصر, maṣdar of بصر يبصر, of the class of كرم; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.
(غشاوة) a primitive noun for what covers the eye; its pattern is فعالة with kasra on the fāʾ, and fatḥa on it is also permissible.
(عذاب) a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the four-letter verb عذّب; its pattern is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(عظيم) ṣifa mushabbaha (adjective resembling the participle) from عظم يعظم, of the class of كرم; its pattern is فعيل.

* Rhetoric:
1- In the verse there is an explicit metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya), primary (aṣliyya), or dependent (tabaʿiyya) if الغشاوة is interpreted as a derived word or made a noun of instrument, as has been said. It is also possible that there is a representative metaphor (istiʿāra tamthīliyya) in the speech, by saying: the state of their hearts, their hearing and their sight, together with the condition arising in them that prevents benefiting from them, is likened to the state of things prepared for being used in important interests, together with the prevention of that by sealing and covering. Then the expression denoting what the thing is likened to is borrowed for what is likened, so that each of the two sides of the simile is composite, and the common ground is the failure to benefit from what it was prepared for.
2- If you say: why did He attribute the sealing to Allah the Exalted, when attributing it to Him indicates preventing the acceptance of the truth and reaching it by its paths, which is evil, and Allah is exalted above doing evil [Note: By this he points to the belief of the Muʿtazila that it is obligatory for Allah the Exalted to do what is best for His servant, and this is false.]? I say:
The intention is to describe the hearts as being as though sealed. As for attributing the sealing to Allah, Mighty and Majestic is He, it is to draw attention to the fact that this quality, in the excess of its firmness and the steadiness of its footing, is like something innate, not accidental.
3- He made hearing singular because of the oneness of what is heard, but not the hearts and the sights, because of the variety of what is perceived and what is seen.
4- He described the punishment by His saying «عظيم» to confirm what the indefiniteness conveys of magnification, intimidation and exaggeration in that; i.e. they shall have, of the great pains, a great kind whose essence cannot be reached and whose limit cannot be grasped.
5- Indefiniteness (al-tankīr): in His saying «غشاوة», and that is for magnification and intimidation.

safi-cedvel:8-8.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction or resumptive. (من) a preposition. (الناس) genitive (majrūr) by it, and the sign of the genitive is the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) [Note: The preposition and its genitive noun may be a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted noun described, which is the mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "some of the people are those who say ...".]. (من) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as postponed mubtadaʾ [Note: (من) may be an indefinite noun described (nakira mawṣūfa) in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, i.e. "a party who says":
and the clause after it is its naʿt.]. (يقول) imperfect, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو (he). (آمنّا) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (نا) is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil.
(بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آمنّا). (الواو) a conjunction. (باليوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, conjoined to the first, attached to (آمنّا). (الآخر) naʿt of (اليوم), genitive like it. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (ما) negative, functioning like ليس. (هم) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as the noun of ما. (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (مؤمنين) genitive in wording, accusative in position, the khabar of ما; the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.
The clause من الناس من يقول ... has no grammatical position, being conjoined to a resumptive clause, or resumptive.
The clause «يقول ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
The clause «آمنّا بالله ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «ما هم بمؤمنين ...» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).

* Morphology:
(الناس) its origin is أناس; its fāʾ (first radical) was deleted, and the alif and lām were made as a kind of compensation for it, so أناس is hardly used with the alif and lām [Note: In Lisān al-ʿArab: الناس is lightened from أناس, and they did not make the alif and lām a compensation for the deleted hamza, because if it were so, it would not have come together with what is compensated for in the saying of the poet: إنّ المنايا يطّلعن على الأناس الآمنينا (Death's fates rise up upon people who feel safe).].. On this basis the alif in الناس is extra, because it is derived from الإنس. Some of them said: there is neither deletion nor addition in the word, and the alif is converted from a wāw, which is the ʿayn (second radical) of the word, from ناس ينوس, "to move".
(يقول) contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by taskīn (making vowelless); its origin is يقول with sukūn on the qāf and ḍamma on the wāw [Translator's note: i.e. يَقْوُلُ.]; then the vowel of the wāw was transferred to the qāf before it because of the heaviness of the vowel on the weak letter, and it became يقول.
(آمنّا) the madda in it is originally two hamzas, the first vowelled and the second vowelless, i.e. (أأمنّا), because its imperfect is يؤمن [Note: It was mentioned in verse (3).].
(الآخر) mentioned in verse (4).
(مؤمنين) plural of مؤمن, active participle of the four-letter verb آمن; it is on the pattern of its imperfect, replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm carrying ḍamma and putting kasra on the letter before the last. The deletion of the hamza — as in the imperfect — has taken place in it in the same way as in (المفلحون); see verse (5).

* Benefits:
1- The grammarians have two views on «ما»:
The first: Ḥijāzī, based on the way of the people of the Ḥijāz, who make it function like «ليس», so it puts the mubtadaʾ in the nominative and the khabar in the accusative.
The second: the way of Banū Tamīm, who leave it inoperative, so the mubtadaʾ and khabar after it are both nominative.
2- «بمؤمنين»: the grammarians have gone on to call this bāʾ, which can be deleted while the meaning remains sound, «a redundant preposition (ḥarf jarr zāʾid)»; but here we go on to call it «a particle of emphasis (ḥarf tawkīd)», out of courtesy towards the Noble Qur'an, and because its rhetorical benefit is to emphasise the khabar. So the saying «وَما هُمْ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ» goes further in emphasis than our saying: «وما هم مؤمنون».

safi-cedvel:9-9.t:
* I'rab:
(يخادعون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of its nominative is the retention of the nūn; (الواو) is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent). (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الواو) a conjunction. (الذين) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the Name of Majesty. (آمنوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and (الواو) is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (ما) negative. (يخدعون) imperfect, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the retention of the nūn, and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (أنفس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الهاء) is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and (الميم) is a particle for the masculine plural. (الواو) circumstantial or a conjunction. (ما) negative. (يشعرون) like يخدعون.
The clause يخادعون ... is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of يقول, or from the pronoun latent in (مؤمنين) [Note: The clause may be resumptive with no grammatical position. Moreover, Ibn Ḥayyān rejected its being a ḥāl from the pronoun of مؤمنين, 1/56.] [Translator's note: "Ibn Ḥayyān" is as printed; the reference is most likely to Abū Ḥayyān (al-Baḥr al-Muḥīṭ).]. The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
The clause «ما يخدعون ...» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl from the agent of يخادعون [Note: Or conjoined to the resumptive clause, with no grammatical position.].
The clause «ما يشعرون ...» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl from the agent of يخدعون [Note: Or conjoined to the resumptive clause, with no grammatical position.]

* Morphology:
(أنفسهم) plural of نفس, a primitive (jāmid) noun meaning the self, the soul or the body; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn. The pattern of أنفس is أفعل with ḍamma on the ʿayn, and it is one of the plurals of paucity.

* Rhetoric:
1- المخادعة is a mufāʿala (form of reciprocity), and what is known about it is that each one does to the other the like of what the other does to him. So here it requires that from each of Allah, the believers and the hypocrites there issue an action relating to the other. This is what is called mushākala (verbal correspondence), because Allah, Glorified is He, neither deceives nor is deceived; He is free of need of any gain, attainment or drawing of benefit for Himself, and too majestic for anything hidden to be hidden from Him.
2- If you say: how did He say «يُخادِعُونَ اللَّهَ», when deception is conceivable only with regard to one from whom matters are hidden, so that the deception may be accomplished without his knowing, and nothing is hidden from Allah?
I say: what is meant is that they try to deceive the Messenger of Allah, since dealing with Allah is dealing with His Messenger, and vice versa, by the saying of the Exalted إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُبايِعُونَكَ إِنَّما يُبايِعُونَ اللَّهَ; or He called their hypocrisy deception because of its resemblance to the act of the deceiver. This is of the type of rational metonymy (al-majāz al-ʿaqlī).

* Benefits:
«يُخادِعُونَ اللَّهَ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا» al-Baqara, verse 9.
In this verse there is a noble point, and a truth which the Noble Qur'an emphasises; that truth is the bond between Allah and the believers: He makes their rank His rank, their cause His cause and their affair His affair. He, Glorified is He, places them under His protection, since He makes their enemy His enemy and their helper His helper. This favour raises the station of the believers to a lofty level, because the reality of faith is the greatest of realities. So reflect on this subtle meaning, which occurs frequently in the Noble Qur'an.

safi-cedvel:143-143.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (كذا): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of the verb جعلنا «[Note: If (الكاف) is parsed as a noun meaning "مثل", it is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, since it is its adjective, i.e. "جعلناكم جعلا مثل هدايتنا من نشاء". The reference is to the guidance mentioned in the previous verse, which has been expressed as "making" (jaʿl).]»; (اللام) denotes distance, and (الكاف) is a particle of address. (جعلنا): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn; (نا) is the fāʿil (agent) and (كم) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (أمّة): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (وسطا): a naʿt (adjective) of أمّة, accusative like it. (اللام): the lām of purpose (taʿlīl). (تكونوا): a defective imperfect verb (of kāna and its sisters), accusative by a concealed (أن) after the lām of purpose; the wāw is the noun (ism) of takūnu. (شهداء): the khabar (predicate) of تكونوا, accusative; it is denied nunation because it is on the pattern فعلاء.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تكونوا) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (جعلنا).
(على الناس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شهداء. (الواو): conjunction. (يكون): an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (أن), indicated by the one mentioned. (الرسول): the noun of يكون, nominative (marfūʿ). (على): a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (شهيدا), which is the khabar of يكون, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يكون) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first interpreted maṣdar and is attached to what the first is attached to.
(الواو): conjunction. (ما): negative. (جعلنا): like the first. (القبلة): mafʿūl bihi, accusative; it is the first object, and the second object is omitted, its implied form being "قبلة", i.e. a qibla for you now. (التي): a relative noun in the position of accusative as a naʿt of القبلة «[Note: The relative may be a second object, or a naʿt of the omitted second object, i.e. "جعلنا القبلة (الآن)" — and it is the Kaʿba — "القبلة التي كنت عليها", i.e. the Kaʿba, before Bayt al-Maqdis became the qibla of the Muslims. It is also possible that the mentioned القبلة is the second object and the relative noun is an adjective of the omitted first object, which is "the direction" or "the qibla", i.e. "We have made the direction which you were facing at first", meaning before the Hijra, "the qibla for you now".]». (كنت): a defective past verb, indeclinable on sukūn; (التاء) is the noun of kāna. (عليها): like (عليكم), attached to an omitted khabar of كنت. (إلا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (اللام): of purpose. (نعلم): an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed (أن) after the lām; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن", for majesty. (من): a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (يتّبع): an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and it is the referent pronoun. (الرسول): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (من): a preposition. (من): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (نعلم), which carries the sense of "نميّز" (we distinguish). (ينقلب): an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (على عقبي): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ينقلب), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نعلم) is in the position of genitive by the lām of purpose, attached to (جعلنا).
(الواو): of the ḥāl (circumstantial), or parenthetical. (إن): lightened from the heavy (inna), and its non-operation is obligatory. (كانت): a defective past verb, (التاء) marking the feminine; the noun of kāna is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هي", i.e. the turning towards the Kaʿba. (اللام): it is the distinguishing lām (al-fāriqa) between the negative (إن) and the lightened (إن), and this lām is obligatory. (كبيرة): the khabar of كانت, accusative. (إلا): a particle of restriction. (على): a preposition. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (كبيرة); the restriction rests on an implied negation understood from the context, i.e. "it is not easy except for those whom Allah has guided" «[Note: If the thing excepted from (al-mustathnā minhu) is taken as omitted, (إلا) is a particle of exception, and the implied form is "it was hard upon the people except upon those whom Allah guided"; the prepositional phrase after إلا is then attached to an omitted element, i.e. "except the hardness upon those whom Allah guided". Ibn Ḥayyān rejected that the exception be an emptied (mufarragh) one.]». «[Translator's note: so in the source, "Ibn Ḥayyān"; presumably Abū Ḥayyān is meant.]» (هدى): a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif. (الله): fāʿil, nominative. (الواو): conjunction. (ما): negative. (كان): like the previous one. (الله): the Name of Majesty, the noun of kāna, nominative. (اللام): the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), or of disavowal. (يضيع): an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed (أن) after the lām; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (إيمان): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يضيع) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted khabar of kāna, i.e. "Allah was not content with the loss of your faith".
(إنّ): a particle resembling the verb (of inna and its sisters). (الله): the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative. (بالناس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (رؤف ورحيم). (اللام): it is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), giving emphasis. (رؤف): the khabar of inna, nominative. (رحيم): second khabar, nominative.
The clause «جعلناكم..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يهدي من يشاء.
The clause «تكونوا ... » has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī).
The clause «يكون الرسول ... » has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative.
The clause «ما جعلنا ... » has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause جعلناكم.
The clause «كنت عليها» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of (التي).
The clause «نعلم..» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative.
The clause «يتّبع الرسول» has no grammatical position: ṣila of (من).
The clause «ينقلب» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second (من).
The clause «كانت لكبيرة» has no grammatical position: parenthetical; or it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «هدى الله» has no grammatical position: ṣila of (الذين).
The clause «ما كان الله ... » has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause جعلناكم.
The clause «يضيع» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative.
The clause «إنّ الله ... » has no grammatical position: giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(وسطا): its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas; it serves for masculine and feminine, singular and plural. It is a derived adjective of the verb وسط يسط of the pattern-class of ضرب.
(عقبيه): dual of عقب, which is the name of the back of the foot; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then kasra, and the construction is figurative.
(كبيرة): feminine of كبير, a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) from كبر يكبر of the pattern-class of فرح; its pattern is فعيل.. See also verse (45) of this sūra. (رؤف): a derived adjective whose pattern is فعول, from verbs of the third, fourth and fifth pattern-classes; it is a ṣifa mushabbaha among the attributes of Allah, or an intensive form of the active participle, used of the Creator and the created.

* Rhetoric:
1- Metaphor (istiʿāra): in the words of the Exalted «وسطا». Originally it is the name of that to which the sides stand in equal relation — like the centre — then it was borrowed for praiseworthy human qualities, because they are midpoints between the blameworthy qualities surrounding them on the two extremes of excess and deficiency, such as generosity between extravagance and miserliness, and courage between cowardice and recklessness.
2- The representational metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya): in the words of the Exalted «مِمَّنْ يَنْقَلِبُ عَلى عَقِبَيْهِ», the common ground being that the one who turns back leaves what is in his hands and turns away from it in the worst manner of returning; likewise the apostate turns back from Islam and leaves the proofs that are in his hands in the worst state.
3- Fronting and delaying (al-taqdīm wa-l-taʾkhīr): «شهداء» has been placed before its complement, which is «عَلَى النَّاسِ», and «شهيدا» has been placed after its complement, which is «عليكم», because the favour bestowed upon them lies in both respects: in the first, in establishing that they are witnesses, and in the second, in establishing that they are testified for with commendation; and what is fronted is always the more important.

* Benefits:
1- أُمَّةً وَسَطاً: it is said that it is middle in place, in the most central of its lands; it is said that it is middle in time, middle in the development of humanity between its childhood and its maturity.. It is said: the "middle" are the best and the just. Perhaps the best of the views is that the middle nation is the one that takes the middle course in matters, with neither excess nor deficiency, and this agrees with the definition of virtue as a mean between two vices.
2- The lām in His words «لكبيرة» is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa), which distinguishes between إن lightened from إنّ and the negative إن. As for the lām in the words of the Exalted «ليضيع», it is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and its condition is that it be preceded by a negated kāna.

safi-cedvel:76-76.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (إذا لقوا ... قالوا آمنّا): its i'rab has passed in verse (14), word by word and clause by clause.. (الواو): conjunction. (إذا): an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the answer قالوا. (خلا): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (بعض): fāʿil (agent), nominative, and (هم): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. (الى بعض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb (خلا), (قالوا): a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and its fāʿil. (الهمزة): for the interrogative of rebuke (istifhām tawbīkhī). (تحدّثون): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (هم): mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الباء): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to (تحدّثون). (فتح): past verb. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (على): a preposition, and (كم): a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (فتح), (اللام): for causation (taʿlīl) [Note: Or it is for becoming and outcome (ṣayrūra wa-maʾāl).] (يحاجّوا): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by (أن) concealed after the lām, and (الواو): a pronoun, fāʿil, and (كم): a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الباء): a preposition, and (الهاء): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يحاجّوكم), (عند): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (يحاجّوكم), (رب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (كم): muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar from the concealed (أن) and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (تحدّثونهم).
(الهمزة): for the interrogative of rebuke. (الفاء): conjunction. (لا): negating. (تعقلون): like تحدّثون.
The clause «لقوا ... » is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position: the answer of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «آمنّا» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «خلا بعضهم» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position: the answer of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «أتحدّثونهم..» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «فتح الله» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «تعقلون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause تحدثونهم, because it is within the scope of their saying, i.e. "they said: do you tell them.. and they said: do you not understand?"

* Morphology:
(خلا): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion; its origin is خلو with fatḥa on the wāw: the wāw came voweled after a fatḥa, so it was converted to an alif.

safi-cedvel:77-77.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة): for the interrogative of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī) or of rebuke (tawbīkhī). (الواو): conjunction [Note: This is according to the view of the majority, but taking it as resumptive is not far-fetched, and the clause after it is then resumptive.], (يعلمون): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (أنّ): a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl), for emphasis. (الله): the Name of Majesty, the ism of anna, accusative. (يعلم): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (ما): a relative noun [Note: Or a maṣdarī particle, and the interpreted maṣdar from (ما) and the verb after it is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of (يعلم); and likewise (ما يعلنون).], indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted. (يسرّون): like يعلمون. (الواو): conjunction. (ما يعلنون): like ما يسرّون.
The clause «يعلمون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an omitted resumptive clause, i.e.:
"Do they blame them, and do they not know?"
The clause «يعلم» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of anna.
The clause «يسرّون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (ما).
The clause «يعلنون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The interpreted maṣdar from anna, its ism and its khabar stands in place of the two objects of يعلمون.

* Morphology:
(يعلنون): the hamza at its beginning has been dropped, following the course of ينفقون.. see verse (3).
(يسرون): the hamza at its beginning has been dropped, following the course of ينفقون ...

safi-cedvel:78-78.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (من): a preposition, (هم): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). (أميّون): a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw. (لا): negating. (يعلمون): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الكتاب): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (إلّا): a particle of exception. (أمانيّ): accusative as an excepted (mustathnā) in a disjoined exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ). (الواو): conjunction. (ان): negating. (هم): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ. (إلّا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (يظنون): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «منهم أمّيون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause قد كان فريق منهم [Note: In verse (75).. It may be cut off from the conjunction and made resumptive, so it has no grammatical position.].
The clause «لا يعلمون الكتاب» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of (أميّون).
The clause «إن هم إلّا يظنون» is conjoined to the clause منهم أميّون and takes its grammatical position.
The clause «يظنّون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of (هم), and the two objects of يظنّون are omitted, i.e. "they think falsehoods to be truth".

* Morphology:
(أميّون): plural of أمّيّ, a nisba (relative adjective) to أم (mother), as though he remained in his original state of creation. The pattern of أمّيّ is فعليّ, with ḍamma on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(أمانيّ): plural of أمنيّة, with doubled yāʾ in the singular and the plural; it may be lightened in both. It is a noun for what a person imagines within himself. Its pattern is أفعيلة, with ḍamma on the hamza; the pattern of أمانيّ with doubled yāʾ is أفاعيل, and without doubling أفاعل.

safi-cedvel:79-79.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء): resumptive. (ويل): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative [Note: Beginning with an indefinite noun is permitted because it is an imprecation, and it falls within the notion of generality by which an indefinite noun may validly be a mubtadaʾ.],, (اللام): a preposition. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). (يكتبون): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn, and (الواو): an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative, fāʿil (agent). (الكتاب): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (بأيدي): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يكتبون), the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and (هم): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. (ثمّ): conjunction. (يقولون): like يكتبون. (ها): a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ. (من عند): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of ذا. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (اللام): for causation (taʿlīl). (يشتروا): an imperfect verb, accusative by (أن) concealed after the lām, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الباء): a preposition, and (الهاء): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يشتروا), by its being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of "exchange" (يستبدلوا).
The interpreted maṣdar from the concealed (أن) and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, [attached] to (يقولون).
(ثمنا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (قليلا): a naʿt (adjective) of (ثمنا), accusative like it.
(الفاء): conjunction. (ويل): like the first. (اللام): a preposition, and (هم): attached, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar. (من): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun [Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective (nakira mawṣūfa), in the position of genitive.. and the clause after it is its naʿt.. or a maṣdarī particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive.] in the position of genitive by (من), attached to the omitted khabar. (كتب): a past verb, and (التاء): for the feminine. (أيدي): fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and (هم): attached, in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (ويل لهم ممّا): its i'rab has passed. (يكسبون): like يكتبون.
The clause ويل للذين يكتبون.. has no grammatical position: a resumption confirming the content of what preceded.
The clause «يكتبون.» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يقولون..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «هذا من عند الله» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «ويل لهم..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ويل للذين.
The clause «كتبت أيديهم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «ويل لهم (the second)» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ويل لهم (the first).
The clause «يكسبون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the second relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(ويل): a maṣdar (verbal noun) that has no verb, because of the weakness of its fāʾ and its ʿayn; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.. In the exegesis it is the name of a valley in Hell.
(أيدي): plural of يد; its lām has been deleted. Its origin is بدو [Translator's note: so in the source; يدو is evidently meant], because the wāw returns in the nisba, so one says يدوي.. The origin of أيدي is أيدو, with ḍamma on the dāl, on the measure of أفلس; then the ḍamma on the dāl was found heavy, so it was given kasra; then the wāw was converted to yāʾ because of its sukūn and the kasra before it, giving أيدي. Its pattern is أفعل, with ḍamma on the ʿayn originally.
(ثمنا): a noun for what is the compensation for the thing sold; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.

* Rhetoric:
- Prolixity (iṭnāb): in His saying, the Exalted, يَكْتُبُونَ الْكِتابَ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ, for He mentioned the hand although writing is only done with it, in order to establish that they themselves directly undertook what they distorted, as an increase in showing the ugliness of their deed.

safi-cedvel:80-80.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (قالوا): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma..
and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (لن): a particle of negation and the subjunctive. (تمسّ): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and (نا): an attached pronoun in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (النار): fāʿil, nominative. (إلا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), and the exception is emptied (mufarragh). (أياما): an adverb of time, accusative. (معدودة): a naʿt (adjective) of (أياما), accusative like it. (قل): an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (الهمزة): for the interrogative. (اتّخذتم): a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and its fāʿil. (عند): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اتّخذتم) [Note: This is if the verb has the meaning of وجد, transitive to one object.. It may be attached to the second object, fronted, of the verb اتّخذ when it is transitive to two objects.], (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (عهدا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الفاء): conjunction. (لن): like the first. (يخلف): an imperfect verb, accusative. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (عهد): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء): a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, (أم): a conjunction, and it is the connected (muttaṣila) one [Note: Or it is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one, in the sense of bal.], (تقولون): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (على الله): preposition [and its genitive noun] the verb.. so the connecting hamza (hamzat al-waṣl) entered upon the verb to escape beginning with a letter with sukūn, and when the hamza of the interrogative came, it took the place of the connecting hamza.
[Translator's note: the source text breaks off here mid-sentence and jumps into what appears to be a morphology note on اتّخذتم; the rest of the i'rab of this verse, its clause analysis and the beginning of the morphology section are missing in the source.]

safi-cedvel:39-39.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (كفروا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (الواو) conjunction; (كذّبوا) like «كفروا»; (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كذّبوا), and (نا) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (الكاف) a particle of address; (أصحاب) khabar (predicate), nominative; (النار) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (هم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (في) a preposition and (ها) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (خالدون), which is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «هم», nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw.
The clause «الذين كفروا» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause «من تبع هداي» in the previous verse «[Note: It may be cut off as resumptive, so it has no grammatical position.]» .
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين) .
The clause «كذّبوا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أولئك أصحاب النار» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين) .
The clause «هم فيها خالدون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أصحاب» or of «النار».

* Morphology:
(آيات) , plural of آية, a noun meaning "sign"; its origin is أيية: its fāʾ is a hamza and its ʿayn and lām are two yāʾs, because it is from تأيّى القوم, when the people gathered.. Then they replaced the first yāʾ with alif because it was vowelled and what preceded it had fatḥa; so the hamza and the quiescent alif came together and were merged, and a madda was placed over them. The pattern of آيات is فعلات.
(أصحاب) , plural of صاحب, which is an active participle of صحب يصحب, of the class of فرح, its pattern فاعل.

safi-cedvel:40-40.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) a vocative particle; (بني) the one addressed, a muḍāf, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ, because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural; (إسرائيل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa, since it is a diptote on account of being a proper name and foreign; (اذكروا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (نعمة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, its appearance prevented by the place being occupied with the vowel of congruence (ḥarakat al-munāsaba), and (الياء) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (التي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of (نعمتي) , (أنعمت) a past verb and its fāʿil; (على) a preposition and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنعمت) , (الواو) conjunction; (أوفوا) like «اذكروا»; (بعهد) a preposition and its genitive noun, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the letter before the yāʾ, attached to (أوفوا) , (الياء) muḍāf ilayhi; (أوف) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) in answer to the command (jawāb al-ṭalab), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the weak letter, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "I" (أنا); (بعهدكم) a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi, attached to (أوف) . (الواو) conjunction; (إيّاي) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb whose implied form is «ارهبوا»; (الفاء) redundant (zāʾida) «[Note: It came to emphasise the meaning and adorn the wording - according to al-Fārisī - while according to others it is a conjunction, conjoining the stated clause to the implied clause «ارهبوا», or to a new implied clause, i.e. "take heed, and fear Me"; this is the choice of Abū Ḥayyān.]» , (ارهبوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (النون) for protection (wiqāya): it protected the verb from the kasra through its connection with the yāʾ of the first person, which was deleted for lightness, and which is the mafʿūl bihi.
The clause «يا بني إسرائيل..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «اذكروا ... » has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «أنعمت ... » has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (التي) .
The clause «أوفوا..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the vocative clause.
The clause «أوف ... » has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, not joined with the fāʾ, i.e.: if you fulfil, I will fulfil.
The implied clause «(ارهبوا)» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the vocative clause.
The clause «ارهبون» has no grammatical position, being an explication (tafsīr) of the implied clause.

* Morphology:
(بني) , plural of ابن; the alif in ابن is a compensation for the deleted lām of the word, its origin being بنو.
(إسرائيل) , a foreign proper noun; it may be pronounced with the hamza lightened, إسراييل; or the hamza may remain and the yāʾ be deleted, i.e. إسرائل; or the hamza and the yāʾ may both be deleted, i.e.:
إسرال.
(نعمة) , the noun for that with which one is blessed, of the verb نعم ينعم, of the classes of نصر and فتح, and نعم ينعم of the class of فرح; its pattern is فعلة with kasra then sukūn.
(أوفوا) , in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion together with an iʿlāl by quiescence: its origin is أوفيوا, with ḍamma on the yāʾ; the ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so the yāʾ was made quiescent and its vowel transferred to the fāʾ - this is iʿlāl by quiescence - then the yāʾ was deleted because of its quiescence and the quiescence of the wāw of the plural, so one said أوفوا; its pattern is أفعوا.
(أوف) , in it there is an iʿlāl by deletion on account of the jussive; its pattern is أفع.

safi-cedvel:41-41.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (آمنوا) an imperative verb.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمنوا) , and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted; (أنزلت) a past verb and its fāʿil; (مصدّقا) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object pronoun in «أنزلت»; (اللام) the lām of strengthening (taqwiya), redundant (zāʾida); (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle «[Note: This is the more remote position; as for the nearer one, it is in the position of genitive by the lām; and the lām may be attached to (مصدّقا) .]» .
(مع) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) of prohibition, jussivizing; (تكونوا) a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and (الواو) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of «تكون»; (أول) the khabar (predicate) of «تكون», accusative; (كافر) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (كافر) , (الواو) conjunction; (لا تشتروا) like «لا تكونوا», but it is complete (tāmm), being made to include the meaning of «تستبدلوا» (exchange); (بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تشتروا) , and (الياء) muḍāf ilayhi; (ثمنا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (قليلا) a naʿt (adjective) of (ثمنا), accusative like it; (الواو) conjunction; (إياي فاتّقون) like «اياي فارهبون» in the previous verse.
The clause «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause that is the response to the vocative in the previous verse.
The clause «أنزلت» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun.
The clause «لا تكونوا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «آمنوا».
The clause «لا تشتروا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «آمنوا».
The implied clause «(اتقوا)» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «آمنوا».
The clause «اتّقون» has no grammatical position, being explicative of the implied clause.

* Morphology:
(مصدّقا) , an active participle of the four-letter verb صدّق, so it is on the pattern of its imperfect, replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm with ḍamma and putting kasra on the letter before the last.
(أوّل) , its pattern is أفعل, and its fāʾ and ʿayn are two wāws; no verb is conjugated from it because of the weakness of the fāʾ and the ʿayn. Some said it is from آل يؤول, so the origin of the word is أأول; then the second hamza was moved back and placed after the wāw, أوأل; then the second hamza was lightened by replacing it with a wāw, then it was assimilated with the first wāw.. This is the view of some of the Kufans.
(تشتروا) , in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by quiescence and by deletion: its origin is تشتريوا with ḍamma on the yāʾ; the ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so its vowel was transferred to the rāʾ and it was made quiescent; then the yāʾ was deleted because of its quiescence and the quiescence of the wāw after it, so it became تشتروا; its pattern is تفتعوا.
(اتّقون) , in it there is an iʿlāl by quiescence and by deletion, following the same course as تشتروا; likewise in it there is the replacement of the wāw - the fāʾ of the word - with tāʾ, as happened in تتّقون.. see verse (21) .. and the yāʾ of the first person was deleted from it for lightness, so that the wording would match the verse-endings (fawāṣil).
(قليلا) , an assimilate adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) from قلّ يقلّ, of the class of ضرب, its pattern فعيل.

* Benefits:
- «وَإِيَّايَ فَاتَّقُونِ. The accusative pronoun «إيّا» is accusative by way of ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb); the explanation of that is that the object of the verb «اتقى» is omitted for lightness, as shown by the presence of the nūn of protection that separates the verb from its object, its implied form being «اتقوني»; as for the pronoun «إيّا», it is accusative by an omitted verb that is explained by the stated verb.

safi-cedvel:42-42.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (لا تلبسوا) like «لا تكونوا» in the previous verse, but it is complete (tāmm); (الحقّ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (بالباطل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تلبسوا) , (الواو) conjunction, or the wāw of accompaniment (al-maʿiyya); (تكتموا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), conjoined to «تلبسوا» - or accusative by (أن) concealed after the wāw of accompaniment - «[Note: and the interpreted maṣdar formed from (أنّ) «[Translator's note: so in the source, with shadda; «أن» is meant.]» and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: let there not be from you a confounding of the truth with falsehood and a concealing of the truth.]» .. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الحق) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) circumstantial; (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (تعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «لا تلبسوا ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the prohibition clause in the previous verse.
The clause «تكتموا..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «تلبسوا».
The clause «أنتم تعلمون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
The clause «تعلمون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (أنتم) .

* Morphology:
(الباطل) , an active participle of بطل يبطل, of the class of كرم; it is the opposite of الحقّ; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:43-43.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction, (أقيموا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الصلاة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (آتوا) like «أقيموا»; (الزكاة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, (الواو) conjunction; (اركعوا) like «أقيموا»; (مع) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اركعوا) , (الراكعين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قيموا ... » «[Translator's note: so in the source, for «أقيموا».]» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «لا تلبسوا..» in the previous verse.
The clause «آتوا الزكاة» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «أقيموا».
The clause «اركعوا ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «أقيموا».

* Morphology:
(أقيموا) , in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion: its origin is أقوموا; it followed the same course as (يقيمون) in verse (3) .
(الصلاة) , a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the four-letter verb صلّى; the alif in it is converted from a wāw, because its plural is صلوات; the wāw came vowelled and what preceded it had fatḥa, so it was converted into alif; its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa on the fāʾ, the ʿayn and the lām.. see verse (3) .
(آتوا) , in it there is an iʿlāl by quiescence and by deletion: its origin is آتيوا with ḍamma on the yāʾ; the ḍamma on the yāʾ was felt heavy, so it was made quiescent - this is iʿlāl by quiescence - then it was deleted because it met, quiescent, with the quiescent wāw - this is iʿlāl by deletion - then the tāʾ was given ḍamma, the vowel of the deleted yāʾ.
(الزكاة) , in it there is an iʿlāl by conversion: the alif is converted from a wāw, as they say زكا يزكو; the wāw came vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into alif. Its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa on the fāʾ, the ʿayn and the lām.
(الراكعين) , plural of الراكع, which is an active participle of ركع يركع, of the class of فتح, its pattern فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
- Synecdochic metaphor (al-majāz al-mursal): in the words of Allah the Exalted وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكاةَ، وَارْكَعُوا مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ, i.e. pray with those who pray; He expressed it by the part, which is bowing (al-rukūʿ), and meant the whole, which is the prayer. So the relation of this figure is partiality (juzʾiyya).

safi-cedvel:44-44.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for interrogation of disapproval (inkārī); (تأمرون) an imperfect verb, nominative..
and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الناس) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (بالبرّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تأمرون) , (الواو) conjunction; (تنسون) like «تأمرون»; (أنفس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) circumstantial; (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (تتلون) like «تأمرون»; (الكتاب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الهمزة) for interrogation of reproach and disapproval; (الفاء) conjunction; (لا) negative; (تعقلون) like «تأمرون».
The clause «تأمرون ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تنسون ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «أنتم تتلون ... » is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of «تنسون».
The clause «تتلون..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (أنتم) .
The clause «تعقلون» has no grammatical position, being (conjoined) to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(البرّ) , a noun for all kinds of good; its verb is برّ يبرّ, of the class of فرح; its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn.
(تنسون) , in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: its origin is تنساون; two quiescent letters met, the alif and the wāw, so the alif was deleted to escape the two quiescent letters, and what precedes the wāw remained with fatḥa as an indication of it; its pattern is تفعون.
(تتلون) , in it there is an iʿlāl by deletion: its origin is تتلوون; two quiescent letters met, the lām of the word and the wāw of the plural; the lām of the word was deleted to escape the meeting of the two quiescent letters; its pattern is تفعون.

* Rhetoric:
- The words of Allah the Exalted وَأَنْتُمْ تَتْلُونَ الْكِتابَ, where He opened the statement with the pronoun for rebuke and greater censure.

safi-cedvel:10-10.t:
* I'rab:
(في قلوب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (مرض) postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ). (الفاء) a conjunction. (زاد) past verb, and (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative. (مرضا) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (الواو) a conjunction. (اللام) a preposition. (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by the lām; the two are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (عذاب) postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (أليم) naʿt (adjective) of (عذاب), nominative like it. (الباء) a causal preposition. (ما) a maṣdariyya (infinitival) particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, with the clause after it as its ṣila (relative clause), and the referent pronoun omitted.]. (كانوا) an incomplete past verb (kāna and its sisters), and (الواو) is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as the noun of كان. (يكذبون) imperfect verb, nominative, and (الواو) is a pronoun, the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from (ما) and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to an omitted second naʿt of (عذاب), i.e. "a painful punishment deserved by their being liars".
The clause «في قلوبهم مرض ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive and explanatory (istiʾnāfiyya bayāniyya), confirming the meaning of what is said of them: «ما هم بمؤمنين..», or causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «زادهم الله مرضا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause في قلوبهم مرض.
The clause «لهم عذاب أليم ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause زادهم الله مرضا.
The clause «يكذبون ...» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of كانوا, and the clause (كانوا) has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī).

* Morphology:
(مرض) a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb مرض بمرض [Translator's note: so printed; read يمرض.], of the class of فرح; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.
(زاد) contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by qalb (conversion); its origin is زيد, its imperfect being يزيد. The yāʾ came vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted to alif. It is either an intransitive verb, as in زاد المال (the wealth increased), or a verb transitive to two objects, as in زادك الله جلالا (may Allah increase you in majesty).
(أليم) ṣifa mushabbaha (adjective resembling the participle) from ألم يألم, of the class of فرح; its pattern is فعيل.
(كانوا) contains iʿlāl by qalb; its origin is كون, its imperfect being يكون. The wāw came vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted to alif.

* Rhetoric:
1- Explicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya) in the saying of the Exalted فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ: sickness is borrowed here for what is in their hearts of ignorance, evil belief, enmity towards the Prophet ﷺ and other kinds of unbelief leading to spiritual ruin. The indefiniteness is to indicate its being a vague kind, other than the sicknesses people are familiar with.

safi-cedvel:11-11.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction. (إذا) an adverb (ẓarf) of future time, containing the meaning of condition, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis قالوا. (قيل) past verb, passive. (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (قيل). (لا) prohibitive, making jussive. (تفسدوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of the jussive is the deletion of the nūn; (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent). (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تفسدوا). (قالوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
(إنّما) restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa), having no governing effect. (نحن) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (مصلحون) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of its nominative is the wāw; the nūn is a compensation for the tanwīn in the singular noun.
The clause «قيل ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The clause «لا تفسدوا ...» is in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) [Note: The majority make this clause one with no grammatical position, explicative (mufassira) of the implied nāʾib fāʿil, which is the saying that the clause explains; that is because the clause — in their view — cannot properly be a nāʾib fāʿil, since originally it cannot properly be a fāʿil.. But the clause, from another point of view, is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of the active verb, and when the verb was made passive the clause became nāʾib fāʿil. Some of the early grammarians incline to adopt this view, such as al-Zamakhsharī, who makes the attribution verbal (lafẓī), not semantic, and so do the moderns. A parallel to this verse will come in many noble verses, and we shall parse them as it has been parsed here.].
The clause «قالوا» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «نحن مصلحون» is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying.

* Morphology:
(إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition; it may be free of condition: والليل إذا يغشى; and it may come for surprise (mufājaʾa): خرجت فإذا رجل بالباب (I went out, and lo, a man at the door).
(تفسدوا) contains the deletion of the hamza for lightening, as happened in (يؤمنون, ويقيمون).
(قيل) contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by qalb (conversion); its origin is قول with ḍamma on the first letter and kasra on the second [Translator's note: i.e. قُوِلَ.]. But the wāw — being a weak letter — cannot bear the vowel, so it had to be made vowelless, and its vowel was transferred to the qāf, and it became قول with kasra then sukūn [Translator's note: i.e. قِوْلَ.]. Then the wāw was converted to yāʾ because it is vowelless and preceded by a kasra, and the verb became قيل.
(الأرض) a primitive (jāmid) noun, and the hamza in it is radical; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(مصلحون) plural of مصلح, active participle of أصلح. So in it the hamza has been deleted for lightening, as it was deleted from its imperfect, because it is on its pattern, replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm carrying ḍamma and putting kasra on the letter before the last; its origin is مؤصلحون.

safi-cedvel:12-12.t:
* I'rab:
(ألا) a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis (inna and its sisters), and (الهاء) is a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of إنّ, and (الميم) is a particle for the masculine plural. (هم) a detached pronoun [Note: Or a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), with (المفسدون) as the khabar of إنّ; or a tawkīd (emphasis) of the attached pronoun that is the noun of إنّ, in which case it is borrowed for the position of the accusative.] in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (المفسدون) khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the wāw. (الواو) a conjunction or circumstantial. (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk). (لا) negative. (يشعرون) imperfect, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the retention of the nūn; (الواو) is an attached pronoun, the fāʿil (agent).
