(نفس) , a noun meaning the spirit, or the body, or the person; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(شفاعة) , maṣdar (verbal noun) of شفع يشفع, of the class of فتح, its pattern فعالة with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(عدل) , maṣdar of عدل يعدل, of the class of ضرب, meaning ransom; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
- He brought the last conjoined clause, «وَلا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ», as a nominal clause although the clauses before it are verbal, for intensiveness and to indicate permanence and continuity, i.e. that they are never helped, and no account is to be taken of whatever success they happen upon.

safi-cedvel:49-49.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذا) «[Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is «إذ».]» an adverbial noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb whose implied form is «اذكروا» (remember); (نجينا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (من آل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نجّينا) , (فرعون) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, because it is a diptote on account of being a proper name and foreign; (يسومون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (كم) mafʿūl bihi; (سوء) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (العذاب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (يذبّحون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil; (أبناء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (يستحيون نساءكم) like «يذبّحون أبناءكم». (الواو) resumptive; (في) a preposition; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate), and (اللام) for distance, (الكاف) for address and (الميم) for the masculine plural; (بلاء) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (بلاء), and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (عظيم) a second naʿt of (بلاء), nominative like it.
The clause «نجّيناكم..» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «يسومونكم» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (آل فرعون) .
The clause «يذبّحون» is in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) of the clause «يسومونكم» «[Note: Or it is a ḥāl of the fāʿil of «يسومونكم».]» .
The clause «يستحيون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause «يذبّحون».
The clause «في ذلكم بلاء» has no grammatical position, being resumptive «[Note: Or parenthetical between the clauses of the account of the Children of Israel.]» .

* Morphology:
(آل) , the hamza was originally a hāʾ, i.e. أهل; the hāʾ was replaced by the hamza because of its closeness to it in point of articulation; then the two hamzas were converted into a madda, because the first has fatḥa and the second is quiescent. It was also said: the origin of آل is أول, from آل يؤول, because a person returns (yaʾūlu) to his family.
(فرعون) , a definite foreign noun, a title for whoever ruled Egypt. It was said: no explanation of فرعون in Arabic is known. From this title - on account of the insolence and tyranny of its bearer - the verb تفرعن was derived, i.e. he became possessed of cunning and guile.
(سوء) , a noun for whatever troubles a person, of worldly or otherworldly matters; it is originally a maṣdar (verbal noun), and is made feminine with the alif: السوءى; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.
(العذاب) , a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the verb عذّب, because its letters fall short of the letters of the maṣdar, which is تعذيب. Its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ.. and see verse (7) of this sūra.
(أبناء) , plural of ابن - see verse 40 - (يستحيون) , in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: its origin is يستحييون with kasra on the first yāʾ, and the deletion followed the same course as in تشتروا (verse 41) .
(نساء) , the hamza in it is converted from a wāw, as it appears in its synonyms نسوة and نسوان; its origin is نساو; when the wāw came final after the alif it was converted into hamza, and this conversion is regular. It is a plural with no singular from its own wording; its singular is امرأة.
(بلاء) an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb بلا يبلو, of the class of نصر; the hamza in it is converted from a wāw - as appears in the verb - its pattern فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
1- Synecdochic metaphor (al-majāz al-mursal): in the words of Allah the Exalted يُذَبِّحُونَ أَبْناءَكُمْ, for they slaughtered only some of the sons, since they did not slaughter the young and the old; so the relation of this figure is generality (ʿumūm).

safi-cedvel:50-50.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذ فرقنا) like «إذ نجّينا» in the previous verse; (الباء) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (فرقنا), and the bāʾ is causal; (البحر) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الفاء) conjunction; (أنجينا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent), and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (الواو) conjunction; (أغرقنا) like «أنجينا»; (آل) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (فرعون) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, (الواو) circumstantial; (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (تنظرون) an imperfect verb, nominative..
and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «فرقنا ... » is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «أنجيناكم» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «فرقنا».
The clause «أغرقنا ... » is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «فرقنا».
The clause «أنتم تنظرون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
The clause «تنظرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (أنتم) .

* Morphology:
(البحر) , a primitive (jāmid) noun for abundant and salty water; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:51-51.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذ واعدنا) like «إذ فرقنا ...» or «نجّينا»; (موسى) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (أربعين) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ, since it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural; (ليلة) tamyīz (specification), accusative; (ثمّ) a conjunction; (اتّخذتم) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (العجل) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and it is the first object; as for the second, it is omitted, its implied form being (إلها) (a god). (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اتّخذتم) , and (الهاء) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi, (الواو) circumstantial; (أنتم) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (ظالمون) khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «واعدنا ... » is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «اتخذتم ... » is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «واعدنا».
The clause «أنتم ظالمون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

* Morphology:
(موسى) , a foreign proper noun. It was said that it is from أوسيت رأسه, when you have shaved it, so it is on the pattern of the passive participle; and it was said that it is فعلى with ḍamma on the fāʾ, from ماس يميس, when one walks proudly; on this view the wāw in موسى is a replacement of the yāʾ because of its quiescence and the ḍamma on what precedes it. But this account does not apply to the name of the Prophet; rather it applies to the الموسى (razor) that cuts.
(أربعين) , one of the nouns for the tens among numbers; it is assimilated to the masculine plural.
(ليلة) , feminine of ليل, from sunset to the rising of dawn. It was said that الليلة is the singular of الليل, the latter being a collective noun; and it was said that الليل and الليلة have one meaning; the plural is الليالي.
(العجل) , a primitive (jāmid) noun for the well-known animal; its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:174-174.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna; (يكتمون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the fāʿil (agent) is the wāw; (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) «[Note: It is permissible for (ما) to be an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective.. and the clause after it is its naʿt (adjective).]», (أنزل) a past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (من الكتاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of أنزل; (الواو) conjunction; (يشترون) like يكتمون; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يشترون), since it is made to include the meaning of يستبدلون (they exchange); (ثمنا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (قليلا) naʿt of (ثمنا), accusative like it; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف) is a particle of address; (ما) negative; (يأكلون) like يكتمون; (في بطون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يأكلون), since it is made to include the meaning of يضعون (they put); (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (النار) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negative; (يكلّم) an imperfect verb, nominative; (وهم) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi «[Translator's note: so in the source; the pronoun meant is (هم) in يكلّمهم.]»; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يكلّمهم), (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الواو) conjunction; (لا يزكّيهم) like لا يكلّمهم; (الواو) conjunction; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); (عذاب) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (أليم) naʿt of عذاب, nominative like it.
The clause «إن الذين يكتمون..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يكتمون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «أنزل الله» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يشترون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause يكتمون.
The clause «أولئك ما يأكلون» is in the position of nominative as khabar of inna.
The clause «ما يأكلون» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «لا يكلّمهم الله» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause ما يأكلون.
The clause «لا يزكّيهم» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause ما يأكلون.
The clause لهم عذاب is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause ما يأكلون «[Note: It is permissible for the clause to be a ḥāl of the third-person pronoun in (يزكّيهم).]».

* Morphology:
(يشترون), it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the yāʾ, the lām (third radical) of the verb, was deleted after being made vowelless, because of the meeting of two vowelless letters. Its pattern is يفتعون.
(بطون), plural of بطن, which is a primitive (jāmid) noun for the inside of everything; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.. Originally the word is a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb بطن يبطن, of the class of نصر.. then it was used as a primitive noun.

* Rhetoric:
1- «أُولئِكَ ما يَأْكُلُونَ فِي بُطُونِهِمْ إِلَّا النَّارَ»: because they ate what is bound up with the Fire — namely bribes — since the Fire is a punishment for it. So in the verse there is a representative metaphor (istiʿāra tamthīliyya), in that the state resulting from their eating what is bound up with the Fire is likened to the state abstracted from their eating the Fire, in respect of what follows from the eating of each of them: the tearing of the bowels and pain, and what follows from the other. So the expression for the thing likened to was used for the thing likened.
2- «وَلا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ» is an expression of His immense anger against them, and an allusion (taʿrīḍ) to their deprivation of the sublime kinds of honours and nearness made available to the believers.

* Benefits:
1- ما يَأْكُلُونَ فِي بُطُونِهِمْ إِلَّا النَّارَ..
This form is not counted as exception proper, since there is no thing excepted from (mustathnā minhu). For this reason «إلا» is cancelled, and what follows it is parsed according to its position in the speech, «nominative, accusative or genitive», as though «إلّا» did not exist. This is the emptied exception (al-istithnāʾ al-mufarragh), because what precedes إلّا is emptied for the governing effect on what follows.
Emptying is permissible for all the governed elements except «the mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment), the absolute object (maṣdar) emphasising its governor, and likewise the ḥāl emphasising its governor: so one does not say: سرت إلا والأشجار, etc..

safi-cedvel:175-175.t:
* I'rab:
(أولاء) a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (الذين) a relative noun, khabar (predicate); (اشتروا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الضلالة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (بالهدى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اشتروا), since it is made to include the meaning of استبدلوا (they exchanged), and the sign of the genitive is the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الواو) conjunction; (العذاب) mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being اشتروا; (بالمغفرة) like بالهدى, attached to the omitted verb; (الفاء) resumptive; (ما) of wonder (taʿajjubiyya), a complete indefinite noun meaning "a thing", in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ «[Note: This is the clearest of the parsings.. and there are other opinions mentioned by al-Farrāʾ, al-Akhfash and al-ʿUkbarī containing much interpretation for which there is no need.. The wonder here is informing about their state, that it ought to be wondered at..]», (أصبر) a rigid (jāmid) past verb for expressing wonder, indeclinable on the fatḥa, and (هم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a pronoun necessarily latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هو), referring to ما; (على النار) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أصبر).
The rigidity of the verb does not prevent attachment (taʿlīq) because it is an incidental rigidity.
The clause «أولئك الذين اشتروا ...» is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of (إن) «[Note: In the previous verse.. and it is permissible to cut it off as an explicative resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), in which case it has no grammatical position.]».
The clause «اشتروا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The implied clause «(اشتروا)» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the mentioned clause اشتروا.
The clause «ما أصبرهم..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «أصبرهم» is in the position of nominative as khabar of (ما).

* Morphology:
(المغفرة), a mīmī maṣdar (verbal noun) from غفر يغفر, of the class of ضرب, or a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar of it. There are other maṣdars of the verb: غفر with fatḥa then sukūn; غفير with fatḥa on the ghayn; غفيرة; غفران with ḍamma on the ghayn; and غفور with ḍamma on the ghayn and the fāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
1- «أُولئِكَ الَّذِينَ اشْتَرَوُا», with respect to this world, «الضلالة», which is certainly not something that can be bought, «بالهدى», which is not of the kind of thing given in exchange for anything, however great; and «العذاب», i.e. they bought, with respect to the Hereafter, the punishment, which cannot be imagined to be something bought, «بالمغفرة», in which the competitors compete. This is of the kind of the explicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya).
2- Contrast (al-muqābala): in the antithesis (al-muṭābaqa) between الضلالة and الهدى, and between العذاب and المغفرة.
Contrast is an art of subtle path that only one expert in the styles of speech treads; otherwise it would be a detestable affectation.

* Benefits:
2- His saying, Exalted is He: فَما أَصْبَرَهُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ: «اصبر is on the pattern افعل, and it is one of the two forms of wonder (taʿajjub)», «ما افعله and افعل به». The grammarians have defined wonder as «an inner feeling by which the soul is affected when it deems great a rare matter that has no equal, whose reality is unknown or whose cause is hidden». The i'rab of the first form of wonder: «ما» is a complete indefinite noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and أصبر is a past verb whose fāʿil is a necessarily latent pronoun, «and هم» is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ «ما». The i'rab of the second, افعل به: افعل is a past verb that came in the form of the imperative to express wonder, and it is indeclinable on a fatḥa implied on its end, whose appearance is prevented by the sukūn required by the imperative form. The bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and the hāʾ is the fāʿil; it is genitive in form and nominative in position because it is the fāʿil, «i.e. an attached pronoun, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of nominative as fāʿil».
Al-Zamakhsharī has a different opinion: he holds that the hāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and that the fāʿil is a necessarily latent pronoun, its implied form being أنت (you). You may choose, for both are good.

safi-cedvel:176-176.t:
* I'rab:
(ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the reference is to their eating the Fire because of their concealing what Allah sent down; (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (الباء) a preposition; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of anna, accusative; (نزّل) a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (الكتاب) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (بالحقّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الكتاب.
The interpreted maṣdar formed from أنّ, its noun and its khabar is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (ذا).
(الواو) resumptive; (إنّ) like أنّ; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as the noun of inna; (اختلفوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (في الكتاب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اختلفوا), (اللام) it is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), conveying emphasis; (في شقاق) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of inna; (بعيد) naʿt (adjective) of شقاق, genitive like it.
The clause «ذلك بأنّ الله ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «نزّل ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of anna.
The clause «إنّ الذين اختلفوا..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «اختلفوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).

* Morphology:
(بعيد), an adjective resembling the active participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from بعد يبعد, of the class of كرم and the class of فرح; its pattern is فعيل. Its plural is بعداء, with ḍamma on the bāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn; بعد, with two ḍammas; and بعدان, with ḍamma on the bāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:84-84.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (إذا أخذنا ميثاقكم) [Translator's note: so in the source; the verse reads وإذ]: the i'rab of its counterpart has passed in the previous verse. (لا): negating. (تسفكون): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (دماء): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (كم): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (لا تخرجون أنفسكم): like لا تسفكون دماءكم. (من ديار): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تخرجون), and (كم): muḍāf ilayhi. (ثمّ): conjunction. (أقررتم): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (تم): an attached pronoun in the position of nominative, fāʿil. (الواو): of the ḥāl (circumstantial). (أنتم): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject). (تشهدون): like تسفكون.
The clause «أخذنا ... » is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لا تسفكون ... » has no grammatical position: the answer to an oath, for taking the covenant is an oath [Note: See footnote (1) in the i'rab of the clauses of verse (83). Al-Jalāl made it the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) of an implied saying, its implied form being "We said".].
The clause «لا تخرجون ... » has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause لا تسفكون.
The clause «أقررتم» has no grammatical position: conjoined to an omitted resumptive clause, i.e. "you understood, then you affirmed".
The clause «أنتم تشهدون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «تشهدون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ أنتم.

* Morphology:
(دياركم): plural of دار; the alif in دار is converted from a wāw, so its plural is also دور. Accordingly, the yāʾ in ديار is converted from a wāw; its origin is دوار, with kasra on the dāl: the wāw came as the ʿayn in a broken plural with a sound lām, preceded by a kasra, and it is weakened (muʿalla) in the singular.

safi-cedvel:85-85.t:
* I'rab:
(ثمّ): conjunction. (أنتم): a pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). (ها): a particle of alerting (tanbīh). (أولاء): a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of nominative, khabar (predicate), with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "you are like these" [Note: Or in the position of accusative as the one addressed (munādā) by an omitted vocative particle!, the clause تقتلون being the khabar of (أنتم), and the vocative clause being parenthetical.
The following is found in the book al-Baḥr al-Muḥīṭ of Ibn Ḥayyān [Translator's note: so in the source; the author is Abū Ḥayyān]:
Those who do i'rab differed over the i'rab of this clause. The preferred view is that (أنتم) is the mubtadaʾ, هؤلاء the khabar, and تقتلون a ḥāl (circumstantial). The Arabs have said: ها أنت ذا قائما.. The pronoun was given a demonstrative as its khabar only in wording, as though he said "you are present", while what is intended in terms of meaning is to inform about the state. What indicates that the clause is a ḥāl is their bringing the single noun accusative as a ḥāl..], (تقتلون): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (أنفس): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (كم): muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (تخرجون): like تقتلون. (فريقا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (من): a preposition, and (كم): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (فريقا), (من ديار): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تخرجون), and (هم): muḍāf ilayhi. (تظاهرون): an imperfect verb, nominative, from which the tāʾ has been dropped ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (على): a preposition, and (هم): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تظاهرون), (بالإثم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil in (تظاهرون), i.e. "you back one another against them with your allies while you are clothed in sin and aggression". (العدوان): conjoined by the wāw to الإثم, genitive like it, (الواو): conjunction. (إن): a jussive conditional particle. (يأتوا): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (كم): an attached pronoun in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi. (أسارى): a ḥāl, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (تفادوا): an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (هم): an attached pronoun in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi.
(الواو): of the ḥāl. (هو): the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ [Note: The pronoun may refer back to the expulsion understood from His saying يخرجون; so it is a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is محرّم, and (إخراج) becomes a badal (substitute) of the pronoun in محرّم.], (محرّم): a fronted khabar, nominative [Note: Or it is a mubtadaʾ, and إخراج is a nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) standing in place of the khabar.], (على): a preposition, and (كم): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (محرم), (إخراج): a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (هم): an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «أنتم هؤلاء» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أقررتم in the previous verse.
The clause «تقتلون ... » is in the position of nominative as a second khabar [Note: It may be a ḥāl, the governor in it being the meaning of likening in our saying "like these".]. The clause «تخرجون ... » is conjoined to the clause تقتلون ... and follows it in position.
The clause «تظاهرون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of تخرجون.
The clause «يأتوكم ... » is in the position of nominative — or accusative — conjoined to the clause تقتلون.
The clause «تفادوهم» has no grammatical position: the answer of a jussive condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «هو محرّم ... » is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl [Note: Or it is conjoined by the wāw to the ḥāl clause تظاهرون عليهم, and the conditional clause becomes parenthetical, because it is between two conjoined elements.].
(الهمزة): for the interrogative of disavowal and rebuke (istifhām inkārī tawbīkhī), and (الفاء): a conjunction — or resumptive —. (تؤمنون): like تقتلون, (ببعض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تؤمنون), (الكتاب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو): conjunction. (تكفرون): like تقتلون. (ببعض): like the first, attached to (تكفرون), (الفاء): resumptive. (ما): negating [Note: Or an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is جزاء, and خزي is a badal of جزاء.], (جزاء): mubtadaʾ, nominative. (من): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, muḍāf ilayhi. (يفعل): an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (ذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi, and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address. (من): a preposition, and (كم): an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of يفعل. (إلّا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). (خزي): khabar, nominative, of the mubtadaʾ جزاء. (في الحياة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خزي), (الدنيا): a naʿt of (الحياة), genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the alif. (الواو): resumptive. (يوم): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يردّون), (القيامة): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (يردّون): a passive imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil. (الى أشدّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يردّون), (العذاب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو): resumptive. (ما): negating, operating as laysa does. (الله): the Name of Majesty, the ism of mā, nominative. (الباء): a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (غافل): a noun genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of mā. (عن): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun [Note: Or a maṣdarī particle, or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective (nakira mawṣūfa).], indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (غافل), (تعملون): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «تؤمنون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to something implied, its implied form being "do you do that".. or it has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تكفرون» is conjoined to the clause تؤمنون.
The clause «ما جزاء ... » has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يفعل ذلك» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «يردّون» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ما الله بغافل» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(تظاهرون): one of the two tāʾs has been dropped from it for lightening, and there is disagreement over which of them this happened to.
(الإثم): a noun for that by which its doer deserves blame and reproach, or for that from which the soul recoils. الإثم may be a maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb أثم يأثم, paradigm فرح; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.
(العدوان): a samāʿī (heard) maṣdar of the verb عدا يعدو, paradigm نصر; its pattern is فعلان, with ḍamma on the fāʾ, and the fāʾ may take kasra. There are other maṣdars of the verb: عدو with fatḥa or ḍamma on the ʿayn and sukūn on the dāl, and عداء with fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(أسارى): plural of أسير — it may be the plural of أسرى, which is the plural of أسير — and أسير is فعيل in the sense of مفعول; its verb is أسر يأسر, paradigm ضرب.
(تفادوهم): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change); its origin is تفاديوهم with ḍamma on the yāʾ. The ḍamma on the yāʾ was found heavy and was transferred to the dāl; when two sukūns came together, the yāʾ and the wāw, the yāʾ was deleted. So it is iʿlāl by vowel-removal (taskīn) and iʿlāl by deletion.. Its pattern is تفاعوهم.
(محرّم): a passive participle of the quadriliteral verb حرّم, on the measure of its passive imperfect, by replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm with ḍamma.
(إخراج): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb أخرج; its pattern is إفعال.
(الكتاب): a primitive (jāmid) noun, by which the Torah is meant; its pattern is فعال, with kasra on the fāʾ. See verse (2) of this sūra.
(جزاء): a samāʿī maṣdar of the verb جزى يجزي, paradigm ضرب; its pattern is فعال, with fatḥa on the fāʾ. It involves the conversion of the weak letter into a hamza; its origin is جزاي: the yāʾ came at the end after an alif with sukūn, so it was converted to a hamza.
(خزي): a samāʿī maṣdar of the verb خزي يخزى [Translator's note: the source prints يخزي], paradigm فرح; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn. There is another maṣdar, خزي, whose pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.
(الحياة): a samāʿī maṣdar of the verb حيي يحيى, paradigm فرح; its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa on the fāʾ, the ʿayn and the lām. It contains iʿlāl by conversion; its origin is حيية: the second yāʾ came voweled after a fatḥa, so it was converted to an alif.
(الدنيا): a derived adjective; its pattern is فعلى, with ḍamma on the fāʾ, the feminine of the elative (ism tafḍīl) أدنى. The lām of the word came as a wāw in فعلى, and its verb is دنا يدنو, paradigm نصر [Note: See al-Naḥw al-Wāfī, vol. 4, p. 588.]. The alif in دنيا is written as the tall alif because what precedes it is a yāʾ. Here it is necessarily feminine because it has the article (ال), as an adjective of (الحياة).
(القيامة): the name of the Day of Resurrection; it is on the measure of a maṣdar ending in tāʾ marbūṭa, i.e. فعالة with kasra on the fāʾ. It contains iʿlāl by conversion; its origin is قوامة: the wāw was converted to yāʾ because the word is a maṣdar used as a noun, and the wāw is weakened in the verb [Note: See al-Naḥw al-Wāfī, vol. 4, p. 586.].

safi-cedvel:227-227.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction; (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle; (عزموا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الطلاق) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) [Note: The verb عزم takes its object directly or through the preposition على; one says عزم الأمر and عزم على الأمر, so there is no need to parse الطلاق as accusative by removal of the preposition, as is found in the Ḥāshiya of al-Jamal.]; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إنّ الله سميع عليم) the i'rab of its counterpart إنّ الله غفور رحيم in the preceding ayah has already been given, and this is like it in its words and its clauses.
The clause «عزموا الطلاق» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause فاءوا in the preceding ayah.

* Morphology:
(الطلاق): a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar), because its verb is طلّق on the pattern فعّل, and its regular maṣdar would be التطليق.

safi-cedvel:228-228.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction; (المطلّقات) a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (يتربّصن) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of nominative.. and (النون) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (بأنفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يتربّصن); (هنّ) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (ثلاثة) an adverb of time, mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), attached to (يتربّصن); (قروء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الواو) a conjunction; (لا) negating; (يحلّ) an imperfect verb, nominative; (اللام) a preposition and (هنّ) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يحلّ); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive-governing particle; (يكتمن) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative by (أن), and (النون) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يكتمن) is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of يحلّ.
(ما) a relative noun [Note: That is, they conceal the creation of the child.. It is also permissible that "what was created" be menstrual blood, in which case (ما) is an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, in the position of accusative, and the clause after it is its adjective.], indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (خلق) a past verb; (الله) the word of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (في أرحام) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خلق); (هنّ) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle; (كن) a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters), indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (النون) the nūn of the feminine plural, the fāʿil [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere the subject of a defective verb is called its ism]; (يؤمنّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable, in the position of nominative.. and (النون) the fāʿil; (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤمن); (الواو) a conjunction; (اليوم) conjoined to the word of Majesty, genitive like it; (الآخر) a naʿt (adjective) of اليوم, genitive like it; (الواو) a conjunction; (بعولة) a mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (هنّ) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أحقّ) a khabar (predicate), nominative; (بردّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أحقّ); (هن) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (في) a preposition; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (أحقّ) [Note: This is if the reference is to the waiting period (ʿidda), i.e. he is entitled to take her back as long as she is in the ʿidda..
Attachment to ردّ is permissible if the reference is to the marriage.], and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (إن) like the first; (أرادوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of jussive ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (إصلاحا) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) a conjunction; (اللام) a preposition and (هنّ) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (مثل) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative [Note: It is a naʿt of an omitted qualified noun, i.e.: and they have good companionship by what is right, like that which is upon them of obligations.]; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (عليهنّ) like لهنّ, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause), i.e. الذي يوجد عليهن; (بالمعروف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of مثل, because it does not become definite by annexation owing to its deep indefiniteness [Note: Or attached to the notion of "being established", which is the omitted khabar.]; (الواو) a conjunction; (للرجال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (عليهنّ) like لهنّ, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of درجة; (درجة) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the word of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (عزيز) a khabar, nominative; (حكيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «المطلّقات يتربّصن» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause للذين يؤلون or to the clause فاءوا in the preceding ayahs.
The clause «يتربّصن» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of المطلّقات.
The clause «لا يحلّ لهنّ» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause المطلّقات يتربّصن.
The clause «يكتمن» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «خلق الله» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «كنّ يؤمنّ» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical, and the apodosis is omitted.
The clause «يؤمنّ ... is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كنّ.
The clause «بعولتهنّ أحقّ has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause المطلّقات يتربّصن.
The clause «أرادوا إصلاحا» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical.. and the apodosis clause is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. if their husbands want reconciliation, then they have more right to take them back.
The clause «لهنّ مثل الذي ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause المطلّقات ...
The clause «للرجال عليهنّ درجة» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause المطلّقات..
The clause «الله عزيز» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(المطلّقات): plural of المطلّقة, which is a passive participle to which the tāʾ has been attached, on the pattern مفعّلة with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(قروء): plural of قرء, with ḍamma or fatḥa on the qāf. In al-Miṣbāḥ: القرء has two dialectal forms: with fatḥa, whose plural is قروء and أقرؤ, like فلس, فلوس and أفلس; and with ḍamma, whose plural is أقراء, like قفل and أقفال.
(أرحام): plural of رحم, a noun for the place where the sperm-drop is formed; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then kasra.
(بعولتهنّ): plural of بعل, and the tāʾ is for the feminine of the plural; it may also be a maṣdar with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. the people of their marriage. In al-Miṣbāḥ: البعل is the husband; one says بعل يبعل (category قتل) بعولة when he marries, and the woman is (also) بعل; one may say of her بعلة with the hāʾ, just as one says زوجة, to make the feminine explicit; the plural is البعولة. In al-Qāmūs, البعل has the plurals بعال and بعول, and it has بعل of the category منع.
(أحقّ): an elative noun (ism tafḍīl) on the pattern أفعل, from حقّ يحقّ (category ضرب).
(درجة): a noun from درج يدرج (category فرح); its pattern is فعلة with two fatḥas.
(مثل): a derived adjective from the verb مثل يمثل فلانا (category نصر).. its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn; it is an adjective resembling the active participle (ṣifa mushabbaha), because it means مماثل (similar). It qualifies the masculine, the feminine, the dual and the plural; one says: هو وهي وهما وهم وهنّ مثله, and one also says هم أمثالهم.

safi-cedvel:148-148.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (لكلّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). (وجهة): delayed mubtadaʾ (subject). (هو): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (مولّي): khabar, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ, and (ها) muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct). (الفاء): for linking the effect to the cause. (استبقوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma;
the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الخيرات): accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "إلى الخيرات", the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (أينما): a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to the complete (tāmm) (تكونوا) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted khabar of (تكونوا) if it is defective, the wāw being the noun (ism) of تكونوا.]»
or to (يأت). (تكونوا): a complete imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. (يأت): an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the weak letter. (الباء): a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يأت). (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (جميعا): ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb). (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb (of inna and its sisters), for emphasis. (الله): the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative. (على كلّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قدير. (شيء): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (قدير): the khabar of inna, nominative.
The clause «لكلّ وجهة ... » has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «هو مولّيها» is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of وجهة.
The clause «استبقوا الخيرات» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive one «[Note: This is permissible for those who allow conjoining a performative (inshāʾ) clause to an informative (khabar) one or the reverse.. For those who do not allow that, it is the apodosis of an implied condition.]».
The clause «تكونوا» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يأت بكم الله» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a jussive-governing condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إنّ الله ... قدير» has no grammatical position: giving the reason (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(وجهة): either it is a noun for the place faced, like the Kaʿba, in which case keeping the wāw is regular, because it is not a maṣdar; or it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) from وجه يجه of the pattern-class of ضرب, in which case keeping the wāw is anomalous (shādhdh), since the rule is to drop it, as in عدة and صلة (verse 112).
(مولّي): an active participle from the quadriliteral ولّى يولّي; it is on the pattern مفعّل with a ḍamma on the mīm and a kasra on the ʿayn.
(الخيرات): plural of الخيرة, on the pattern فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn, a noun meaning "those abounding in good"; it may be lightened from a doubled form, and its pattern then is فيعلة.
(يأت): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion on account of the jussive; its pattern is يفع (see verse 106 of this sūra).

* Benefits:
- فاستبقوا: the fāʾ is the elucidating fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), because it discloses an implied condition in whose apodosis it occurs. الخيرات has been put in the accusative after the dropping of the preposition, and it is accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural.

safi-cedvel:149-149.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (من): a preposition. (حيث): a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ولّ).. If it is taken to include the sense of condition, it may be attached to (خرجت). (خرج): a past verb; (التاء) is a pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent) «[Note: It is in the position of jussive if (حيث) is conditional.]». (الفاء): redundant (zāʾida), to link what precedes it with what follows it «[Note: Or it is connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) if (حيث) is made conditional, and the clause is then in the position of jussive.]». (ول): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the weak letter; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (وجه): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct). (شطر): an adverb of place, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of accusative, attached to (ولّ) «[Note: Or it is a second mafʿūl bihi, accusative — contrary to al-Shinqīṭī in al-Durar al-Lawāmiʿ, for whom (شطر) is among the non-inflecting (ghayr mutaṣarrifa) adverbs.]». (المسجد): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (الحرام): a naʿt (adjective) of المسجد, genitive like it. (الواو): of the ḥāl (circumstantial). (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb (of inna and its sisters), and (الهاء) the noun (ism) of inna. (اللام): the shifted lām (al-muzaḥlaqa), giving emphasis. (الحقّ): khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ). (من ربّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of الحقّ, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): resumptive. (ما الله بغافل عمّا تعملون): the i'rab of its counterpart, words and clauses, has already passed (verse 144 of this sūra).
The clause «خرجت» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ولّ» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) by the wāw to a resumptive clause, implied or mentioned «[Note: I.e. "so do what you have been commanded, and turn your face.. from wherever you go out".]». The clause «إنّه للحقّ من ربّك» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

* Morphology:
(حيث): an adverbial noun of place; it is mostly indeclinable on ḍamma, and it may be indeclinable on kasra or fatḥa.

* Benefits:
1- «للحقّ»: this lām is the shifted lām (lām al-muzaḥlaqa); it has moved from the beginning of the mubtadaʾ (subject) to the beginning of the khabar, and the reason for that has already been given.
1- The clause «خرجت» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; it has already been stated that every clause that comes after an adverb is in the position of genitive by annexation.

safi-cedvel:150-150.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (من حيث خرجت ... المسجد الحرام): its i'rab has passed in the previous verse. (الواو): conjunction. (حيثما كنتم ... شطره): its i'rab, words and clauses, has passed «[Note: In verse (144) of this sūra.]». (اللام): of purpose (taʿlīl). (أن): a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative. (لا): negative. (يكون): a defective imperfect verb (of kāna and its sisters), accusative (manṣūb). (للناس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of يكون. (على): a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of حجّة — an adjective placed before the thing qualified. (حجّة): the delayed noun (ism) of يكون, nominative (marfūʿ).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن لا يكون..) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (ولّوا) «[Note: It may be attached to an omitted element.. the implied form being "We did that so that … not …".]».
(إلا): a particle of exception. (الذين): a relative noun in the position of accusative as the excepted «[Note: With an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "except the speech of those who did wrong". It may also be a badal (substitute) of الناس, in the position of genitive.. Ibn Hishām makes the exception disjoined (munqaṭiʿ), so (إلا) means "لكن" and (الذين) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "they have the false argument" or "the false disputation".]». (ظلموا): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (من): a preposition, and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of ظلموا. (الفاء): connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. (لا): prohibitive, jussive-governing. (تخشوا): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and (هم) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الواو): conjunction. (اخشوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn;
the wāw is the fāʿil, (النون) is for protection (al-wiqāya), and (الياء) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (الواو): conjunction. (اللام): of purpose. (أتمّ): an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed (أن) after the lām; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنا". (نعمة): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct). (على): a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أتمّ) — or to a ḥāl of نعمتي.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن أتمّ) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to the verb ولّوا by being conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar (لئلا يكون ...).
(الواو): resumptive. (لعل): a particle resembling the verb, expressing hope. (وكم) «[Translator's note: so in the source; the pronoun meant is (كم).]»: an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of laʿalla. (تهتدون): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «يكون للناس.. حجة» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī). The clause «ظلموا» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين).
The clause «تخشوهم» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if they are like that, then do not fear them".
The clause «اخشوني» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause تخشوهم.
The clause «أتمّ..» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative.
The clause لعلّكم تهتدون has no grammatical position: resumptive, and it is linked in meaning with the preceding statement of purpose ...
The clause تهتدون is in the position of nominative as the khabar of laʿalla.

* Morphology:
(حجّة): the noun from حجّه يحجّه of the pattern-class of نصر; its pattern is فعلة with ḍamma then sukūn.
(تخشوهم): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the alif was dropped from the end of the verb because it came with sukūn before the wāw of the plural, which also has sukūn; then the shīn was given a fatḥa to indicate the dropped alif. Its pattern is تفعوهم.
(اخشوني): it contains iʿlāl by deletion, running along the lines of تخشوهم.

safi-cedvel:151-151.t:
* I'rab:
(الكاف): a preposition and particle of comparison «[Note: The kāf may be a noun meaning "مثل", in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar of the verb أتمّ, i.e. "أتمّ نعمتي إتماما مثل إرسالنا رسولا منكم".]». (ما): maṣdar-forming. (أرسلنا): a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn; (نا) is the fāʿil (agent).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أرسلنا) is in the position of genitive by the kāf, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq governed by أتمّ, i.e. "أتمّ نعمتي إتماما كإرسالنا فيكم رسولا منكم".
(في): a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أرسلنا). (رسولا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (منكم): like فيكم, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (رسولا). (يتلو): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (عليكم): like the first, attached to (يتلو). (آيات): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra, and (نا) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct). (الواو): conjunction. (يزكّي): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being an implied ḍamma; the fāʿil is "هو", and (كم) the mafʿūl bihi. (الواو): conjunction. (يعلّمكم): like يزكّيكم. (الكتاب): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الحكمة): conjoined (maʿṭūf) by the wāw to الكتاب, accusative like it. (الواو): conjunction. (يعلّمكم): like يزكّيكم. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as second mafʿūl bihi. (لم): a particle of negation, of conversion (to the past) and of the jussive. (تكونوا): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the noun (ism) of takūnu. (تعلمون): an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «أرسلنا» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī).
The clause «يتلو ... » is in the position of accusative as a second naʿt of (رسولا) «[Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (رسولا), because it is qualified.]».
The clause «يزكّيكم» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause يتلو.
The clause «يعلّمكم» (the first) is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause يتلو.
The clause «يعلّمكم» (the second) is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the first clause يعلمكم.
The clause تكونوا has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of (ما).
The clause تعلمون is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of تكونوا.

safi-cedvel:152-152.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء): giving the reason (taʿlīliyya), or connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. (اذكروا): an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (اذكر): an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the command, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنا". (الواو): conjunction. (اشكروا): like اذكروا. (اللام): a preposition, and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اشكروا). (الواو): conjunction. (لا): prohibitive, jussive-governing. (تكفروا): an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the mentioned (النون) is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the omitted (الياء) is the mafʿūl bihi.. In the speech there is an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "لا تكفروا نعمتي".
The clause «اذكروني» has no grammatical position: giving the reason, resumptive «[Note: Or it is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if I offer you these blessings, then remember Me".]».
The clause «أذكركم» has no grammatical position: the apodosis of a condition implied from the preceding command, not joined with the fāʾ, i.e. "إن تذكروني أذكركم".
The clause «اشكروا» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause اذكروني.
The clause «لا تكفرون» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause اشكروا.

* Benefits:
فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ confirmed this meaning
with the ḥadīth qudsī which says: Allah the Exalted says: «Whoever remembers Me within himself, I remember him within Myself; and whoever remembers Me in a gathering, I remember him in a gathering better than it».

safi-cedvel:197-197.t:
* I'rab:
(الحجّ) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) [Note: This is on the basis of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "the months of the Hajj are known months."], (أشهر) khabar (predicate), nominative [Note: It may be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "its time is months", and that clause is the khabar of الحجّ without assuming an omitted muḍāf.], (معلومات) naʿt (adjective) of أشهر, nominative like it; (الفاء) conjunction; (من) a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (فرض) past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he), i.e. "he made it obligatory upon himself"; (في) preposition and (هنّ) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (فرض); (الحجّ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) the lā of generic negation; (رفث) the noun of lā, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (لا فسوق) like لا رفث, and likewise (لا جدال); (في الحجّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of لا جدال [Note: The khabar of the first and second (لا) is omitted, i.e. "so no obscenity in the Hajj and no wickedness in the Hajj", and that was dispensed with by the khabar of the last one.]; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, its governor being (تفعلوا), which is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (من خير) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ما, and (من) here is explicative (bayāniyya) [Note: There are other possible attachments, mentioned in detail in the i'rab of ayah (106) of this sūra.]; (يعلم) imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (الواو) resumptive; (تزوّدوا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and the mafʿūl bihi is omitted, its implied form being: "what will bring you to the end of your journey"; (الفاء) causal (taʿlīliyya); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (خير) the noun of inna, accusative; (الزاد) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (التقوى) the khabar of inna, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (الواو) conjunction; (اتّقوا) like تزوّدوا, and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء), which is dropped for lightening, is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; its original form is اتّقوني; (يا) vocative particle; (أولي) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ, for it is attached (mulḥaq) to the sound masculine plural; (الألباب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «الحجّ أشهر» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «من فرض فيهنّ» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «فرض فيهنّ ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: It is possible that the khabar is the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «لا رفث.» in the Hajj is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined to the fāʾ [Note: The two clauses "no wickedness in the Hajj" and "no disputing in the Hajj" are conjoined to the apodosis clause.].
The clause «تفعلوا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause من فرض فيهنّ.
The clause «يعلمه الله» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined to the fāʾ.
The clause «تزوّدوا» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «إنّ خير الزاد التقوى» has a position, being causal. [Translator's note: The source reads «محلّ لها تعليليّة» ("has a position, causal"); by the book's usual pattern «لا محلّ لها» ("has no grammatical position") seems intended.]
The clause اتّقون has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause تزوّدوا.
The vocative clause «يا أولي الألباب» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(معلومات): plural of معلومة, the feminine of معلوم, a passive participle from علم يعلم, of the pattern (bāb) فرح; its pattern (wazn) is مفعول.
(فسوق): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb فسق يفسق, of the patterns نصر, ضرب and كرم; its wazn is فعول with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(جدال): an aurally transmitted maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb جادل; its wazn is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ; the regular (qiyāsī) one is المجادلة.
(الزاد): a maṣdar meaning التزوّد, or it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the five-letter verb تزوّد; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; it is also a name for travel provisions.
(التقوى): it is an ism maṣdar from the verb اتّقى; in it the first radical (fāʾ) was changed to tāʾ because it came before the tāʾ of the iftiʿāl form in the verb اتّقى, its original being أو تقى [Translator's note: so in the source; presumably اوتقى (i.e. اِوْتَقَى) is meant.]; the change remained in التقوى, whose original is الوقيا, then the yāʾ was changed to wāw in the noun to distinguish it from the adjective, which is التقيّ.
(أولي): the wāw is extra, written but not pronounced; it is attached (mulḥaq) to the sound masculine plural.

* Rhetoric:
1- His saying «فِي الْحَجِّ», i.e. in its days: using the overt noun where a pronoun would be expected is to show the perfection of care for its matter and to signal the reason for the ruling, for visiting the Mighty House and drawing near through it to Allah the Mighty and Majestic is among the things that require abandoning the matters mentioned. Preferring negation is for intensifying the prohibition and indicating that this deserves not to exist at all, for whatever is objectionable and repugnant in itself is even more repugnant in the course of the Hajj, like wearing silk in prayer and singing melodiously in reciting the Qur'an, because it is a departure from what nature and habit require into pure worship.
2- «فَإِنَّ خَيْرَ الزَّادِ التَّقْوى», i.e. take «التقوى» (God-consciousness) as your provision for your return, for it is the best provision; the speech has been expressed contrary to what the apparent context requires, for intensification. It is an eloquent simile (tashbīh balīgh) for التقوى.
3- «وَاتَّقُونِ يا أُولِي الْأَلْبابِ»: He commanded them to free themselves of everything other than Him, and that is what reason stripped of the impurities of desire requires; therefore the people of understanding (أولو الألباب) were singled out with this address, even though the command to taqwā is not specific to the people of understanding alone, because every human being is commanded to have taqwā. This is what is called iṭnāb (amplification), which is mentioning the specific after the general to draw attention to the merit of the specific over the general.
4- The Qur'an has used «الألباب» in the plural and did not bring it in the singular, because it is among the words whose plural is sweet (sounding).

* Benefits:
1- In this ayah the Exalted directs us to hold fast to the etiquette of the Hajj, forbidding us to speak of what takes place between a woman and her husband in the hour of privacy, which is not fitting to mention before people, just as He forbids us wickedness (الفسوق), which is everything that takes a person out of the fold of religion. Among the subtle characteristics of Arabic is that fāʾ and sīn at the beginning of a verb often indicate aversion and repugnance; الفسل is the despicable matter.
Al-Farazdaq says:
فلا تقبلوا منهم أباعر تشترى ... بوكس ولا سودا تصحّ فسولها
(Do not accept from them camels bought at a loss, nor black ones whose worthless ones are sound.)
2- The Exalted often concludes ayahs by praising people of intellect and urging the liberation of the mind and its use, far from errors and superstitions and from what the Bedouins of the Jāhiliyya were upon; among that is His saying: وَاتَّقُونِ يا أُولِي الْأَلْبابِ، إِنَّ فِي ذلِكَ لَآياتٍ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ، لِقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ، لِأُولِي النُّهى, and similarly the denunciation of whoever does not use his thought and reason:
«وَلَقَدْ ذَرَأْنا لِجَهَنَّمَ كَثِيراً مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ لا يَفْقَهُونَ بِها وَلَهُمْ أَعْيُنٌ لا يُبْصِرُونَ بِها، وَلَهُمْ آذانٌ لا يَسْمَعُونَ بِها أُولئِكَ كَالْأَنْعامِ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ أُولئِكَ هُمُ الْغافِلُونَ.
Perhaps in this orientation lies the vitality of religion and its responsiveness to the necessities of development, for whoever has a heart or gives ear while he is present.

safi-cedvel:115-115.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (لله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). (المشرق): postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ). (المغرب): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to المشرق by the wāw, nominative like it. (الفاء): conjunction, linking the effect to the cause. (أينما): a conditional noun causing the jussive, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to the apodosis «[Note: It may be attached to the protasis.]». (تولّوا): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (الفاء): connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (ثمّ): an adverb of place, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. (وجه): postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb. (الله): the Name of Majesty, the noun of إن, accusative (manṣūb). (واسع): khabar, nominative. (عليم): a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «لله المشرق»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «تولوا»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «ثمّ وجه الله»: in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إنّ الله واسع»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(المشرق): a noun of place from شرق, of the pattern-class نصر; its pattern is مفعل with kasra on the second radical, contrary to the rule, since by rule the second radical takes fatḥa, because its second radical has ḍamma in the imperfect.
(المغرب): a noun of place from غرب, of the pattern-class نصر; it is like المشرق in departing from the rule.
(تولّوا): it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by deletion. Its origin is تولاوا; two quiescent letters met, so the alif was deleted and the fatḥa remained on the lām before it as an indication of it, so it became تولّوا. Its pattern is تفعّوا with fatḥa on the second radical.
(ثمّ): a noun used to point to what is far, meaning "there"; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn, and its second and third radicals are the same letter. Like it is ثمّة.
(وجه): a noun for the well-known body part ("face"); it is used in the verse by way of metaphor. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(واسع): active participle of وسع يسع, of the pattern-class فرح; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:116-116.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (قالوا): a verb and its fāʿil (agent). (اتّخذ): past verb. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). (ولدا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) — it is the second object; as for the first, it is omitted, its implied form being "some of His creatures". (سبحان): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, accusative, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (بل): a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and of beginning. (اللام): a preposition. (الهاء): a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). (في السموات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما. (الأرض): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السموات by the wāw, genitive like it. (كلّ): mubtadaʾ, nominative «[Note: What made its parsing as a mubtadaʾ permissible, though it is indefinite, is that it indicates generality; and it is on the deletion of a muḍāf, i.e., "everything that Allah created".]». (له): like the first, attached to (قانتون), which is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw.
The clause «قالوا ...»: has no grammatical position; resumptive «[Note: Some conjoin it to the clause قالوا لن يدخل in verse (111).. and that is far-fetched..]».
The clause «اتّخذ الله ولدا»: in the position of accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «سبحانه»: has no grammatical position, being a parenthetical clause of supplication.
The clause «له ما في السموات»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «كلّ له قانتون»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(ولدا): originally it is a derived adjective from ولد يلد, of the pattern-class ضرب; then it came to be used as a noun for everyone who is born. It is applied to the male and the female, the dual and the plural. Its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas.
(قانتون): plural of قانت, the active participle of قنت; its pattern is فاعل.

* Benefits:
1- The expressions «سبحانه وتعالى» and «جل جلاله» and the like are all parenthetical clauses, and by them is intended declaring Allah free of imperfection, glorifying Him, and ...

safi-cedvel:117-117.t:
* I'rab:
(بديع): khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو". (السموات): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (الأرض): maʿṭūf (conjoined) by the wāw to السموات, genitive like it. (الواو): conjunction. (إذا): an adverb for the future including the meaning of a condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis. (قضى): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (أمرا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الفاء): connective for the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (إنّما): the restraining (kāffa) and the restrained (makfūfa). (يقول): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is "هو". (اللام): a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يقول). (كن): a complete (tāmm) imperative verb; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (الفاء): conjunction «[Note: Or it is resumptive according to some.. and Ibn Hishām rejected that.]», linking the effect to the cause. (يكون): a complete imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "هو".
The clause «(هو) بديع السموات ...»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «قضى ...»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «إنّما يقول ...»: has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «كن»: in the position of accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «يكون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو", and the nominal clause is conjoined to the clause يقول, or it is resumptive.

* Morphology:
(بديع): an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from بدع يبدع, of the pattern-class كرم; its pattern is فعيل.
(قضى): it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by conversion. Its origin is قضي, its imperfect being يقضي; when the yāʾ came voweled after a fatḥa, it was converted into an alif.
(كن): it contains a weak-letter change by deletion to suit the indeclinability on the sukūn; its origin is كون, with ḍamma on the kāf and sukūn on the wāw. Its pattern is فل.

* Rhetoric:
Representative metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya): in the saying of Allah the Exalted فَإِنَّما يَقُولُ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ, where the form of the coming-about of what is intended, after the will has attached to it, without delay, is likened to the obedience of the obedient one commanded, immediately after the command of the one obeyed, without hesitation.

safi-cedvel:118-118.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (قال): past verb. (الذين): a relative noun, fāʿil (agent). (لا): negative. (يعلمون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil. (لولا): a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ). (يكلّم): imperfect verb, nominative, and (نا) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (أو): a conjunction. (تأتي): imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and (نا) direct object. (آية): fāʿil, nominative. (كذلك قال الذين من قبلهم مثل قولهم): the i'rab of its counterpart has been given «[Note: See verse (113).]». (تشابه): past verb, and (التاء) is for the feminine. (قلوب): fāʿil, nominative, and (هم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (قد): a particle of realization. (بيّنا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and نا is the fāʿil. (الآيات): direct object, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (لقوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (بيّنا). (يوقنون): imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قال الذين ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قالوا اتّخذ «[Note: In verse (116).]».
The clause «لا يعلمون»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لولا يكلّمنا الله»: in the position of accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «تأتينا آية»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the object-of-speech clause.
The clause «قال الذين ...»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «تشابهت قلوبهم»: has no grammatical position, being resumptive or parenthetical.
The clause «قد بيّنا ...»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «يوقنون»: in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

* Morphology:
(يوقنون): see further explanation of its morphology in verse (4) of this sūra.

* Benefits:
لولا: a particle of non-occurrence because of existence; [here] its meaning is urging, like «هلّا», and it is called:
a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ)..

safi-cedvel:119-119.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ): a particle resembling the verb, and (نا) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ. (أرسلنا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, (نا) is the fāʿil (agent), and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (بالحقّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent or the object. (بشيرا): ḥāl, accusative (manṣūb), of the object. (نذيرا): maʿṭūf (conjoined) by the wāw to (بشيرا), accusative like it. (الواو): conjunction. (لا): negative. (تسأل): imperfect verb, passive, nominative (marfūʿ); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (عن أصحاب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تسأل). (الجحيم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
The clause «إنّا أرسلناك»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «أرسلناك»: in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «لا تسأل ...»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause إنّا أرسلناك.

* Morphology:
(بشيرا): an adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the verb بشر يبشر, of the pattern-classes ضرب and فرح; its pattern is فعيل.
(نذيرا): an irregular maṣdar (verbal noun) of the quadriliteral verb أنذر; it is used as adjectives are used, as a ṣifa mushabbaha meaning المنذر (with kasra on the dhāl). Its pattern is فعيل.
(الجحيم): a noun for fire that blazes fiercely. It is originally a derived adjective on the pattern فعيل meaning الجاحم, so it is one of the intensive patterns.

safi-cedvel:229-229.t:
* I'rab:
(الطلاق) a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (مرّتان) a khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the alif; (الفاء) a conjunction; (إمساك) a mubtadaʾ, nominative, and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "واجب عليكم" (incumbent upon you), and it comes before the mubtadaʾ; (بمعروف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of إمساك, or to the maṣdar (verbal noun) إمساك; (أو) a conjunction; (تسريح) conjoined to إمساك, nominative like it; (بإحسان) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an adjective of تسريح or to the maṣdar تسريح.
The clause «الطلاق مرتان» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «(عليكم) إمساك» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
(الواو) a conjunction; (لا) negating; (يحلّ) an imperfect verb, nominative; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (يحلّ); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive-governing particle; (تأخذوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (من) a preposition and (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of شيئا [Note: Or attached to (تأخذوا).]; (آتيتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn..
and (التاء) is the fāʿil, and the mīm is a particle for the masculine plural; (الواو) a redundant (zāʾida) letter for lengthening the vowel of the mīm; (هنّ) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (شيئا) a mafʿūl bihi whose governor is تأخذوا, and the second object of the verb آتيتموهنّ is omitted, its implied form being "آتيتموهنّ إيّاه".
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تأخذوا) is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of يحلّ.
(إلّا) a particle of exception; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive-governing particle; (يخافا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn, and (الألف) is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يخافا) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, with an omitted muḍāf, and the preposition with its genitive noun, in its specific, delimited sense, is excepted from the most general of states before the particle of exception [Note: The implied meaning: it is not lawful for you to take anything of what you have given them in any state whatsoever, except in the state where the two spouses fear not keeping the limits of Allah; then the taking is valid and lawful. Abū Ḥayyān makes it an "emptied" exception (istithnāʾ mufarragh), it being a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. it is not lawful for you to take for any reason whatsoever except out of fear of not keeping the limits of Allah, for that is what makes the taking permissible for you.]; (أن) like the first; (لا) negating; (يقيما) like يخافا; (حدود) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الله) the word of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا يقيما) is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi whose governor is يخافا.
The clause «لا يحلّ..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause الطلاق مرّتان.
The clause «تأخذوا..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «آتيتموهنّ» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يخافا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second particle relative (أن).
The clause «يقيما» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the third particle relative (أن).
(الفاء) resumptive; (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle; (خفتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (تم) a pronoun, the fāʿil; (ألّا يقيما حدود الله) its i'rab has already been given ...
The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا يقيما) is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl bihi whose governor is خفتم.
(الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) the lā of generic negation; (جناح) the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (عليهما) like لكم, attached to the omitted khabar of lā; (في) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted khabar [Note: (ما) may be an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, in the position of genitive, and the clause after it its adjective.]; (افتدت) a past verb, indeclinable on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns. and (التاء) the tāʾ of the feminine; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (افتدت).
The clause «خفتم» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يقيما» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the fourth particle relative (أن).
The clause «لا جناح عليهما» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «افتدت به» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما).
