(لعنة): a maṣdar (verbal noun) of single occurrence (marra) from لعن يلعن of the pattern-class of فتح; its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn (see verse 89 of this sūra).
(أجمعين): plural of أجمع, a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) on the pattern أفعل, from the verb جمع يجمع of the pattern-class of فتح.

safi-cedvel:162-162.t:
* I'rab:
(خالدين): ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), of the pronoun in (عليهم) — the previous verse — the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ. (في): a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خالدين; the pronoun refers to the curse, or to the Fire indicated by it. (لا): negative. (يخفّف): a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). (عنهم): like فيها, attached to (يخفّف). (العذاب): nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative. (الواو): conjunction. (لا): negative, repeated to emphasise the negation. (هم): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (ينظرون): a passive imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause يخفّف عنهم العذاب is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in خالدين; or it has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «هم ينظرون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause لا يخفّف عنهم العذاب.. or it has no grammatical position.
The clause «ينظرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

safi-cedvel:58-58.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb whose implied form is «اذكر» (remember); (قلنا) a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (ادخلوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذه) a demonstrative, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (القرية) a badal (substitute) of «ذه», or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of it, accusative; (الفاء) conjunction; (كلوا) like «ادخلوا».. (من) a preposition and (ها) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كلوا) , (حيث) an adverb of place, indeclinable on the ḍamma, attached to (كلوا) , (شئتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (التاء) is the fāʿil, and (الميم) a particle of the masculine plural; (رغدا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), standing in for the maṣdar, for it is its adjective, i.e. «أكلا رغدا» (a plentiful eating) «[Note: It may also be a ḥāl (circumstantial), with «هانئين» (enjoying it) implied.]» . (الواو) conjunction; (ادخلوا) its i'rab has preceded; (الباب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, (سجّدا) a ḥāl, accusative, of the fāʿil of «ادخلوا»; (الواو) conjunction; (قولوا) like «ادخلوا»; (حطّة) the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject) whose implied form is «سؤالنا» or «مسألتنا» (our request). (نغفر) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), in answer to the command (jawāb al-ṭalab), its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "we" (نحن); (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (نغفر) . (خطايا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) resumptive; (السين) for the future; (نزيد) an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "we"; (المحسنين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «قلنا ... » is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ادخلوا ... » is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «كلوا ... » is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause «ادخلوا».
The clause «شئتم» is in the position of genitive by the annexation of (حيث) to it.
The second clause «ادخلوا» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the first clause «ادخلوا».
The clause «قولوا ... » is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the second clause «ادخلوا».
The clause «(مسألتنا) حطّة» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported.
The clause «نغفر ... » has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «سنزيد المحسنين» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(القرية) , a primitive (jāmid) noun.. it may be taken from قريت, i.e. "I gathered", because it gathers its people.. It is originally a noun for the place, but it may be applied figuratively to those who dwell in it.
(شئتم) , in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion on account of the verb's being indeclinable on the sukūn: two quiescent letters met, so the alif converted from a yāʾ was deleted - this is regular in every hollow weak verb - and the fāʾ of the verb was given kasra to indicate the deleted letter, which is the yāʾ; its pattern is فلتم.
(سجّدا) , plural of ساجد, an active participle of سجد يسجد, of the class of نصر, its pattern فاعل.. and the pattern of سجّد is فعّل with ḍamma on the fāʾ and fatḥa on the doubled ʿayn.
(حطّة) , a maṣdar of manner (maṣdar hayʾa) from the verb حطّ يحطّ, of the class of نصر; its pattern is فعلة with kasra on the fāʾ. It was also said that it is a word they were commanded to say whose meaning is not known «[Note: Ḥāshiyat al-Jamal ʿalā al-Jalālayn.. and it was said that it is repentance.]» .
(خطايا) , plural of خطيئة, a noun meaning "sin", its pattern فعيلة. It was said: the pattern of خطايا is فعائل; its origin is خطايئ with a yāʾ with kasra before the hamza; then the yāʾ was converted into a hamza with kasra «[Note: The wāw or yāʾ is converted into hamza after the alif of مفاعل or فعائل.]» , so two hamzas came together, and the second was converted into yāʾ «[Note: A final hamza is replaced by yāʾ when it comes after a hamza.]» ; then the hamza was given fatḥa for lightness, and likewise the final yāʾ; then the yāʾ was converted into alif because it was vowelled and what preceded it had fatḥa; then the hamza was converted into yāʾ to escape heaviness, and it became خطايا.
It was also said - and this is the view of Sībawayh - that the origin of خطايا is خطائئ; then the second hamza was replaced by yāʾ according to the rules of replacement. Then the kasra on the hamza was replaced by a fatḥa, so the yāʾ was converted into alif; then the hamza was replaced by yāʾ «[Note: See al-Naḥw al-Wāfī, vol. 4, p. 578.]» .
(المحسنين) , plural of المحسن, which is an active participle of the four-letter verb أحسن, so it is on the pattern of its imperfect, replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm with ḍamma and putting kasra on the letter before the last.

safi-cedvel:59-59.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (بدّل) a past verb; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (ظلموا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (قولا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (غير) a naʿt (adjective) of (قولا), accusative like it; (الذي) a relative, muḍāf ilayhi, in the position of genitive; (قيل) a past verb in the passive, and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "it" (هو), i.e. the saying; (اللام) a preposition and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قيل) . (الفاء) conjunction; (أنزلنا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (نا) is the fāʿil; (على) a preposition; (الذين) a relative in the position of genitive, attached to (أنزلنا) , (ظلموا) its i'rab has preceded; (رجزا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزلنا) «[Note: Or to an omitted naʿt of (رجزا) .]» , (الباء) a causal preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (كانوا) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and (الواو) the noun of kāna; (يفسقون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «بدّل الذين ظلموا» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «قلنا» in the previous verse.
The clause «ظلموا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين) .
The clause «قيل لهم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي) .
The clause «أنزلنا» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «بدّل».
The second clause «ظلموا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين) .
The clause «كانوا يفسقون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (ما) .
The clause «يفسقون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of «كانوا».
The interpreted maṣdar formed from (ما) and the verb is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ ... attached to (أنزلنا) .

* Morphology:
(قولا) an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb قال يقول; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; the wāw underwent no iʿlāl (weak-letter change) because it is quiescent.
(رجزا) , a noun for everything foul or hateful; its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
- The words of Allah the Exalted فَأَنْزَلْنا عَلَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا: the overt noun is put in place of the pronoun for causation and for intensifying the blame and reproach, and to make explicit that by what they did they had wronged themselves by exposing them to the wrath of Allah the Exalted.

safi-cedvel:60-60.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذ استسقى موسى لقومه) like «إذ قال موسى لقومه» «[Note: in verse (54) of this sūra.]» . (الفاء) conjunction; (قلنا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (نا) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (اضرب) an imperative verb, its fāʿil a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "you" (أنت); (بعصا) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اضرب) , the bāʾ being for instrumentality (istiʿāna), the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (الكاف) muḍāf ilayhi; (الحجر) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الفاء) conjunction; (انفجر) a past verb, and (التاء) for the feminine, (من) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (انفجرت) , (اثنتا) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the alif, since it is assimilated to the dual; (عشرة) a numeral component, indeclinable on the fatḥa, with no grammatical position; (عينا) tamyīz (specification), accusative; (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (علم) a past verb; (كلّ) fāʿil, nominative; (أناس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (مشرب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (كلوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn ... and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (الواو) conjunction; (اشربوا) like «كلوا»; (من رزق) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the two preceding verbs by way of contention (tanāzuʿ), with the second being made to govern; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو) conjunction; (لا) of prohibition, jussivizing; (تعثوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn.. and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تعثوا) , (مفسدين) an emphasising ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «استسقى موسى» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قلنا ... » is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause «استسقى».
The clause «اضرب ... » is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «انفجرت منه اثنتا عشرة» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to an implied clause, i.e.: so he struck, and there gushed forth.
The clause «علم كلّ أناس ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive «1» .
The clause «كلوا» has no grammatical position, being resumptive «2» .
The clause «اشربوا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «كلوا».
The clause «لا تعثوا ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «كلوا».
«[Translator's note: the markers «1» and «2» above have no corresponding footnotes in the source.]»

* Morphology:
(استسقى) , in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by conversion: its origin is استسقي with fatḥa on the yāʾ; the yāʾ came vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into alif.
(عصا) , the alif in it is converted from a wāw, because the dual is عصوان; and you say:
عصوت بالعصا, i.e. I struck (with the stick). The pattern of عصا is فعل with two fatḥas.
(الحجر) , a primitive (jāmid) noun, its pattern فعل with two fatḥas.
(اثنتان) , feminine of اثنان, which is a noun for double the one; in it the lām of the word is deleted, and the alif and the nūn are added for the dual; so it is assimilated to the dual, because it has no singular from its own wording. The nūn was deleted from اثنتا عشرة because it resembles the annexation construction.
(عشرة) , a noun for the first of the tens, feminine of العشر; it came feminine, agreeing with the thing counted, because it is compounded with what precedes it.
(عينا) , a primitive noun meaning "spring"; its plural is أعين and عيون; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(أناس) , plural of انس, a collective noun meaning human beings; its singular is the relative adjective from it, i.e. إنسيّ. There is another plural of it, أناسيّ, with fatḥa on the hamza. The pattern of أناس is فعال with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(مشرب) , a noun of place from شرب يشرب, of the class of فرح; its pattern is مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn, because the ʿayn of the imperfect has fatḥa and it is a sound verb.
(تعثوا) , in it there is an iʿlāl by deletion: its origin is تعثاوا; the alif came quiescent before the quiescent wāw, so the alif was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; its pattern is تفعوا. Its verb is عثا يعثو and عثي يعثى, of the classes of نصر and فرح.

safi-cedvel:61-61.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذ قلتم يا موسى) its i'rab has preceded in verse (55) , (لن) a particle of accusative and negation; (نصبر) an imperfect verb, accusative, its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "we" (نحن); (على طعام) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نصبر) , (واحد) a naʿt (adjective) of (طعام), genitive like it; (الفاء) for linking the effect to the cause, or connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; (ادع) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the weak letter, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "you" (أنت); (اللام) a preposition, and (نا) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ادع) , (ربّ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (يخرج) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), in answer to the command (jawāb al-ṭalab), its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (لنا) like the first, attached to (يخرج) . (من) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive by (من) «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective.. and the clause after it is a naʿt of it.]» attached to (يخرج) , and the object of «يخرج» is omitted, its implied form being «شيئا» (something); (تنبت) an imperfect verb, nominative; (الأرض) fāʿil, nominative; (من بقل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the omitted object of «تنبت», i.e.: of what the earth grows, of herbs «[Note: Or it is a badal (substitute) of (ما) with repetition of the preposition.]» . And (ها) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (وقثّائها وفومها وعدسها وبصلها) annexed nouns, conjoined by the conjunctions to «بقلها», genitive like it.
The clause «قلتم ... » is in the position of genitive by the annexation of (إذ) to it.
The clause «of the vocative and its response» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «لن نصبر ... » has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «ادع ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause that is the response to the vocative, since it is within the scope of the vocative.. or it is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. if we are in need of more than one kind of food, then call upon your Lord for us..
The clause «يخرج..» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «تنبت الأرض» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما) .
(قال) a past verb, its fāʿil a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he"; (الهمزة) for interrogation of disapproval (inkārī); (تستبدلون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (هو) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (أدنى) khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الباء) a preposition; (الذي) a relative in the position of genitive, attached to the verb «تستبدلون». (هو خير) like «هو أدنى». (اهبطوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and (الواو) is the fāʿil; (مصرا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الفاء) causal.. or connecting the apodosis of an implied condition; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (اللام) a preposition; (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as the postponed noun of inna, (سألتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and its fāʿil. (الواو) resumptive; (ضرب) a past verb in the passive, being made to include the meaning of «جعلت» (was made), and (التاء) for the feminine; (على) a preposition and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ضربت) , (الذلّة) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (المسكنة) conjoined by the wāw to «الذلّة», nominative like it; (الواو) conjunction; (باءوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بغضب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the wāw, the bāʾ being for accompaniment (mulābasa); (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of (غضب) . (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (الباء) a preposition; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of anna; (كانوا) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the noun of kāna; (يكفرون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar formed from (أنّ), its noun and its khabar is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ «ذلك», i.e. that wrath is deserved by their disbelief.
(بآيات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يكفرون) , (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو) conjunction; (يقتلون) like «يكفرون»; (النبيين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (بغير) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of «يقتلون», i.e. they kill them, being in the wrong «[Note: It may be attached to an omitted naʿt of an omitted maṣdar - i.e. a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar - i.e. a killing occurring without right.]» , (الحق) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
(ذلك) its i'rab has preceded; (الباء) a causal preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (عصوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; the ḍamma is implied on the alif that was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما عصوا) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «ذلك».
(الواو) conjunction; (كانوا) like the first; (يعتدون) like «يكفرون».
The clause «قال ... » has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) in answer to an implied question.
The clause «تستبدلون ... » is in the position of accusative as the speech reported.
The clause «هو أدنى» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the first relative noun (الذي) .
The clause «هو خير» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذي) .
The clause «اهبطوا ... » has no grammatical position, being resumptive «[Note: It may be in the position of accusative as the speech reported of an implied saying.]» .
The clause «إنّ لكم ما سألتم» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya) «[Note: It may be the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if you go down, then you shall have what you asked.]» .
The clause «سألتم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما) .
The clause «ضربت عليهم الذلّة» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «باءوا ... » has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «ذلك بأنهم كانوا ... » has no grammatical position, being causal, or a resumption without causation.
The clause «كانوا يكفرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of anna.
The clause «يكفرون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of (كانوا), and the clause «يقتلون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause «يكفرون».
The clause «ذلك بما عصوا» has no grammatical position, being a badal of the clause «ذلك بأنهم كانوا ...».
The clause «عصوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (ما) .
The clause «كانوا يعتدون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «عصوا».
The clause «يعتدون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of «كانوا».

* Morphology:
(طعام) , a noun for what is eaten, of any kind; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(واحد) , a noun indicating the individual, in the masculine, or a derived adjective on the pattern فاعل.
(ادع) , in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion on account of indeclinability; its pattern is افع with ḍamma on the ʿayn.
(بقل) , a noun for the stemless plants (al-najm) that the earth grows; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn; its plural is بقول with ḍamma on the bāʾ.
(قثّاء) , a noun for the well-known plant (cucumber); it is a collective noun whose singular is قثّاءة, with kasra on the qāf and fatḥa on the doubled thāʾ; the hamza is radical, as they say: أقثأت الأرض, i.e. its cucumbers became abundant.
(فوم) , a primitive (jāmid) noun for the well-known plant, which is garlic (الثوم); it was also said to be wheat; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(عدس) , a primitive noun, a collective noun whose singular is عدسة, on the pattern فعلة with two fatḥas; likewise عدس, its pattern فعل with two fatḥas.
(بصل) , a primitive noun for the well-known plant, its pattern فعل with two fatḥas.
(أدنى) , its alif is converted from a wāw, because it is from دنا يدنو; its pattern is أفعل, an assimilate adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha). It was also said that the alif is a replacement of a hamza, because it is taken from دنؤ يدنؤ, of the class of كرم, so it is دنيء, i.e. base.
(مصرا) , a noun meaning a city, or Egypt in particular; its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn.
(الذلّة) , an aural (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb ذلّ يذلّ, of the class of ضرب; its pattern is فعلة with kasra then sukūn. There are other maṣdars of the verb: ذلّ with ḍamma on the dhāl, ذلالة with fatḥa on the dhāl, and a mīmī maṣdar, مذلّة.
(المسكنة) , a mīmī maṣdar from السكون (stillness), because the poor man (al-miskīn) moves little; its pattern is مفعلة, and the tāʾ is for intensiveness.
(غضب) , an aural maṣdar of the verb غضب يغضب, of the class of فرح, its pattern فعل with two fatḥas.
(النبيين) , plural of النبيّ, which is an assimilate adjective on the pattern فعيل; its origin is النبيء, because it is from النبأ, which is the news, since he gives news from Allah; it was lightened by converting the hamza into yāʾ, then the two yāʾs were merged together. Or it is taken from النبوة, i.e. elevation, because the rank of the Prophet is elevated above the ranks of the rest of creation «[Note: al-ʿUkbarī: the book (Wujūh al-iʿrāb wa-l-qirāʾāt ...) .]» .
(عصوا) , in it there is an iʿlāl by deletion that followed the same course as (تعثوا) in the previous verse.
(يعتدون) , in it there is an iʿlāl by deletion that followed the same course as (تهتدون) in verse (53) .

* Rhetoric:
- Metonymy (al-kināya): in the words of Allah the Exalted وَضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الذِّلَّةُ وَالْمَسْكَنَةُ, i.e. the two were made to surround them as a dome surrounds the one over whom it is pitched, or they were stuck to them and made an inseparable fixture (ḍarbat lāzib) that will not leave them, as a recompense for their ingratitude - from the "striking" of clay onto a wall - by way of implicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra bi-l-kināya).

safi-cedvel:20-20.t:
* I'rab:
(يكاد) an incomplete imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). (البرق) the noun of يكاد, nominative. (يخطف) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو, i.e. the lightning. (أبصار) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (كلّما) adverbial of time, containing the meaning of condition [Note: (كلّ) may be parsed as an adverb of time attached to (مشوا), and (ما) as a maṣdariyya (infinitival) particle, the interpreted maṣdar being in the position of the genitive by the construct of كلّ with it; the implied meaning: "every time of shining ...".
And thus the interpreted maṣdar is to be supplied in every such expression.], attached to (mutaʿalliq) (مشوا). (أضاء) past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (اللام) a preposition and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (أضاء). (مشوا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (في) a preposition and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by the preposition, attached to (مشوا). (الواو) a conjunction. (إذا) an adverb of the future containing the meaning of condition, attached to the apodosis قاموا. (أظلم) past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو, i.e. the lightning. (على) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of the genitive by the preposition, attached to (أظلم). (قاموا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (الواو) a conjunction. (لو) a particle of impossibility for impossibility (ḥarf imtināʿ li-mtināʿ), a non-jussive condition. (شاء) past verb. (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (اللام) falling in the apodosis of لو. (ذهب) past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (بسمع) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ذهب), and (هم) is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) a conjunction. (أبصارهم) muḍāf and muḍāf ilayhi, conjoined to سمعهم, genitive like it. (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis (inna and its sisters). (الله) the Name of Majesty, noun of إنّ, accusative. (على كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قدير). (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (قدير) khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative.
The clause «يكاد البرق ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
The clause «يخطف ...» is in the position of the accusative as khabar of يكاد.
The clause «أضاء ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «مشوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «أظلم ...» is in the position of the genitive by the construct of إذا with it.
The clause «قاموا» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «شاء الله» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «ذهب ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «إنّ الله.. قدير» has no grammatical position, being resumptive and causal (istiʾnāfiyya taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(يكاد) the alif is converted from a wāw, so it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by qalb (conversion). The origin is يكود with fatḥa on the wāw; the vowel of the wāw was transferred to the kāf before it — iʿlāl by taskīn (making vowelless) — then the wāw was converted to alif because it is vowelless and what precedes it has fatḥa.
(مشوا) contains iʿlāl by deletion; its origin is مشاوا. The alif and the wāw came together vowelless, so the alif was deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, and what precedes the wāw was given fatḥa to indicate the deleted alif.
(قاموا) the alif in it is originally a wāw, because its imperfect is يقوم; the conversion took place in it as in قالوا (see verse 14).
(شاء) the alif in it is converted from a yāʾ, because its maṣdar (verbal noun) is شيء; the iʿlāl took place in it as in زاد (see verse 10), its origin being شيأ with fatḥa on the yāʾ.
(شيء) a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb شاء يشاء, of the class of فتح; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(قدير) ṣifa mushabbaha (adjective resembling the participle) of the verb قدر يقدر, of the class of نصر and the class of ضرب, and قدر يقدر, of the class of فرح; its pattern is فعيل.

* Benefits:
Among the features of the Arabic language and its principal characteristics is the easing of pronunciation. Since calling a noun made definite by أل is marked by difficulty of pronunciation, recourse is had to placing (أي) between it and the vocative particle. Thus it has been inserted in the saying of the Exalted «يا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ», and through it calling «الناس», which is made definite by أل, became smooth.

safi-cedvel:21-21.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) vocative particle. (أيّ) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative. (الناس) badal (substitute) of أيّ, following it in the nominative in wording, or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of it. (اعبدوا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and (الواو) is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent). (ربّ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الكاف) is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and (الميم) is a particle for the masculine plural. (الذي) relative noun in the position of the accusative as naʿt (adjective) of (ربّ). (خلق) past verb, and (كم) is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو (He). (الواو) a conjunction. (الذين) relative noun in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the accusative pronoun in خلقكم. (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, and (كم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, for hope (tarajjī), and (كم) is a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of لعلّ. (تتّقون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the sign of the nominative is the retention of the nūn, and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The vocative clause «يا أيها الناس ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
The clause «اعبدوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative — resumptive.
The clause «خلقكم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لعلّكم تتقون» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya) [Note: The position of this clause relative to what precedes it is the position of the requital relative to the condition. It may also be circumstantial (ḥāliyya) from the agent of اعبدوا, i.e. "in your state of hoping for piety, eager for it". The overall meaning:
Worship your Lord in your hope of piety, or so that you may be pious, or exposing yourselves to piety.].
The clause «تتّقون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of لعلّ.

* Morphology:
(تتّقون) contains ibdāl (substitution) and iʿlāl (weak-letter change). As for the ibdāl, it is the conversion of the wāw, which is the fāʾ (first radical) of the verb, to tāʾ. Its bare past is وقى and its augmented past is اتّقى, whose origin is اوتقى; the wāw was converted to tāʾ because it came before the tāʾ of iftiʿāl. This conversion is regular in every verb whose fāʾ is wāw or yāʾ: when they come before the tāʾ of iftiʿāl, they are converted to tāʾ and assimilated with the tāʾ of iftiʿāl, and also in its active and passive participles. As for the iʿlāl, it is iʿlāl by deletion: its origin is تتقيون; the ḍamma was felt heavy on the yāʾ, so the vowel was transferred to the qāf; then two vowelless letters met, the yāʾ and the wāw, so the yāʾ was deleted to escape the meeting of two vowelless letters, and it became تتّقون; its pattern is تفتعون.
2- لعلّ comes in the Noble Qur'an for hope, and comes for causation (taʿlīl), and comes for exposing oneself to a thing, as if He were urging them to practise worship and thereby expose themselves to piety..

safi-cedvel:123-123.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (اتّقوا): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn,
the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (يوما): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), on the deletion of a muḍāf, i.e., «the punishment of a day». (لا): negative. (تجزي): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma. (نفس): fāʿil, nominative. (عن نفس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تجزي). (شيئا): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, accusative. (الواو): conjunction. (لا): negative. (يقبل): imperfect verb, passive, nominative. (من): a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يقبل). (عدل): nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative. (الواو): conjunction. (لا): negative. (تنفع): imperfect verb, nominative, and (ها) a pronoun, direct object. (شفاعة): fāʿil, nominative. (ولا): like the previous one. (هم): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (ينصرون): imperfect verb, passive, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn, and (الواو) is the nāʾib fāʿil.
The clause «اتقوا يوما»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the vocative clause in the previous verse. The clause «لا تجزي نفس..»: in the position of accusative as naʿt (adjective) of (يوما), the linking pronoun being omitted, its implied form being "فيه" ("in it").
The clause «لا يقبل منها عدل»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause تجزى.
The clause «لا تنفعها شفاعة»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause تجزي.
The clause «لا هم ينصرون»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause تجزي.
The clause «ينصرون»: in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

safi-cedvel:124-124.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (إذ): an adverbial noun for past time, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر ("remember"). (ابتلى): past verb, indeclinable on the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa. (إبراهيم): fronted direct object, accusative (manṣūb). (ربّ): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (بكلمات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ابتلى). (الفاء): conjunction. (أتم): past verb, and (هنّ) an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as direct object; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (قال): past verb, and the fāʿil is "هو". (إن): a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الياء) the noun of إنّ. (جاعل): the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative, and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (للناس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (إماما) «[Note: It may be attached to the active participle جاعل, i.e., "for the sake of the people".]» (a naʿt placed before the noun it describes). (إماما): direct object of the active participle جاعل. (قال): like the first. (الواو): conjunction. (من ذرّيّة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being اجعل («[Note: It may be attached to a naʿt (adjective) of the first object of اجعل, i.e., "make a group of my offspring imams".]»), and the direct object is omitted, its implied form being إماما, i.e., «make of my offspring an imam». (قال): like the first. (لا): negative. (ينال): imperfect verb, nominative. (عهد): fāʿil, nominative, and (الياء) muḍāf ilayhi. (الظالمين): direct object, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «ابتلى إبراهيم ربّه»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «أتمّهنّ»: in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause ابتلى.
The clause «قال..»: has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) or an explanation of the trial.
The clause «إنّي جاعلك»: in the position of accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «قال» (the second): has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «(اجعل) من ذرّيّتي..»: in the position of accusative as the object of speech, and it is conjoined, by coordination, to the speech of Allah the Exalted: إنّي جاعلك.
The clause «قال» (the third): has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption.
The clause «لا ينال عهدي الظالمين»: in the position of accusative as the object of speech.

* Morphology:
(ابتلى): it contains a weak-letter change (iʿlāl) by conversion; its origin is ابتلي. The yāʾ came voweled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into an alif.
(جاعل): active participle of the triliteral جعل; its pattern is فاعل (see verse 30 of this sūra).
(إماما): a noun for that which is followed; masculine and feminine are the same in it. Its plurals are أيمّه and أئمة. The pattern of إمام is فعال, with kasra on the first radical.
(ذرّية): a noun for children and progeny. Originally the dhāl may take any of the three vowels; here it is with ḍamma on the dhāl. Its plurals are الذراري and الذرّيات. The pattern of ذرّية is فعليّة, with ḍamma on the first radical, sukūn on the second, kasra on the third, and a doubled yāʾ with fatḥa.
(ينال): it contains a weak-letter change by conversion, beginning from the past; its origin is ينيل, the yāʾ being converted into an alif after its vowel was transferred to the nūn..

* Rhetoric:
In this verse there is a charming art among the arts of eloquence called the art of murājaʿa (exchange of speech): the speaker relates an exchange of words that took place between him and a partner in conversation, or between two people, in the most concise expression, the most eloquent allusion and the most elegant dialogue, together with sweetness and strength of wording and ease of composition. This verse has combined the meanings of speech: statement and inquiry, command and prohibition, promise and threat.

* Benefits:
1- The fāʿil may not precede its verb; if it comes first, it is parsed as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the fāʿil is taken to be an implied pronoun. This is unlike the direct object, which may be placed before the verb in particular cases mentioned in the lengthy books of grammar. [Its placing before the fāʿil occurs] as in the saying of Allah the Exalted «وَإِذِ ابْتَلى إِبْراهِيمَ رَبُّهُ». «[Translator's note: the bracketed words are added for clarity; in this verse the object is fronted before the fāʿil, not before the verb.]»
2- إبراهيم means in Syriac "the merciful father", and its form in Hebrew is «ابراهام».
3- جاعل is an active participle that operated as its verb operates, so it took two objects: the first is the kāf of «جاعلك», so it is an annexation of the active participle to its object, and the second is «إماما».
4- It is said that the words with which Allah tried Abraham are the rites (of pilgrimage), and Abraham carried them out; therefore Allah the Exalted said about him «وَإِبْراهِيمَ الَّذِي وَفَّى». It is also said that the words are: «the laws, the commands and the prohibitions».
5- In this verse the eloquence of the Qur'an shines forth in this art of dialogue which they call «al-murājaʿa». You can contemplate this style for the subtle dialogue and the eloquent concision it contains. In Arabic literature there are examples of this kind for which the scope of this book has no room.
Whoever wishes may consult them in al-Buḥturī, ʿUmar ibn Abī Rabīʿa and poets like them.

safi-cedvel:125-125.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (إذ): its i'rab was given in the previous verse. (جعلنا): past verb and its fāʿil (agent). (البيت): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (مثابة): a second direct object, accusative «[Note: It may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) if (جعل) is made to include the meaning of خلق ("created").]». (للناس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of مثابة «[Note: It may be attached to the verb جعل.]». (أمنا): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to مثابة by the wāw, accusative like it. (الواو): resumptive. (اتّخذوا): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. (من مقام): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted second direct object. (إبراهيم): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa. (مصلّى): first direct object, accusative. (الواو): resumptive. (عهدنا): like (جعلنا). (إلى إبراهيم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عهدنا), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa. (إسماعيل): maʿṭūf to إبراهيم by the wāw, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa. (أن): a particle of explanation (tafsīr) «[Note: Al-ʿUkbarī permitted making it a maṣdar particle, with the clause طهّرا as its ṣila, and the interpreted maṣdar genitive by an omitted preposition, attached to (عهد).]». (طهّرا): imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn,
and the alif is the fāʿil. (بيت): direct object, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on its end, its appearance being prevented by the place being occupied by the appropriate vowel, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (للطائفين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (طهّرا), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ. (العاكفين): maʿṭūf to الطائفين by the wāw, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ. (الرّكّع): maʿṭūf to الطائفين by the wāw, genitive like it. (السجود): naʿt of الركّع, genitive like it «[Note: This is if it is the plural of ساجد. It may be a maṣdar (verbal noun), and in that case there is a deleted muḍāf, i.e., "those of prostration".]».
The clause «جعلنا ...»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «اتخذوا..»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «عهدنا..»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «طهّرا..»: has no grammatical position; explicative.

* Morphology:
(مثابة): a noun of place from ثاب يثوب, meaning "returned". The origin of مثابة is مثوبة (with sukūn on the thāʾ and fatḥa on the wāw); then the vowel of the wāw was transferred to the thāʾ and the wāw made quiescent (iʿlāl by quiescence), then the wāw was converted into an alif because the letter before it has fatḥa and it was originally voweled, so it became مثابة. The tāʾ is augmentative, for intensiveness. Its pattern is مفعلة.
(أمنا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb أمن, of the pattern-class فرح; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(مقام): a noun of place from قام يقوم; the alif in it is converted from a wāw. Its origin is مقوم (with sukūn on the qāf and fatḥa on the wāw); then the wāw was made quiescent and the qāf given fatḥa (iʿlāl by quiescence), then the wāw was converted into an alif because the letter before it has fatḥa and it was originally voweled. Its pattern is مفعل with fatḥa on the second radical.
(مصلّى): a noun of place from the quadriliteral صلّى يصلّي; it is on the pattern of its passive imperfect, by replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm carrying ḍamma. The alif in مصلّى was originally a wāw; when the letter before it had fatḥa, it was converted into an alif.
(الطائفين): plural of الطائف, the active participle of طاف يطوف; its pattern is فاعل, and the wāw was converted into a hamza because it came after the alif of فاعل.
(العاكفين): plural of العاكف, the active participle of the triliteral عكف; its pattern is فاعل.
(الركّع): plural of الراكع, the active participle of ركع يركع, of the pattern-class فتح; its pattern is فاعل. The pattern of ركّع is فعّل, with ḍamma on the first radical and fatḥa on the doubled second radical.
(السجود): plural of الساجد, the active participle of سجد; its pattern is فاعل, and the pattern of السجود is فعول with ḍamma on the first radical..
السجود may also be a maṣdar of the triliteral verb سجد.

safi-cedvel:126-126.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (إذ): its i'rab was given in verse (124). (قال): past verb. (إبراهيم): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ). (ربّ): the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the bāʾ, its appearance prevented by the place being occupied by the vowel of the deleted yāʾ; the yāʾ, deleted for lightness, is a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (اجعل): an imperative verb of supplication; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (ها): a particle of alerting. (ذا): a demonstrative in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (بلدا): a second direct object, accusative. (آمنا): naʿt (adjective) of (بلدا), accusative like it. (الواو): conjunction. (ارزق): like اجعل. (أهل): direct object, accusative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (من الثمرات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ارزق). (من): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as badal (substitute) of أهل. (آمن): past verb; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (من): a preposition, and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of آمن. (بالله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آمن). (اليوم): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the Name of Majesty by the wāw, genitive like it. (قال): like the first, and the fāʿil is Allah. (الواو): conjunction. (من): a relative noun in the position of accusative «[Note: Or in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is the clause أمتّعه.. Also, (من) may be a conditional noun causing the jussive, a mubtadaʾ whose apodosis is omitted, its implied form being أرزقه, with the clause أمتّعه conjoined to the apodosis clause on the assumption of أنا أمتّعه; the khabar of the mubtadaʾ is then the clause كفر.. أرزقه, consisting of the protasis and its apodosis.]», direct object of an omitted verb, its implied form being (أرزق). (كفر): past verb; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (الفاء): conjunction. (أمتّع): imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا", and (الهاء) a pronoun, direct object. (قليلا): an adverb of time standing in for an omitted adverb, i.e., «a little time», accusative, attached to (أمتّعه) «[Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, i.e., "a little enjoyment".]». (ثمّ): a conjunction. (أضطرّ): like (أمتّع), and (الهاء) direct object. (إلى عذاب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أضطرّه), by its being made to include the meaning of ألجئه ("I will force him"). (النار): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (الواو): resumptive. (بئس): an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame. (المصير): fāʿil, nominative — and the thing specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being «the punishment of the Fire».
The clause «قال إبراهيم..»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ربّ اجعل..»: in the position of accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اجعل..»: has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «ارزق..»: has no grammatical position, conjoined to the response to the vocative.
The clause «آمن ...»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «قال..»: has no grammatical position; resumptive.
The clause «(أرزق) من كفر..»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to an implied object of speech, i.e., «I will provide for him, and I will provide for whoever disbelieves».
The clause «كفر..»: has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «أمتّعه..»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the omitted clause (أرزق).
The clause «أضطرّه..»: in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause أمتّعه.
The clause «بئس المصير»: has no grammatical position; resumptive «[Note: Or in the position of nominative as a fronted khabar of the implied postponed mubtadaʾ, which is the thing specified for blame, i.e.:
"the punishment of the Fire — wretched is the destination".]».

* Morphology:
(آمنا): active participle of أمن يأمن; its pattern is فاعل, and it is used in the sense of (possessing security).
(أضطرّه): it contains the substitution (ibdāl) of the tāʾ of the ifti'āl form with ṭāʾ because it came after the ḍād. Its pattern is أفتعله.
(المصير): a mīm-maṣdar of the verb صار يصير, meaning "returned"; its pattern is مفعل with kasra on the second radical. In the word there is iʿlāl by quiescence, since the vowel of the yāʾ was transferred to the ṣād before it, and it was made quiescent.

* Benefits:
1- «ربّ» is a munādā that is a muḍāf, from which two things have been deleted: the vocative yāʾ (يا) from its beginning and the yāʾ of the speaker from its end. It is fitting here to mention the categories of the munādā, which are five: two are indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of accusative, namely the singular proper name and the intended indefinite noun; and three are accusative, namely the unintended indefinite noun, the muḍāf, and that which resembles the muḍāf. All these categories are accusative by an omitted verb, its implied form being «ادعو» or «أنادي» ("I call"), for which the vocative particle stands in.

safi-cedvel:127-127.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (إذ): mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر ("remember"). (يرفع): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). (إبراهيم): fāʿil (agent), nominative. (القواعد): direct object, accusative (manṣūb). (من البيت): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of القواعد. (الواو): conjunction. (إسماعيل): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to إبراهيم, nominative like it. (ربّ): the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative, from which the vocative particle has been deleted, and (نا) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (تقبّل): an imperative verb of supplication; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (من): a preposition, and (نا) in the position of genitive, attached to (تقبّل). (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الكاف) a pronoun, the noun of إنّ. (أنت): a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: Or a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is السميع.. and the clause أنت السميع is the khabar of إنّ. It may also be borrowed for the position of accusative as a tawkīd (emphasis) of the noun of إنّ.]». (السميع): the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, nominative. (العليم): a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «يرفع إبراهيم..»: in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ربّنا تقبّل..»: in the position of accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb, its implied form being: يقولان ربنا ("the two of them saying: our Lord"); the clause يقولان is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of إبراهيم and إسماعيل.
The clause «تقبّل منّا..»: has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «إنّك أنت السميع»: has no grammatical position; causal (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(القواعد): plural of القاعدة, the feminine of القاعد; it is a noun for the foundation on which a building stands. Its form is originally derived, on the pattern فاعل, and then it came to be used as a noun.
(إسماعيل): a foreign proper name.
(السميع): one of the intensive forms of the active participle, a derived adjective on the pattern فعيل from the transitive سمع. It may be an adjective resembling the active participle (ṣifa mushabbaha), because it indicates permanence and continuity.

safi-cedvel:93-93.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (إذ): an adverbial noun for the past, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكروا", (أخذنا): a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (نا): an attached pronoun, fāʿil (agent), in the position of nominative. (ميثاق): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم): a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): of the ḥāl (circumstantial). (رفعنا): like أخذنا. (فوق): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (رفعنا), and (كم): a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الطور): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (خذوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (ما): a relative noun in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi. (آتينا): like أخذنا, and (كم): a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (بقوّة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آتينا), the bāʾ being causal [Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of خذوا.. i.e. "take what We gave you, clothed in strength", i.e. firmly established.], (الواو): conjunction. (اسمعوا): like خذوا. (قالوا): a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma ... and the wāw is the fāʿil. (سمعنا): like أخذنا, and likewise (عصينا), (الواو): of the ḥāl. (أشربوا): a passive past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (في قلوب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أشربوا), and (هم): muḍāf ilayhi. (العجل): mafʿūl bihi, accusative, with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "the love of the calf". (بكفر): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أشربوا), the bāʾ being causal, and (هم): muḍāf ilayhi. (قل): an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (بئس): a past verb, inflexible (jāmid), for expressing blame; the fāʿil is a necessarily latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (ما): an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective (nakira mawṣūfa), in the position of accusative as a tamyīz (specification) of the latent pronoun [Note: There are other ways of parsing (ما) which have passed earlier. See footnote (4) in the i'rab of the clauses of verse (90).], (يأمر): an imperfect verb, nominative. (كم): a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (الباء): a preposition, and (الهاء): a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يأمر), (إيمان): fāʿil, nominative, and (كم): a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (إن كنتم مؤمنين): its i'rab has passed in verse (91).
The clause «أخذنا ... » is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «رفعنا» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, with (قد) implied.
The clause «خذوا ... » is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) of an omitted saying, i.e. "We said: take".
The clause «آتيناكم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «اسمعوا» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause خذوا.
The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «سمعنا» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «عصينا» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause سمعنا.
The clause «أشربوا» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, with (قد) implied.
The clause «قل» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «بئسما ... » is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «يأمركم به إيمانكم» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of (ما), and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "the worship of the calf".
The clause إن كنتم مؤمنين has no grammatical position: resumptive.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "evil is what it commands you".. or "then do not kill the prophets of Allah, do not deny the messengers, and do not conceal the truth ...".

* Morphology:
(إيمان): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb آمن; its pattern is إفعال. The yāʾ is converted from a hamza; its origin is ائمان, because the madda in آمن is originally two hamzas, the first with fatḥa and the second with sukūn, i.e. أأمن on the measure أفعل; when what preceded the second hamza came with kasra, it was converted to yāʾ for harmony and lightening.

* Rhetoric:
Eloquent simile (al-tashbīh al-balīgh): in His saying, the Exalted, وَأُشْرِبُوا فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الْعِجْلَ, where their hearts — because of how firmly the love of the calf had settled in them — are made as though they drink it, i.e. its love penetrated them and its image became firmly fixed in their hearts because of their excessive infatuation with it and their eagerness to worship it, just as dye penetrates a garment and drink the depths of the body.

safi-cedvel:94-94.t:
* I'rab:
(قل): an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (إن): a jussive conditional particle. (كان): a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (التاء): for the feminine. (اللام): a preposition, and (كم): a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) [Note: Or attached to (خالصة), which is the khabar.], (الدار): the ism of kānat, nominative, with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "the bliss of the abode". (الآخرة): a naʿt (adjective) of (الدار), nominative like it, (عند): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (خالصة), or to an omitted khabar of kāna. (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. (خالصة): a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الدار, accusative. (من دون): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خالصة), (الناس): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الفاء): connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (تمنّوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil. (الموت): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. (إن كنتم صادقين): like إن كنتم مؤمنين [Note: In verse (91) of this sūra.].
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كانت لكم الدار» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «تمنّوا ... » is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «كنتم صادقين» has no grammatical position: resumptive.. and it is a restriction on the first condition; its answer is omitted, indicated by the first answer.

* Morphology:
(خالصة): either a maṣdar (verbal noun) of خلص coming on the pattern فاعلة, like العافية, or an active participle to which the tāʾ of the feminine has been attached.
(تمنّوا): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the weak letter — the lām of the word — was deleted because it came with sukūn before the wāw of the plural, which has sukūn. Its pattern is تفعّوا, with fatḥa on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
In His saying, the Exalted, فَتَمَنَّوُا الْمَوْتَ, the imperative departs from its original meaning to the meaning of challenging to incapacity (taʿjīz), because that is not among their traits nor their familiar outward ways; wishing for death is the way of the righteous ones brought near, because whoever is certain of martyrdom longs for it.

safi-cedvel:201-201.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (من) preposition and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first [Note: What was mentioned in footnote no. (2) on the page before the previous one.]; (من يقول.. في الدنيا) its i'rab, word by word and clause by clause, has already been given [Note: In the previous ayah (200).
(3, 4) In the previous ayah (200).]; (حسنة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunction; (في الآخرة حسنة) like its counterpart before it «3»; (الواو) conjunction; (ق) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and (نا) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (You); (عذاب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (النار) muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «منهم من يقول» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause من الناس من يقول «4».
The clause «قنا عذاب النار» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause آتنا ...

* Morphology:
(قنا): it contains a double change (iʿlāl) by deletion: the first radical (fāʾ) of the verb was dropped starting from the imperfect because it is weak in the first radical, and the third radical (lām) was dropped because of the indeclinable form; it is treated as both mithāl (first-radical weak) and nāqiṣ (third-radical weak); its wazn is عنا.
(حسنة): a noun for the good, desired thing; its wazn is فعلة with two fatḥas.

safi-cedvel:95-95.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (لن): a particle of the subjunctive and negation. (يتمنّوا): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and (الهاء): a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (أبدا): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يتمنّوه), (الباء): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (يتمنّوه) [Note: (ما) may be a maṣdarī particle, the interpreted maṣdar being in the position of genitive; or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective (nakira mawṣūfa), the clause after it being its naʿt (adjective).], (قدّم): a past verb, and (التاء): for the feminine. (أيدي): fāʿil, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and (هم): an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): resumptive. (الله): the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (عليم): khabar (predicate), nominative. (بالظالمين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عليم), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause يتمنّوه has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause قدّمت أيديهم has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause الله عليم has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(يتمنّوه): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) following the course of (تمنّوا) in the previous verse.

* Benefits:
These two verses carry the crushing proof and the spirit of challenge to the Jews, because Allah, glorified is He, declared decisively that they will never wish for death; and we have not known of them in their long history that they threw themselves into death out of desire to enter Paradise.
The Muslims triumphed over the two states of Chosroes and Caesar because they wished for death and sought martyrdom, believing that they would pass from the abode of extinction to the abode of permanence; and this is the mark of the true believers in every age.
Perhaps in the attitude of Khālid ibn al-Walīd towards death there is the best lesson: he wept when he realised that he was about to meet death, and was asked, "What makes you weep?" He said: "I have been present at such-and-such a number of battles, until there is not a span's breadth left in my body but there is in it the thrust of a spear or the blow of a sword; and here I am dying on my bed as the camel dies. So may the eyes of the cowards never sleep."

safi-cedvel:202-202.t:
* I'rab:
(أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف) a particle of address; (اللام) preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (نصيب) postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ); (من) preposition and (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of نصيب [Note: It may be maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt of نصيب.]; (كسبوا) past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (سريع) khabar, nominative; (الحساب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; the adjective has been annexed to its fāʿil.
The clause «أولئك لهم نصيب» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لهم نصيب..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولئك.
The clause «كسبوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «الله سريع الحساب» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(نصيب): a noun for what is apportioned and raised, whether abstract or material; it is فعيل in the sense of مفعول.
(سريع): a derived adjective from سرع يسرع, of the patterns (bāb) فرح and كرم; it is an adjective resembling the active participle (ṣifa mushabbaha); its wazn is فعيل.
(الحساب): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the quadriliteral verb حاسب; its wazn is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ; as for the regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the verb, it is محاسبة.

safi-cedvel:203-203.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اذكروا) imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (في أيام) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اذكروا); (معدودات) naʿt (adjective) of أيام, genitive (majrūr) like it; (الفاء) conjunction; (من) a conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (تعجّل) past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he); (في يومين) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تعجّل), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) the lā of generic negation; (إثم) the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (على) preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of lā; (الواو) conjunction; (من تأخّر فلا إثم عليه) like the preceding one, taking its i'rab word by word and clause by clause; (اللام) preposition; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar, and the mubtadaʾ is omitted, its implied form being "هو" (it), referring to the permissibility of hastening and delaying; (اتّقى) past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he); (الواو) conjunction; (اتّقوا) like اذكروا; (الله) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (اعلموا) like اذكروا; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of anna; (إلى) preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تحشرون), which is a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «اذكروا الله» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «من تعجّل..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «تعجّل في يومين» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: It is possible that the khabar is the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «لا إثم عليه» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined to the fāʾ.
The clause «(هو) لمن اتّقى» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical or an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «اتّقى» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «اتّقوا الله» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause اذكروا الله.
The clause «اعلموا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to one of the two clauses of request.
The clause «تحشرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of anna.
The interpreted maṣdar from anna, its noun and its khabar takes the place of the two objects of اعلموا.

* Morphology:
(معدودات): plural of معدودة, the feminine of معدود, a passive participle from عدّ يعدّ, of the pattern (bāb) نصر; its wazn is مفعول.

safi-cedvel:204-204.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (من الناس من يعجب) like من الناس من يقول [Note: In ayah (200) of this sūra.], and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (قول) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (في الحياة) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of قوله [Note: Or attached to the maṣdar (قوله) on the assumption "in the affairs of this world", or attached to the verb يعجبك.]; (الدنيا) naʿt of الحياة, genitive (majrūr) like it, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (يشهد) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he); (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (على) preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (يشهد); (في قلب) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) circumstantial; (هو) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (ألدّ) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الخصام) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «من الناس من..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يعجبك قوله» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «يشهد الله» is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) [Note: The wāw may be considered resumptive and the clause after it resumptive with no grammatical position.. and the wāw may be a conjunction joining the clause يشهد to the clause يعجبك.].
The clause «هو ألدّ الخصام» is in the position of accusative as ḥāl.

* Morphology:
(الخصام): plural of خصم, like كعب and كعاب; or it is an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the quadriliteral verb خاصم, and in that case there is an omitted muḍāf in the speech, i.e. "he is the most severe of those who dispute".
(قوله): maṣdar of قال يقول; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(ألدّ): a derived adjective meaning "severe in dispute"; it is an adjective resembling the active participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) on the wazn أفعل, from لدّ يلدّ, of the pattern (bāb) نصر.

safi-cedvel:205-205.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb سعى; (تولّى) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he); (سعى) like تولّى; (في الأرض) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of سعى, i.e. "moving about", or attached to (سعى); (اللام) the lām of causation (taʿlīl); (يفسد) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) (أن) after the lām, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he); (في) preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive (majrūr), attached to (يفسد).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يفسد) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (سعى).
(الواو) conjunction; (يهلك) like يفسد, accusative by conjunction; (الحرث) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (النسل) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الحرث by the wāw, accusative like it; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (لا) negative; (يحبّ) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (He); (الفساد) mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The clause «تولّى» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the condition, its protasis and its apodosis are either resumptive or conjoined to the clause يعجبك in the previous ayah.
The clause «سعى» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «يفسد» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «يهلك.» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause that is the ṣila of the particle relative.
The clause «الله لا يحبّ الفساد» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لا يحبّ الفساد» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.

* Morphology:
(تولّى): it contains a change (iʿlāl) by substitution; its original is تولّي: the yāʾ came vowelled after a fatḥa and was changed to alif; its wazn is تفعّل.
(سعى): it contains an iʿlāl by substitution; its original is سعي: the yāʾ came vowelled after a fatḥa and was changed to alif; its wazn is فعل with two fatḥas.
(الحرث): it is the noun from حرث يحرث, of the pattern (bāb) نصر, meaning crops; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(النسل): it is the noun from نسل ينسل, of the pattern ضرب, and it is offspring; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(الفساد): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb فسد يفسد, of the patterns نصر, ضرب and كرم; its wazn is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:22-22.t:
* I'rab:
(الذي) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as badal (substitute) of (الذي) in the previous verse [Note: Or mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb تتقون; or in the position of the accusative as a second naʿt (adjective) of (ربّ); or khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being هو.]. (جعل) past verb [Note: جعل here is in the sense of خلق (created), so it is transitive to one object.], and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being هو, i.e. Allah. (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جعل); (الميم) is a particle for the masculine plural. (الأرض) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (فراشا) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative [Note: What permitted making الفراش a ḥāl, although it is a primitive (jāmid) noun, is that the speech indicates a simile.
Moreover, (جعل) may be in the sense of صيّر (made into), in which case (فراشا) becomes a second mafʿūl bihi.], from الأرض. (الواو) a conjunction. (السماء) mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, i.e. "He made the sky" [Note: (السماء والبناء) may be conjoined to (الأرض والفراش) by a conjunction of composition (ʿaṭf tarkīb), i.e. a conjunction of single words.]. (بناء) ḥāl, accusative, from السماء [Note: The same remark made in footnote no. (3) holds for (بناء). And the implied clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the mentioned clause جعل لكم الأرض.]. (الواو) a conjunction. (أنزل) past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو. (من السماء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزل) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl from (ماء) — a naʿt placed before the noun it describes.]. (ماء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الفاء) a conjunction. (أخرج) past verb, and the fāʿil is هو. (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (أخرج). (من الثمرات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أخرج) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl from (رزقا).]. (رزقا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (اللام) a preposition and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted naʿt of (رزقا). (الفاء) falling in the apodosis of an implied condition, or for linking the cause with the effect. (لا) prohibitive, making jussive. (تجعلوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the sign of its jussive is the deletion of the nūn, and (الواو) is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil. (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi — or it is itself the second object. (أندادا) first mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (تعلمون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (الواو) is the fāʿil.
The clause «جعل ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «أنزل ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «أخرج ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause أنزل ...
The clause «لا تجعلوا ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if Allah has honoured you with these good things, then do not set up rivals to Allah", or "if you worship Him, then do not set up rivals to Him"; or it is causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «أنتم تعلمون» is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl.
The clause «تعلمون» is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أنتم).

* Morphology:
(الأرض) a primitive noun for the planet on which we live; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn. Its plurals are أرضون, أروض with ḍamma on the hamza, أراض and آراض.
And see verse (11) of this sūra.
(فراشا) a primitive noun for what is spread out; it is also a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb فرش يفرش, of the class of نصر and the class of ضرب; its pattern is فعال, with kasra on the fāʾ.
(بناء) a primitive noun in the sense of a house; it is also the maṣdar of بنى يبني, of the class of ضرب. The hamza in بناء is converted from a yāʾ; its origin is بناي: the yāʾ came final after the vowelless alif, so it was converted to hamza, and this rule is regular.
(ماء) its origin is موه, because of their saying ماهت الركية تموه (the well became watery), and in the plural أمواه. When the wāw was vowelled and what preceded it had fatḥa, it was converted to alif; then they substituted a hamza for the hāʾ, and that is not by analogy (qiyās) [Note: al-ʿUkbarī in (Imlāʾ mā manna bihi al-Raḥmān min wujūh al-iʿrāb wa-l-qirāʾāt).].
(رزقا) a primitive noun for what is benefited from; its pattern is فعل, with kasra on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn. In the verse it means "that which is provided".
(أندادا) plural of ندّا [Translator's note: so printed; the singular is ندّ.], ṣifa mushabbaha (adjective resembling the participle) from ندّ يندّ, of the class of ضرب; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.

* Benefits:
Some linguists claimed that the word الأرض is a description of our planet, because it تأرض (consumes) what is in its belly, meaning that it eats everything that enters into it.
3- It is established that the ṣāḥib al-ḥāl (the one to whom the ḥāl refers) is definite; an exception is made to that when the naʿt comes before the noun it describes, so that it is parsed as a ḥāl, and in this case the ṣāḥib al-ḥāl may be indefinite.

safi-cedvel:96-96.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (اللام): the lām of the oath, for an omitted oath.
