(تجدنّ): an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative; (النون): the heavy nūn of emphasis, and (هم): an attached pronoun in the position of accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت", (أحرص): second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الناس): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (حياة): a preposition and its genitive noun [Translator's note: so in the source; the head evidently stands for على حياة], attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أحرص). (الواو): conjunction. (من): a preposition. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to something omitted indicated by what is mentioned, i.e. "more eager than those who associate partners", (أشركوا): a verb and its fāʿil. (يودّ): an imperfect verb, nominative. (أحد): fāʿil, nominative, and (هم): attached, muḍāf ilayhi. (لو): a maṣdarī particle. (يعمّر): a passive imperfect verb, nominative, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (ألف): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يعمّر), (سنة): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar (لو يعمّر..) is in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of the verb يودّ.
(الواو): resumptive. (ما): the Ḥijāzī negating mā, operating as laysa does. (هو): detached, in the position of nominative, the ism of mā. (الباء): a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. (مزحزح): genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of mā, and (الهاء): muḍāf ilayhi, (من العذاب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the active participle مزحزح. (أن): a maṣdarī particle. (يعمّر): a passive imperfect verb, accusative, and the nāʾib fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو".
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يعمّر ...) is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of the active participle مزحزح [Note: i.e. "his being granted long life will not remove him".. The interpreted maṣdar may be a badal (substitute) of the pronoun (هو), if it refers to the granting of long life.]. (الواو): resumptive. (الله): the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative. (بصير) (بصير) [Translator's note: the head is repeated in the source]: khabar, nominative. (الباء): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (بصير) [Note: Or a maṣdarī particle, the interpreted maṣdar being in the position of genitive.. or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective (nakira mawṣūfa), in the position of genitive.], (يعملون): an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause تجدنّهم has no grammatical position: the answer to an implied oath.
The clause أشركوا has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause يودّ أحدهم has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).. or it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the hāʾ in تجدنّهم.
The clause يعمّر has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī).
The clause ما هو بمزحزحه.. has no grammatical position, being resumptive.. or it is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of أحدهم.
The clause يعمّر (the second) has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause الله بصير ... has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause يعملون has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the nominal or particle relative, or it is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of (ما).

* Morphology:
(أحرص): an elative (ism tafḍīl) from the verb حرص يحرص, paradigm ضرب and paradigm فرح; its pattern is أفعل.
(ألف): a primitive (jāmid) noun for the number; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(سنة): a noun for the well-known period of months and days. Its lām has been deleted, which is the wāw or the hāʾ, because its diminutive is سنيّة and سنيهة, and the nisba to it is سنوي and سنهي. Its plural is سنون, with ḍamma or kasra on the sīn, سنوات and سنهات.
(مزحزح): an active participle from the bare quadriliteral زحزح, so it is on the measure of its imperfect, by replacing the imperfect prefix with a mīm with ḍamma and giving kasra to the letter before the last.
(بصير): its pattern is فعيل; it is either a ṣifa mushabbaha (adjective resembling the active participle) of the paradigm كرم, or an intensive form (mubālagha) of the active participle of the paradigm فرح.

* Rhetoric:
1- Concision (ījāz): in the verse, for in the indefiniteness of «حياة» there is vagueness, and through it their eagerness for prolonged life is known.
2- Metonymy (kināya): in His saying, the Exalted: أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ, for it is a metonymy for a great amount, so as to include one who wishes never to die.

safi-cedvel:233-233.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (الوالدات) a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (يرضعن) an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of nominative, and (النون) the fāʿil (agent); (أولاد) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (هنّ) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (حولين) an adverb of time, mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (كاملين) a naʿt (adjective) of حولين, accusative like it, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (اللام) a preposition; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), and the mubtadaʾ is implied (muqaddar), its implied form being: "that which was mentioned of nursing for two years". (أراد) a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive-governing particle; (يتمّ) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", referring to the relative; (الرضاعة) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative.
The interpreted maṣdar from (أن) and the verb is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
(الواو) a conjunction; (على المولود) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, and the preposition with its genitive noun is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the passive participle المولود; (رزق) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (هنّ) a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (كسوتهنّ) conjoined by the wāw to رزقهنّ, nominative like it; (بالمعروف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الرزق and الكسوة; (لا) negating; (تكلّف) a passive imperfect verb, nominative; (نفس) nāʾib fāʿil, nominative; (إلا) a particle of restriction; (وسع) a mafʿūl bihi, which was originally the second object; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing «1»; (تضارّ) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the sukūn, and it was given a fatḥa because of the meeting of two sukūns caused by the doubling; it is passive [Note: It may be active, its fāʿil being (والدة) and its object (ولدها), with the bāʾ redundant, i.e. a mother harms her child by casting the child to its father after it has become attached to her.]; (والدة) nāʾib fāʿil, nominative; (بولد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (لا تضارّ), and the bāʾ is causal, and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing «3»; (مولود) the nāʾib fāʿil of an omitted verb explained by the one mentioned before it, i.e.: لا يضارّ مولود. له ... (له) like the first, and it is the nāʾib fāʿil of the passive participle المولود. (بولد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted (يضارّ), and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause made of the implied verb and the nāʾib fāʿil has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause لا تضارّ والدة بولدها.. and it has been mentioned in the i'rab of the clauses.
(الواو) a conjunction; (على الوارث) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (مثل) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (الفاء) a conjunction; (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle; (أرادا) a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (الألف) a pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (فصالا) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (عن تراض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of فصال, i.e. a weaning issuing from mutual consent.. the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the deleted yāʾ; (من) a preposition and (هما) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an adjective of تراض; (تشاور) conjoined by the wāw to تراض, genitive (majrūr) like it; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) the lā of generic negation; (جناح) the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (على) a preposition and (هما) an indeclinable pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted khabar of lā. (الواو) a conjunction; (إن أردتم) like إن أرادا; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive-governing particle; (تسترضعوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أولاد) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: It is the second object; as for the first object, it is omitted, i.e. that you seek a woman to nurse your children.. It is also permissible that أولادكم be accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. that you seek a woman to nurse for your children.], and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تسترضعوا) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
(الفاء) linking the apodosis; (لا جناح عليكم) like the first.. (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the sense of a condition, attached to the content of the apodosis; (سلّمتم) a past verb and its fāʿil; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (آتيتم) a past verb and its fāʿil; (بالمعروف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of سلّمتم, or to the verb سلّمتم, or to (آتيتم); (الواو) a conjunction; (اتّقوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الله) the word of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) a conjunction; (اعلموا) like اتّقوا; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الله) the word of Majesty, the noun of أنّ, accusative; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to بصير [Note: (ما) may be a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ.]; (تعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بصير) the khabar of أنّ, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar from أنّ, its noun and its khabar stands in place of the two objects of اعلموا.
The clause «الوالدات يرضعن» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يرضعن.. is in the» position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الوالدات).
The clause «أرادا..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (من). [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in the text here is أراد.]
The clause «(ذلك) لمن أراد..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «على المولود له رزقهنّ» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «لا تكلّف نفس..» has no grammatical position, being causal (giving the reason).
The clause «لا تضارّ والدة» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: The clause may be in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of (يرضعن) if (لا) is parsed as negating.].
The clause «(لا) يضارّ مولود له» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause لا تضارّ ...
The clause «على الوارث مثل ذلك» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause (على المولود له رزقهنّ).
The clause «إن أرادا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause الوالدات يرضعن, and the clause «لا جناح عليهما» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ, and the clause «أردتم..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause إن أرادا.
The clause «فلا جناح عليكم» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause سلّمتم is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the apodosis
is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. when you hand over, there is no blame on you.
The clause «أتيتم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «اتّقوا الله» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the first resumptive clause.
The clause «اعلموا..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the first resumptive clause.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (ما) [Note: Or it is the ṣila of the particle relative if (ما) is parsed as a maṣdar-forming particle.].

* Morphology:
(الوالدات): plural of الوالدة, the feminine of الوالد, an active participle for a qualified noun that is usually omitted, so the adjective has become like a noun because of the constant omission of the qualified noun.
(حولين): dual of حول, a non-derived noun meaning "year"; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(كاملين): dual of كامل, an active participle derived from كمل يكمل (see ayah 196).
(الرضاعة): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb رضع يرضع (category فرح, category ضرب and category فتح); its pattern is فعالة with fatḥa on the fāʾ, which may also take kasra ...
(المولود له): he is the father; the (ال) in المولود is the relative al (waṣliyya), and (مولود) is a passive participle that works like its passive verb.
(رزقهنّ): a maṣdar, or in the sense of "that which is provided", i.e. food.
(كسوتهنّ): maṣdar of كسا يكسو or كسا يكسي; its pattern is فعلة with kasra then sukūn; or in the sense of "that which clothes", i.e. the garment, in which case it is a noun.
(وسعها): a heard maṣdar of the verb وسع يسع (category فرح); its wāw may take any of the three vowels, and here it comes with ḍamma; its pattern is فعل.
(الوارث): an active participle from ورث يرث (category وثق); its pattern is فاعل.
(فصالا): a heard maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb فاصل, meaning "to separate from"; its pattern is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ; the regular maṣdar is المفاصلة; here it means weaning.
(تراض): maṣdar of تراضى; it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion because it is a defective noun (manqūṣ), i.e. التراضي. By rule the letter before the last should take ḍamma because the verb begins with a tāʾ, but because of the heaviness of ḍamma before yāʾ the letter came with kasra, so it became التراضي.
(تشاور): a regular maṣdar of the five-letter verb تشاور; its pattern is تفاعل with ḍamma on the ʿayn.
(أردتم): it contains iʿlāl by deletion: the verb is built on the sukūn because of its connection to the nominative pronoun, so the alif — the weak letter — was deleted to avoid the meeting of two sukūns; its pattern is أفلتم.

* Benefits:
1- The exceptive إلّا: it alone among the particles of exception is a particle, and it has three cases:
a- The excepted after it must be accusative.
b- It follows (the excepted-from) as a badal (substitute).
c- What follows it is parsed according to the governing words; this is the "emptied" exception (al-istithnāʾ al-mufarragh).
First: the first category, "what follows it must be accusative", has three cases:
The first: the excepted is connected (of the same kind) and placed later, and the statement is complete and affirmative, e.g.: «فشربوا منه إلا قليلا منهم».
The second: the excepted is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), e.g.: «ما لَهُمْ بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِلَّا اتِّباعَ الظَّنِّ», for following conjecture is not of the genus of knowledge.
The third: the excepted precedes that from which it is excepted, whether the statement is negative or affirmative.
As for following as a badal and the emptied exception, they will be discussed in other places in this book.
In the saying of the Exalted «لا تُكَلَّفُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا وُسْعَها», إلا here is a particle of restriction, because the statement is negative and that from which the exception is made is omitted, namely «شيئا».
2- لا تضارّ: a doubled imperfect verb in the jussive; it was given a fatḥa for its lightness. It may correctly take a kasra, treating it like the meeting of two sukūns.
Following the vowel of the verb's first radical is also correct, and the verse of Jarīr has been transmitted in all three ways:
فغضّ الطرف إنك من نمير ... فلا كعبا بلغت ولا كلابا
(Lower your gaze, for you are of Numayr: you have attained neither Kaʿb nor Kilāb.)

safi-cedvel:97-97.t:
* I'rab:
(قل): an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". (من): a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject), (كان): a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its ism is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (عدوا): the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative. (لجبريل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) عدو [Note: Or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (عدوّا).], the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa. (الفاء): causal. (إنّ): a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl), and (الهاء): a pronoun, the ism of inna. (نزّل): a past verb, and (الهاء): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (على قلب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نزّل), and (الكاف): a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (بإذن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نزّل), (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (مصدّقا): a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of the hāʾ in نزّله. (اللام): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (مصدّقا) [Note: Or the lām is redundant, for strengthening, and (ما) is the mafʿūl bihi of the active participle (مصدقا).], (بين): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما. (يدي): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, and (الهاء): muḍāf ilayhi, (الواو): conjunction. (هدى): conjoined to (مصدّقا), accusative like it, and likewise (بشرى); the sign of the accusative in both is the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif. (للمؤمنين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (هدى وبشرى).
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «من كان عدوّا» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
The clause «كان عدوّا ... » is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: The khabar may be the protasis and apodosis clauses together.].. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "then there is no ground for his enmity", or "then let him die of rage" ... etc.
The clause «إنّه نزّله ... » has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «نزّله على قلبك» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of (إنّ).

* Morphology:
(جبريل): a foreign (aʿjamī) noun, a diptote. The statement of whoever said that it is derived from الجبروت is far-fetched; likewise far-fetched is its being a compound of the annexation type, and that جبر means "servant" and ايل is one of the names of Allah the Exalted.. There are thirteen dialectal forms of جبريل, the most eloquent being جبريل on the measure of قنديل; among them is fatḥa on the jīm, and among them جبرئيل like سلسبيل ...
etc.
(إذن): a samāʿī (heard) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb أذن يأذن, paradigm فرح; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.
(بشرى): a noun meaning "gladdening news"; it has been used as a maṣdar, construed as a derived word, i.e. "giving glad tidings". Its pattern is فعلى, with ḍamma then sukūn.

* Benefits:
1- The imperfect verb is made jussive in three cases. The first: when it is preceded by one of the jussive particles that make one verb jussive. The second: when it is preceded by one of the conditional particles that make two imperfect verbs jussive: the protasis and its apodosis. The third: when it is the answer to a request. We find this detailed in the extended books of grammar.
2- جبريل: two words compounded, the first: جبر meaning "servant", and إيل meaning "God"; after compounding it becomes «جبرائيل» with some modification, and it means «عبد الله» (servant of God). [Translator's note: this benefit adopts the compound derivation that the author called far-fetched in the morphology section above; translated as written.]

safi-cedvel:234-234.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction, and (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), with an omitted muḍāf before it»; (يتوفّون) a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (من) a preposition and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nāʾib fāʿil; (الواو) a conjunction; (يذرون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (أزواجا) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (يتربّصن) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (النون) the fāʿil; (بأنفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يتربّصن) [Note: al-Jamal, in his Ḥāshiya on the Jalālayn, permitted the bāʾ to be redundant (zāʾida), with (أنفس) genitive in form and nominative in position, as a semantic tawkīd (emphasis) of the feminine-plural nūn in يتربّصن.], and (هنّ) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (أربعة) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to the verb يتربّصن; (أشهر) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الواو) a conjunction; (عشرا) conjoined to أربعة, accusative like it; (الفاء) a conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the sense of a condition, attached to the content of the apodosis; (بلغن) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (النون) the fāʿil; (أجل) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (هنّ) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا جناح عليكم) its i'rab has already been given [Note: In ayah 233.]; (في) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of lā [Note: It may be an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, and the clause after it its naʿt.]; (فعلن) like بلغن; (بأنفسهنّ) like the first, attached to (فعلن); (بالمعروف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of فعلن [Note: Or attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. they acted in a manner according to what is right.]; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the word of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to خبير [Note: Or a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive, attached to خبير.]; (تعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (خبير) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ — الله — nominative ...
The clause الذين يتوفّون.. has no grammatical position, being conjoined to an earlier resumptive clause..
The clause «يتوفّون..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يذرون..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «يتربّصن» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين) [Note: The clause may be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being (أزواجهم); in that case there is no need to assume an omitted muḍāf for the relative noun (الذين), and the resulting nominal clause is the khabar of the relative.].
The clause «بلغن ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «لا جناح عليكم has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «فعلن» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما) [Note: Or in the position of genitive as an adjective of (ما) taken as an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective.].
The clause «الله.. خبير» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (ما) [Note: Or it is the ṣila of the particle relative (ما), since it is a maṣdar-forming particle.].

* Morphology:
(يتوفّون): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the weak letter — the final radical of the word — was deleted because it came quiescent before the quiescent wāw of the plural; its pattern is يتفعّون, with fatḥa on the doubled ʿayn of the word as an indication of the deleted alif.
(يذرون): it contains iʿlāl by deletion; its original form is يوذرون because its past is وذر; its first radical was deleted for heaviness; its pattern is يعلون with fatḥa on the ʿayn. It is from the fourth category, فرح يفرح, or (like) وسع يسع. Its past is not used by the Arabs, and likewise its maṣdar and its active participle; so one does not say وذر on the pattern of شهم, nor واذر, but rather ترك and تارك. And one says: ذره تركا, and يذره تركا [Note: From Lisān al-ʿArab, adapted.].
(عشرا): its form came masculine because its specified noun is feminine, namely (الليالي, the nights), since they are the basis in reckoning days.
(خبير): its morphology is like that of بصير (see ayah 233).

* Benefits:
1- «الَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنْكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْواجاً يَتَرَبَّصْنَ».
There are many differing views on the i'rab of this ayah from numerous leading grammarians and lexicographers; we summarize the most important of them as follows:
a- Sībawayh: holds that «الذين is in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ», its khabar omitted, its implied form being «نتلو عليكم حكمهم» (we recite to you their ruling).
b- al-Zamakhsharī: «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf: «وأزواج الذين».
c- al-Mubarrad: made the clause يتربصن the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the implied form being «أزواجهم يتربصن»

safi-cedvel:250-250.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (لمّا) its i'rab was given in the previous verse; (برزوا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (لجالوت) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (برزوا) «[Note: It may be attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (برزوا), i.e. "prepared for Goliath."]», and the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa, since it is a diptote; (الواو) conjunction; (جنود) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to جالوت, genitive (majrūr) like it, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (قالوا) like برزوا; (ربّ) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb), with the vocative particle omitted, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أفرغ) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you"; (على) preposition and (نا) a pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to (أفرغ); (صبرا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (ثبت) like أفرغ; (أقدام) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (انصر) like أفرغ, and (نا) mafʿūl bihi; (على القوم) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (انصرنا); (الكافرين) naʿt (adjective) of القوم, genitive like it, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ.
The clause «برزوا ...» is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قالوا..» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «النداء: ربّنا..» is in the position of an accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أفرغ..» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative (resumptive).
The clause «ثبّت أقدامنا» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أفرغ.
The clause «انصرنا..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أفرغ.

* Morphology:
(صبرا): maṣdar (verbal noun) of صبر يصبر, of the bāb ضرب; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(القوم): a collective noun (ism jamʿ) with no singular from its own root; its plurals are أقوام, أقاوم (with fatḥa on the hamza), أقائم and أقاويم (see verse 60).

safi-cedvel:251-251.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (هزموا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma..
and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بإذن) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (هزموهم) «[Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of هزموهم.]»; (الله) the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (قتل) past verb; (داود) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), barred from tanwīn because it is a proper name and foreign; (جالوت) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (آتاه) past verb and its object; (الله) the Divine Name, fāʿil, nominative; (الملك) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (علّمه) like آتاه; (من) preposition and (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to (علّمه); (يشاء) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "he", i.e. Allah. (الواو) resumptive; (لولا) a particle of non-occurrence due to the existence [of something] — a non-jussive condition; (دفع) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and the khabar (predicate) is obligatorily omitted, its implied form being "موجود" (exists); (الله) the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الناس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, governed by the maṣdar (verbal noun) دفع; (بعض) badal (substitute) of الناس, accusative like it; (ببعض) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the maṣdar دفع, and the bāʾ is for transitivity; (اللام) occurring in the apodosis (jawāb) of لولا; (فسد) past verb, and (التاء) the tāʾ of the feminine; (الأرض) fāʿil, nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (لكنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for rectification (istidrāk); (الله) the Divine Name, the noun of لكنّ, accusative; (ذو) khabar of لكنّ, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw because it is one of the five — or six — nouns; (فضل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (على العالمين) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (فضل), the maṣdar, and the sign of the genitive is the yāʾ, since it is treated like the sound masculine plural.
The clause «هزموهم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied clause, i.e. "So Allah answered them, and they defeated them."
The clause «قتل داود ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هزموهم.
The clause «آتاه الله..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هزموهم.
The clause «علّمه..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هزموهم.
The clause «يشاء» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «دفع الله» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «فسدت الأرض» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «لكنّ الله ذو فضل» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the last resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(داود): a foreign proper name.
(دفع): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb دفع; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:252-252.t:
* I'rab:
(تي) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn that appears on the yāʾ, which was dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns, in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (آيات) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ); (الله) the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (نتلو) imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the wāw.. and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "we", for majesty, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (على) preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نتلوها); (بالحقّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), either of the fāʿil of نتلو, or of its object, or of the genitive pronoun in (عليك), i.e. "clothed with the truth" (ملتبسين بالحقّ, ملتبسة بالحقّ or ملتبسا بالحقّ respectively); (الواو) conjunction; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الكاف) an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative as the noun of إنّ; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), conveying emphasis; (من المرسلين) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar.
The clause «تلك آيات الله..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «نتلوها» is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl of آيات الله.
The clause «إنّك لمن المرسلين» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(المرسلين): plural of المرسل, passive participle of the verb أرسل built for the passive; its pattern is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:184-184.t:
* I'rab:
(أيّاما) an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), governed by an omitted verb whose implied form is صوموا (fast) «[Note: It is permissible to make it a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa), because the verb صام, though intransitive, is treated as transitive owing to the adverb's connection with it and its inseparability from it. It is also permissible to make (أياما) accusative by the maṣdar (الصيام), as an adverb or as an object, and this is the choice of Sībawayh; but Abū Ḥayyān rejected it because of the presence of an extraneous separator between the maṣdar and what it governs.]», (معدودات), naʿt (adjective) of (أياما), accusative like it, the sign of its accusative being the kasra; (الفاء) conjunction; (من) a jussivizing conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (كان) a defective past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive as protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the noun of kāna is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو), referring to من; (من) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the noun of kāna; (مريضا) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative; (أو) a conjunction; (على سفر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted element conjoined to the khabar of kāna, i.e. كان موجودا على سفر (was on a journey); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (عدّة) mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being: عليه عدّة (upon him is a number). There is in it the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. عليه صيام عدّة (upon him is the fasting of a number); (من أيّام) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of عدّة; (أخر) naʿt of أيام, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa because it is a diptote, on account of being an adjective and of deflection (al-ʿadl). (الواو) conjunction; (على) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar fronted before فدية; (يطيقون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi, and there is in it the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. يطيقون صيامه (they are able to fast it); (فدية) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (طعام) badal (substitute) of فدية, nominative like it «[Note: Or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هي (it), and the clause is a naʿt of فدية in the position of nominative.]», (مسكين) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (الفاء) conjunction; (من) like the first; (تطوّع) a past verb in the position of jussive as protasis, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (خيرا) accusative by removal of the preposition «[Note: It is permissible for it to be a mafʿūl bihi of (تطوّع) ... see verse (158).]», (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (هو) a pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (خير) khabar, nominative; (اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt of خير «[Note: Or it is attached to خير, since it is an elative noun (ism tafḍīl).]», (الواو) conjunction; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (تصوموا) an imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تصوموا) is in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, i.e.: صيامكم (your fasting).
(خير) khabar, nominative; (لكم) like له, attached to an omitted naʿt of خير «[Note: Or it is attached to خير, since it is an elative noun.]», (إن) a jussivizing particle of condition; (كنتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as protasis.. and (تم) a pronoun, the noun of kāna; (تعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative..
And the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «من كان منكم مريضا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause كتب عليكم الصيام.
The clause «كان منكم مريضا» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ من.
The clause «(عليه) عدّة» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «على الذين.. فدية» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause من كان منكم.
The clause «يطيقونه» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «من تطوّع ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause على الذين.. فدية.
The clause «تطوّع خيرا» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ من.
The clause «هو خير له» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «تصوموا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative أن.
The nominal clause «صيامكم خير» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause من كان منكم ...
The clause «كنتم تعلمون» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تعلمون» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كنتم.. and the apodosis clause is indicated by the context of the speech, i.e.: if you know that it is better, then do it.

* Morphology:
(مريضا), an adjective resembling the active participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from مرض يمرض, of the class of فرح; its pattern is فعيل.
(سفر), a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb سفر يسفر, of the class of نصر; its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.
(عدّة), a noun meaning "number"; its pattern is فعلة, with kasra on the fāʾ, and its ʿayn and lām (second and third radicals) are identical.
(أخر), its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma on the fāʾ and fatḥa on the ʿayn, and it is deflected (maʿdūl) from آخر «[Note: With fatḥa on the hamza and the khāʾ and an alif between them, because it is the plural of أخرى, and أخرى is the feminine of آخر — with fatḥa. The rule for فعلى with ḍamma on the fāʾ, the feminine of أفعل, is that it is used only in construct with a definite noun or joined with the definite article. As for what has neither construct nor the article, its rule is أفعل, like أفضل ... i.e. it remains singular masculine.]»; for this reason it is made genitive with the fatḥa.
But if أخر — with ḍamma on the hamza and fatḥa on the khāʾ — is the plural of أخرى, the feminine of آخر — with kasra on the khāʾ — then it is fully declinable. You say مررت بأوّل وأخر, with full declension, since there is no deflection here «[Note: Summarised from Shudhūr al-Dhahab by Ibn Hishām, p. 552, third edition.]».
(فدية), a noun for what is given in place of the one ransomed; its pattern is فعلة, with kasra on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(طعام), a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar) from the quadriliteral أطعم, like العطاء in the sense of الإعطاء. Its regular maṣdar is الإطعام, but the number of the noun's letters fell short of its verb's letters, so it was a noun of maṣdar. الطعام is not the food eaten, because He put it in construct with المسكين, and the food does not belong to the poor person before he takes possession of it; if it were taken in that sense it would be figurative, which is not impossible.
(خيرا), maṣdar of the verb خار يخير, of the class of ضرب; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(خير), an elative noun.. see verse (54) of this sūra.

safi-cedvel:185-185.t:
* I'rab:
(شهر) khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being تلك الأيام (those days) «[Note: It is permissible for it to be a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is (الذي أنزل فيه القرآن); and al-ʿUkbarī allowed the khabar to be His saying (فمن شهد منكم ...), with the fāʾ redundant in the khabar, because the mubtadaʾ is qualified by something carrying the meaning of condition, namely (الذي).]», (رمضان) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa because it is a diptote, on account of being a proper name and the added alif and nūn; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as naʿt (adjective) of شهر, or of رمضان, in which case it is in the position of genitive; (أنزل) a past verb in the passive; (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزل), (القرآن) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (هدى) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa; (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of هدى; (بيّنات) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to هدى by the wāw, accusative like it, the sign of its accusative being the kasra; (من الهدى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of بيّنات, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied on the alif; (الفرقان) conjoined to الهدى by the wāw, genitive like it; (الفاء) conjunction; (من) a jussivizing conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (شهد) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive as protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and the fāʿil (agent) is "he" (هو); (من) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the pronoun of شهد; (الشهر) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. دخول الشهر (the entry of the month), (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اللام) the jussivizing lām of command; (يصم) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial) «[Note: It is permissible for it to be a mafʿūl bihi (see footnote 1, verse 184).]», because it is the pronoun of the adverb, i.e. ليصم أيّامه (let him fast its days). (الواو) conjunction; (من كان مريضا ... أخر) its i'rab has passed «[Note: Verse (184), both words and clauses.]» (يريد) an imperfect verb, nominative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (بكم) like منكم, attached to (يريد), (اليسر) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negative; (يريد بكم العسر) like the preceding; (الواو) conjunction; (اللام) causal (li-l-taʿlīl); (تكملوا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the lām, the sign of its accusative being the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (العدّة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative by it; (الواو) conjunction; (لتكبّروا) like لتكملوا and conjoined to it; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi....
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تكملوا ...) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted verb conjoined to His saying يريد بكم اليسر ... i.e. ويعينكم لإكمال العدّة (and He helps you to complete the number).
(على) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle «[Note: It is permissible for it to be a relative in the position of genitive, attached to (تكبّروا), with the referent omitted, i.e.:
هداكموه (what He guided you to).]», (هدى) a past verb, indeclinable on the implied fatḥa, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما هداكم) is in the position of genitive by the preposition, attached to (تكبّروا), since it is made to include the meaning of تحمدوه (praise Him) for His guiding you.
(الواو) conjunction; (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, for hope (tarajjī), and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of laʿalla, (تشكرون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «شهر رمضان» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «أنزل فيه القرآن» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «من شهد ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «شهد منكم الشهر» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «يصمه» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يريد الله ...» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «لا يريد بكم العسر» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the causal clause.
The clause «تكملوا العدّة» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «تكبّروا الله» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second particle-relative (أن).
The clause «لعلّكم تشكرون» has no grammatical position, being causal, and conjoined as a cause to the interpreted maṣdars.
The clause «تشكرون» is in the position of nominative as khabar of laʿalla.

* Morphology:
(رمضان), a generic proper name (ʿalam jins) derived from الرمض, which is burning; its pattern is فعلان, with fatḥa on the fāʾ and the ʿayn.
(القرآن), originally a maṣdar (verbal noun) of قرأ in the sense of "gathered", or from القراءة (reading); then it became a proper name for the revealed Book. Its pattern is فعلان, with ḍamma then sukūn.
(الفرقان), here a maṣdar of فرق يفرق, of the class of نصر and the class of ضرب; it may be applied as an attribute to the Qur'an, and then it becomes an attribute of a proper name. Its pattern is فعلان, with ḍamma on the fāʾ (see verse 53 of this sūra).
(الشهر), a noun for the span of time between two new moons, or a noun for the new moon itself; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(يصمه), it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion, to suit the jussive; its origin is يصومه with sukūn on the wāw and the mīm; when two vowelless letters met, the weak letter was deleted. Its pattern is يفله.
(اليسر), a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb يسر ييسر, of the class of كرم; its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(العسر), a heard maṣdar of the verb عسر يعسر, of the class of فرح and the class of كرم; its pattern is فعل, with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(هداكم), it contains iʿlāl by qalb (conversion); its origin is هدي with a vowelled yāʾ: when the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa it was converted into an alif (see verse 2 of this sūra).

* Rhetoric:
Involution and evolution (al-laff wa-l-nashr): in His saying «يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ بِكُمُ الْيُسْرَ» etc. His saying «لِتُكْمِلُوا الْعِدَّةَ» is the reason for the command to observe the number; His saying «وَلِتُكَبِّرُوا اللَّهَ» is the reason for the command to make up (the missed days); and His saying «وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ» is for the dispensation and the facilitation.

safi-cedvel:23-23.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (إن) a jussive conditional particle. (كنتم) an incomplete past verb (kāna and its sisters), indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (التاء) is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as the noun of كان, and (الميم) is a particle for the masculine plural. (في ريب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of كان. (من) a preposition. (ما) relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive by (من), attached to (ريب) [Note: Or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (ريب).. (ما) may also be an indefinite noun described (nakira mawṣūfa), in which case the clause after it is its naʿt, in the position of the genitive.]. (نزّلنا) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (نا) is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent). (على عبد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نزّلنا), and (نا) is an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), in the position of the genitive.
(الفاء) linking the apodosis of the condition. (ائتوا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and (الواو) is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil. (بسورة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ائتوا). (من مثل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of سورة [Note: The pronoun in His saying (مثله) may refer back to what was sent down from Allah, in which case the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted adjective of (سورة), and (من) may be partitive or explicative. Or the pronoun may refer back to the Messenger ﷺ in His saying (عبدنا), in which case the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (ائتوا), and (من) is for the starting point (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya), i.e. "with a sūra coming from one who is in his condition of being an unlettered human being".], and (الهاء) is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) a conjunction. (ادعوا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and (الواو) is the fāʿil. (شهداء) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (كم) is muḍāf ilayhi. (من دون) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from شهداء. (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (إن كنتم) is parsed like the preceding. (صادقين) khabar of كنتم, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the yāʾ.
The clause «كنتم في ريب ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
The clause «نزّلنا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «ائتوا بسورة ...» is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ادعوا شهداءكم ...» is in the position of the jussive, conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «كنتم صادقين» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: It may be a badal (substitute) of the clause كنتم في ريب ...]; and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by the meaning of what precedes it, i.e. "if you are truthful in that Muḥammad said it of his own accord, then do this which has been demanded of you".

* Morphology:
(كنتم) contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion, to suit the indeclinability on the sukūn: the weak letter was deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, namely the sukūn of the weak letter and the sukūn of the nūn.
(فأتوا) its origin is ائتيوا.. It contains iʿlāl by deletion after iʿlāl by taskīn (making vowelless): the ḍamma was felt heavy on the yāʾ, so it was made vowelless and the vowel was transferred to the tāʾ before it; then the yāʾ was deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters; its pattern is افعوا. In the verb there is another deletion, namely the deletion of the hamzat al-waṣl (connecting hamza) after the coming of the fāʾ, and the writing of the second hamza was adjusted so that it is written on an alif.. This change is regular in every verb that begins with a hamzat al-waṣl followed by a second hamza: the hamzat al-waṣl is deleted when preceded by fāʾ or wāw, and then the second hamza is written on an alif.
(سورة) a primitive (jāmid) noun; its pattern is فعلة, with ḍamma then sukūn. The wāw is either radical or converted from a hamza.
(مثله) ṣifa mushabbaha (adjective resembling the participle) from the verb مثل يمثل, of the class of نصر; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.
(شهداء) plural of شهيد, ṣifa mushabbaha from شهد يشهد, of the class of فرح; its pattern is فعيل.
(ادعوا) contains iʿlāl carried over from the imperfect; its origin is تدعوون: the wāw was deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, then it was carried over to the imperative.
(صادقين) plural of صادق, active participle of صدق يصدق, of the class of نصر; its pattern is فاعل.

safi-cedvel:163-163.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): resumptive. (إله): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct). (إله): khabar (predicate), nominative. (واحد): a naʿt (adjective) of إله, nominative like it. (لا): the lā of generic negation. (إله): the noun (ism) of lā, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative; the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "موجود" or "معبود بحقّ". (إلّا): a particle of exception. (هو): a detached pronoun in the position of nominative, a badal (substitute) of the pronoun concealed in the khabar, or a badal of the position of lā and its noun, because its position is nominative. (الرحمن): khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو" «[Note: Or it is a third khabar of the mubtadaʾ (إلهكم).. and (رحيم) a fourth khabar.. In that case there is no clause.]». (الرحيم): second khabar of the omitted mubtadaʾ.
The clause «إلهكم إله واحد» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا إله إلا هو» is in the position of nominative as a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ إلهكم «[Note: It may be resumptive, with no grammatical position.]».
The clause « (هو) الرحمن» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun that is the badal.

* Morphology:
(واحد): a derived noun on the pattern فاعل, but it has the meaning of الأحد, i.e. the singular, unique one. Its verb is وحد بحد «[Translator's note: so in the source; presumably يحد]» of the pattern-class of ضرب, and its ʿayn may take a ḍamma in the past, irregularly (see verse 61 of this sūra).

* Benefits:
1- لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ: the scholars agree that the khabar of «لا» is omitted, its implied form being «حق» or «موجود», and they differ about the remaining parts of the clause «refer to the previous page». «لا» is parsed as the lā of generic negation, and «إله» is its noun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of accusative. The omission of its khabar is regular among the Ḥijāzīs, as in: لا بأس, and لا حول ولا قوة, and as in لا فتى إلا علي ولا سيف إلا ذو الفقار.

safi-cedvel:164-164.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ): a particle resembling the verb (of inna and its sisters), for emphasis. (في خلق): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). (السموات): muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (الأرض): conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السموات by the wāw, genitive like it. (الواو): conjunction. (اختلاف): conjoined to خلق, genitive like it. (الليل): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (النهار): conjoined to الليل by the wāw, genitive like it. (الواو): conjunction. (الفلك): conjoined to خلق, genitive like it. (التي): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of الفلك. (تجري): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هي". (في البحر): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تجري) «[Note: It may be attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of تجري.]». (الباء): a preposition. (ما): a relative noun «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, the clause after it being its naʿt.]», indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of تجري, i.e. "accompanied by what benefits people". (ينفع): an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (الناس): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (الواو): conjunction. (ما): a relative noun conjoined to خلق, in the position of genitive. (أنزل): a past verb. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative. (من السماء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزل). (من ماء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the object of أنزل, i.e. "what Allah sent down from the sky, it being water" «[Note: The preposition and its genitive noun (من ماء) may be parsed as in the position of genitive as a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) of السماء, on the basis that the first (من) is explicative, not for the beginning of the extent, the first genitive phrase being attached to a ḥāl of the object of أنزل.]». (الفاء): conjunction. (أحيا): a past verb, indeclinable on an implied fatḥa on the alif; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", i.e. Allah. (الباء): a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (أحيا). (الأرض): mafʿūl bihi. (بعد): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (أحيا). (موت): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (ها) muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو): conjunction. (بث): a past verb; the fāʿil is "هو". (في): a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (بث). (من كلّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of the object of بث. (دابّة): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو): conjunction. (تصريف): conjoined to خلق, genitive like it. (الرياح): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (السحاب): conjoined to الرياح by the wāw, genitive like it. (المسخّر): a naʿt of السحاب, genitive like it. (بين): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (المسخّر), since it is a passive participle. (السماء): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الأرض): conjoined to السماء by the wāw, genitive like it. (اللام): the lām of the beginning (lām al-ibtidāʾ), for emphasis. (آيات): the delayed noun (ism) of inna, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra. (لقوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of آيات, i.e. "clear signs for a people".. (يعقلون): an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «إن في خلق.. لآيات» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تجري» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of (التي).
The clause «ينفع..» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the first (ما).
The clause «أنزل الله» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second (ما).
The clause «أحيا» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أنزل الله.
The clause «بثّ» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أحيا.
The clause «يعقلون» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of قوم.

* Morphology:
(خلق): a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb خلق يخلق of the pattern-class of نصر; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(اختلاف): a regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar of the five-letter verb اختلف; its pattern is افتعال, on the pattern of its past with a kasra on its third letter and the addition of an alif before its last letter.
(الليل): a noun for the time extending from sunset to the rising of dawn; its plural is الليالي with the addition of the yāʾ irregularly, and it is also pluralised as ليائل..
It is said that it is a collective noun (ism jamʿ) whose singular is ليلة; and it is said rather that الليلة is like الليل, just as one says العشيّ and العشيّة.
(النهار): a noun for what is between the rising of dawn and sunset, or from sunrise to sunset; its plural is أنهر with a ḍamma on the hāʾ, and نهر with a ḍamma on the nūn and the hāʾ.
(الفلك): a non-derived (jāmid) noun meaning "vessel"; it is singular and plural in one form. The فلك indicating the singular is in the words of the Exalted: الفلك المشحون, and the one indicating the plural is what comes in this verse. Its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.
(دابّة): feminine of دابّ, an active participle from the triliteral دبّ; its pattern is فاعل, and it has been used as a noun meaning "animal".
(تصريف): a regular maṣdar from the quadriliteral صرّف; its pattern is تفعيل, formed from its past by adding a tāʾ at its beginning, removing the doubling and adding a yāʾ before its last letter.
(الرياح): plural of ريح. It contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its original form is روح — with a kasra on the rāʾ and sukūn on the wāw — because it is from راح يروح: the wāw came with sukūn after a kasra, so it was changed into yāʾ, and it remained so in the plural. Its pattern in the singular is فعل with a kasra on the fāʾ, and in the plural فعال, also with a kasra on the fāʾ.
(السحاب): a collective noun whose singular is سحابة, derived from السحب, i.e. dragging; its pattern is فعال; its plural is سحب with two ḍammas, and سحائب is the plural of سحابة.
(المسخّر): a passive participle from the quadriliteral سخّر; its pattern is مفعّل with a fatḥa on the doubled ʿayn.

* Benefits:
1- الفلك: it comes as a singular and comes as a plural; it is treated as masculine when singular and as feminine when a broken plural.
2- لآيات: the noun of inna, and the shifted lām (lām al-muzaḥlaqa) gives emphasis; it has come at the beginning of the noun because the noun is delayed, and its proper place is to shift to the beginning of the khabar.
The preposition and its genitive noun at the beginning of the verse are attached to the omitted khabar of inna; the implied form is «إن آيات كائنة في خلق السماوات والأرض to the end ... ».
3- الريح is pluralised as رياح and أرواح; its root has wāw, not yāʾ, and therefore it occurs in the poetry of Maysūn bint Jandal:
وبيت تخفق الأرواح فيه ... أحب إلي من قصر منيف
(A house in which the winds flutter is dearer to me than a lofty palace.)

safi-cedvel:165-165.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (من الناس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). (من): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject) «[Note: It may be an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, the clause after it being in the position of nominative as its naʿt (adjective).]». (يتّخذ): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". (من دون): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يتّخذ) «[Note: The preposition and its genitive noun may be attached to an omitted naʿt of the second object, i.e. "he takes idols as gods counted apart from Allah"; what we have set down above is based on making the verb (يتّخذ) transitive to one object.]». (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct), genitive (majrūr). (أندادا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (يحبّون): an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil, and (هم) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi. (كحبّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). (الله): like the first. (الواو): parenthetical. (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. (آمنوا): a past verb and its fāʿil. (أشد): khabar, nominative. (حبّا): tamyīz (specification), accusative. (لله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (حبّا). (الواو): conjunction. (لو): a non-jussive conditional. (يرى): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma. (الذين): a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil. (ظلموا): like آمنوا. (إذ): an adverb for future time, borrowed from the past, in the position of accusative, attached to (يرى). (يرون): an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. (العذاب): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (أنّ): a particle resembling the verb (of inna and its sisters). (القوّة): the noun (ism) of anna, accusative. (لله): like the previous one, attached to an omitted khabar of anna. (جميعا): ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of the pronoun concealed in the khabar.
The interpreted maṣdar from أنّ, its noun and its khabar stands in place of the two objects of the omitted علموا.. which is the apodosis of لو, i.e. "لو يرى الذين ظلموا العذاب لعلموا أنّ القوّة لله جميعا". (الواو): conjunction. (أنّ الله): like أنّ القوة. (شديد): khabar, nominative. (العذاب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The second interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first interpreted maṣdar.
The clause «من الناس من يتّخذ» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause in the previous verse.
The clause «يتّخذ» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of (من).
The clause «يحبّونهم» is in the position of accusative as a naʿt of (أندادا) «[Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of يتّخذ, construed according to the meaning of من.]».
The clause «الذين آمنوا» has no grammatical position: parenthetical.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position: ṣila of (الذين).
The clause «يرى الذين» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause «من الناس من ... ».
The clause «ظلموا» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second (الذين).
The clause «يرون العذاب» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.

* Morphology:
(يتّخذ): its past is اتّخذ.. It contains the substitution of the hamza — which is the fāʾ of the word — by a yāʾ, then its change into a tāʾ and its assimilation with the tāʾ of the iftiʿāl form; its original form is (ائتخذ), and its bare triliteral is أخذ. This is the view of al-Jawharī, and it differs from the view of Ibn al-Athīr, for whom the bare form is تخذ, so the tāʾ is radical and was assimilated with the tāʾ of iftiʿāl. Its pattern is افتعل in any case (verse 80 of the sūra).
(أندادا): plural of ندّ; its pattern is فعل with a kasra on the fāʾ; a derived adjective from ندّ يندّ of the pattern-class of ضرب.
(حبّ): the heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of حبّ; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.
(يرون): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the lām of the word — the alif — was dropped because it came with sukūn before the wāw of the plural, which also has sukūn; then the letter before the wāw was given a fatḥa to indicate the dropped alif. The hamza — the ʿayn of the word — had already been dropped for lightening before it was attached to the wāw of the plural. Its pattern is يفون with a fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(جميعا): a noun taken from الجمع, so it is فعيل; it is like a collective noun (ism jamʿ), so it is sometimes treated as a singular, as in the words of the Exalted: نحن جميع منتصر, and sometimes treated as a plural, as in the words of the Exalted: جَمِيعٌ لَدَيْنا مُحْضَرُونَ. In its i'rab it may be accusative as a ḥāl, and it may be made to follow what precedes it as tawkīd (emphasis) in the sense of كلّ (see verse 29).
(شديد): a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) from شدّ يشدّ of the pattern-class of نصر and the pattern-class of ضرب, and from the second it is more evident; its pattern is فعيل.

* Rhetoric:
1- «وَلَوْ يَرَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا», i.e. if these «الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا» knew, by the said taking,. The overt noun has been put in the place of the pronoun to indicate that this — taking — «وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَتَّخِذُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ» — is a great wrong (ẓulm).
2- Concision (ījāz): in the verse, by omission of the apodosis of لو; this is frequent and widespread in their speech and occurs often in the Qur'an.

* Benefits:
1- أَشَدُّ حُبًّا: حبّا is parsed as a tamyīz, since every accusative noun after an elative (afʿal al-tafḍīl) is parsed as a tamyīz.
2- The word «دون» is an adverb meaning "beneath", but it comes with other meanings known from the context of speech: it comes meaning "in front of", "behind", "inferior" and "other than", and it mostly occurs in the genitive with «من».

safi-cedvel:206-206.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb (أخذته); (قيل) a passive past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is the clause اتّق الله, as will come; (اللام) preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive (majrūr), attached to (قيل); (اتّق) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you); (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (أخذ) past verb, and (التاء) the tāʾ of the feminine, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (العزّة) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (بالإثم) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), either of العزّة, i.e. "bound up with sin", or of the hāʾ that is the object, i.e. "bound up with sin"; the bāʾ may also be causal, in which case the preposition is attached to the verb أخذ, i.e. "pride seized him because of sin". (الفاء) resumptive; (حسب) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (جهنّم) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (اللام) occurring in the answer to an omitted oath; (بئس) an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; (المهاد) the fāʿil of biʾsa, nominative. The one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, and it is جهنّم.
The clause «قيل ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the condition, its protasis and its apodosis are either resumptive or conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause) clause يعجبك [Note: In ayah (204) of this sūra.]. The clause «اتق الله» is in the position of genitive nominative as nāʾib fāʿil [Translator's note: the source reads «في محلّ جرّ رفع»; "in the position of nominative" is evidently meant.] [Note: This is contrary to the opinion of the majority, who hold that the nāʾib fāʿil is implied, i.e. "the saying".. but there is no need for that because the clause is originally the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) by the verb in the active voice.].
The clause «أخذته العزّة» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «حسبه جهنّم» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «بئس المهاد..» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the oath.

* Morphology:
(العزّة): maṣdar (verbal noun) of عزّ يعزّ, of the pattern (bāb) ضرب; its wazn is فعلة with kasra then sukūn.
(جهنّم): an underived (jāmid) noun for the abode of punishment; its wazn is فعنّل with fatḥa on the fāʾ and the ʿayn and doubling of the nūn, the second nūn being extra, like علّس [Translator's note: so in the source; the word usually cited is جهنّام / بئر جهنّم.], the one far in depth, and that is why it was so named.
(المهاد): either the plural of مهد, or it is singular meaning "bed".

safi-cedvel:207-207.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (من الناس من يشري) like the i'rab of its counterpart that came before «1»; (نفس) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ابتغاء) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), accusative; (مرضاة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (رؤف) khabar (predicate), nominative; (بالعباد) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) رؤوف.
The clause «من الناس» من يشري is conjoined to the clause من الناس من يقول «2».
The clause «يشري..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «الله رؤف بالعباد» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(نفس): a noun indicating the self, the body or the soul.
It is feminine if the soul is meant, and masculine if the person or the self is meant; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn (see ayah 48 of this sūra).
(ابتغاء): it contains the substitution of hamza for yāʾ because it came at the end after a quiescent alif; its original is ابتغاي, because the verb is ابتغى يبتغي. Its wazn is افتعال, because the substitution changes nothing of the wazn.
(مرضاة): it contains a change (iʿlāl) by substitution; its original is مرضية with fatḥa on the yāʾ, preceded by a ḍād with fatḥa, so the yāʾ was changed to alif to match the vowel of what precedes it, and it became مرضاة; its wazn is مفعلة, and it is a mīm-maṣdar from رضي.

safi-cedvel:208-208.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) vocative particle; (أيّ) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative (manṣūb), and (ها) a particle of alerting with no grammatical position; (الذين) badal (substitute) of أيّ, in the position of accusative [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere such a badal is usually said to be in the position of nominative, following the wording of أيّ.]; (آمنوا) past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (ادخلوا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter [Translator's note: so in the source; ادخلوا is indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.], and the wāw is the fāʿil; (في السلم) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ادخلوا); (كافّة) ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in (ادخلوا), or ḥāl of السلم, i.e. in all its aspects and laws; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, making the verb jussive; (تتّبعوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (خطوات) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra in place of the fatḥa, for it is a sound feminine plural; (الشيطان) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna; (اللام) preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl of عدوّ — an adjective placed before what it qualifies; (عدوّ) khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ); (مبين) naʿt (adjective) of عدوّ, nominative like it.
The vocative clause «يأيّها الذين..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «ادخلوا في السلم» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative (resumptive).
The clause «لا تتّبعوا خطوات» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ادخلوا في السلم.
The clause «إنّه لكم عدو» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).

* Morphology:
(السلم): a maṣdar (verbal noun) meaning المسالمة (making peace), or it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar) from the verb سالم; its wazn is فعل with kasra then sukūn, and the fāʾ may take fatḥa; it is treated as masculine and feminine.
(كافّة): a maṣdar meaning "the group" or "all", on the wazn of the active participle from كفّ; it is not annexed and does not take al-, and it is used in the singular, so it is not made dual or plural..

safi-cedvel:209-209.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction; (إن) a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive; (زللتم) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (تم) is the fāʿil (agent); (من بعد) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (زللتم); (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (جاء) past verb, and (التاء) the tāʾ of the feminine, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (البيّنات) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما جاءتكم) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
(الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اعلموا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of anna, accusative (manṣūb); (عزيز) khabar (predicate), nominative; (حكيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar from (أنّ), its noun and its khabar takes the place of the two objects of اعلموا.
The clause «إن زللتم..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ادخلوا in the previous ayah, because it is within the scope of the vocative.
The clause «جاءتكم البيّنات» has a position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (ما). [Translator's note: The source reads «محلّ لها صلة» ("has a position, ṣila"); by the book's usual pattern «لا محلّ لها» ("has no grammatical position") is intended.]
The clause «اعلموا..» is a causal explanation for the implied apodosis indicated by the content of His saying, the Exalted: إن الله عزيز حكيم, i.e.: "If you slip.. then await His punishment, for Allah is Mighty in His retribution, Wise in His undoing and His settling (of matters)."

* Rhetoric:
1- «فَإِنْ زَلَلْتُمْ», i.e. you turned away from entering «في السلم» and kept aside; its original meaning is falling, and what was mentioned is meant by it figuratively (majāz).

safi-cedvel:210-210.t:
* I'rab:
(هل) an interrogative particle meaning negation, so it indicates a disapproving (inkārī) question; (ينظرون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (يأتي) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; in the speech there is an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "the command of Allah comes" or "His punishment".
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يأتي) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, i.e.: they await the coming of punishment from Allah.
(في ظلل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يأتي) or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil; (من الغمام) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ظلل, or to the verb يأتي, i.e. from the direction of the clouds; (الواو) conjunction; (الملائكة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the Name of Majesty, nominative like it. (الواو) resumptive or a conjunction; (قضي) passive past verb; (الأمر) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (الواو) resumptive; (إلى الله) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ترجع), which is a passive past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; ترجع is an imperfect (muḍāriʿ) verb.]; (الأمور) nāʾib fāʿil, nominative.
The clause «ينظرون» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يأتيهم الله» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (أنّ) [Translator's note: so in the source; the particle in the ayah is أن.].
The clause «قضي الأمر» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: Or conjoined to the clause يأتيهم الله, with no grammatical position, because it falls within the scope of the awaiting.].
The clause «ترجع الأمور» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(ظلل): plural of ظلّة, a noun for that by means of which one seeks shade; its wazn is فعلة with ḍamma on the fāʾ, and its plural is فعل with ḍamma then fatḥa.
(الغمام): an underived (jāmid) noun for what covers and veils, i.e. clouds; its wazn is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ, and it is the plural of غمامة.
(قضي): the alif was changed to yāʾ because what precedes it takes kasra in the passive.
(الأمر): maṣdar (verbal noun) of أمر يأمر, of the pattern (bāb) نصر; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- «إِلَّا أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ»: the shift (iltifāt) to the third person in the ayah is to announce that the evil of their deeds requires turning away from them.
2- Metonymic trope (majāz mursal): in His saying, the Exalted, «فِي ظُلَلٍ مِنَ الْغَمامِ», its relationship is causality, because clouds are the likely place of mercy or punishment and their cause: from them the rains pour down, and destructive, sweeping floods may arise.

safi-cedvel:253-253.t:
* I'rab:
