The clause «أتمّوا الصيام» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the second resumptive clause.
(الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, jussivizing; (تباشروا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn ...
and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (هنّ) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (أنتم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (عاكفون) khabar, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw; (في المساجد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عاكفون), (تي) a demonstrative, indeclinable on the sukūn appearing on the yāʾ that is deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (حدود) khabar, nominative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition; (لا) prohibitive, jussivizing; (تقربوها) like تباشروهنّ.
The clause «لا تباشروهنّ» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the second resumptive clause.
The clause «أنتم عاكفون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «تلك حدود..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause لا تقربوها has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if you want obedience, then do not approach them.
(الكاف) a preposition of likening «[Note: Or a noun meaning مثل (like), in the position of accusative as naʿt of an omitted maṣdar, its implied form being بيانا مثل هذا البيان (an explanation like this explanation).]», (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its implied form being بيانا (an explanation); (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (يبيّن) an imperfect verb, nominative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (آيات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the kasra, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يبيّن), (لعلّهم يتّقون) like لعلّكم تشكرون «[Note: In verse (185) of this sūra.]». The clause يبيّن الله has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause لعلّهم يتّقون has no grammatical position, being causal.
The clause يتّقون is in the position of nominative as khabar of laʿalla.

* Morphology:
(الرفث), a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb رفث يرفث, of the class of نصر; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas; or it is of the class of ضرب.
(لباس), a primitive (jāmid) noun for what is worn, from the verb لبس يلبس, of the class of فرح; its pattern is فعال, with kasra on the fāʾ. Its plural is لبس, with ḍamma then sukūn, and ألبسة, with fatḥa on the hamza and kasra on the bāʾ.
(تختانون), the word contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by qalb (conversion); its origin is تختونون with kasra on the first wāw, its bare form being خان يخون: the wāw was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into an alif, in the past and the imperfect ...
(تاب), it contains iʿlāl by qalb, the alif being converted from a wāw; its imperfect is يتوب and its maṣdar توبا and توبة. The wāw was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was converted into an alif; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas (see verse 37 of this sūra).
(عفا), it contains iʿlāl by qalb, in the same way as تاب.
(ابتغوا), it contains iʿlāl by making vowelless and iʿlāl by deletion. Its origin is ابتغيوا, with ḍamma on the yāʾ, the lām (third radical) of the verb, which came as the fifth letter; then it was made vowelless as its vowel was transferred to the letter before it, then it was deleted because it met, vowelless, with the vowelless wāw of the plural.
(الخيط), originally it is the maṣdar of the verb خاط خيط «[Translator's note: so in the source; the imperfect is يخيط.]», of the class of ضرب; then it was used as a primitive noun for a strand of linen, silk, hemp or other material.. In the noble verse it came in the sense of the whiteness of the morning or the blackness of the night. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(الأبيض), an adjective resembling the active participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) from the triliteral بيض يبيض, of the class of فرح; its pattern is أفعل.
(الأسود), an adjective resembling the active participle from the triliteral سود يسود, of the class of فرح; its pattern is أفعل.
(الفجر), originally a maṣdar from فجر يفجر, of the class of نصر; then it came to be applied to the light of morning. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(عاكفون), plural of عاكف, active participle from the triliteral عكف; its pattern is فاعل.
(حدود), plural of حدّ, a heard maṣdar of the verb حدّ يحدّ, of the class of نصر; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn, and its ʿayn and lām (second and third radicals) are the same letter. The pattern of حدود is فعول, with ḍamma on the fāʾ.

* Rhetoric:
1- «هُنَّ لِباسٌ لَكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ لِباسٌ لَهُنَّ».
That is, they are a repose for you and you are a repose for them. Since the man and the woman embrace each other and each of them wraps around the other, each one, in relation to the other, was likened to a garment; or because each of them covers the other and keeps him from immorality. This is by way of metonymy (al-kināya).
2- His saying «مِنَ الْفَجْرِ» is an explanation of the white thread, and it sufficed in place of explaining the black thread, because explaining one of them is an explanation of the other. If you say: is this a case of metaphor (istiʿāra) or of simile (tashbīh)?
I say: His saying «مِنَ الْفَجْرِ» took it out of the category of metaphor, just as your saying:
"I saw a lion" is figurative; but if you add "of so-and-so", it reverts to a simile. If you say: then why was «مِنَ الْفَجْرِ» added so that it became a simile? Why was it not confined to metaphor, which is more eloquent than simile and more deeply rooted in fluency? I say: because it is a condition of the borrowed term that the situation or the speech indicate it; had «مِنَ الْفَجْرِ» not been mentioned, it would not have been known that the two threads are borrowed terms. So «مِنَ الْفَجْرِ» was added, and it became an eloquent simile (tashbīh balīgh) and ceased to be a metaphor.
3- Antithesis (al-ṭibāq): because He set black against white; as for mentioning the rest of the colours, that is called tadbīj (colour-embroidery).
4- «الرفث» in the verse is a metonymy for sexual intercourse.

safi-cedvel:254-254.t:
* I'rab:
(يا) vocative particle; (أيّ) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative, and (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (الذين) a relative noun, badal (substitute) of أيّ, in the position of an accusative; (آمنوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (أنفقوا) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (من) preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنفقوا) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted word which is originally a naʿt (adjective) of the implied object of أنفقوا, i.e. "spend something of what We have provided you."]»; (رزقنا) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. (ونا) a pronoun, fāʿil, and (كم) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من قبل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنفقوا); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle; (يأتي) imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb); (يوم) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يأتي) is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
(لا) negative, without governing effect (muhmala) «[Note: Or it governs like ليس.]»; (بيع) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative «[Note: Or it is the noun of لا, nominative.]»; (في) preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «[Note: Or to an omitted khabar of لا.]»; (الواو) conjunction; (لا خلّة) like لا بيع, and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "فيه"; (الواو) conjunction; (لا شفاعة) like لا بيع, and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "فيه". (الواو) resumptive; (الكافرون) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw; (هم) a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) «[Note: It may be a second mubtadaʾ whose khabar is الظالمون.. and the clause هم الظالمون is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الكافرون).]»; (الظالمون) khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the wāw.
The clause «يأيّها ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «أنفقوا» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative (resumptive).
The clause «رزقناكم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «يأتي يوم» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «لا بيع فيه» is in the position of a nominative as a naʿt of يوم.
The clause «لا خلّة ...» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause لا بيع فيه.
The clause «لا شفاعة» is in the position of a nominative, conjoined to the clause لا بيع فيه.
The clause «الكافرون.. الظالمون» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(ممّا): two words: من and ما. The nūn of the genitive-governing (من) is dropped «[Translator's note: the source has a stray closing parenthesis here.]», and likewise that of (عن), when (ما) follows them, whatever its type.
(بيع): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb باع يبيع, of the bāb ضرب; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(خلّة): a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar) from the verb خالّه, i.e. he befriended him; so it has the meaning of friendship, as though it permeates (تتخلّل) the limbs, i.e. enters between them. It may have the meaning of the active participle, i.e. مصادق (a friend), with kasra on the dāl, or the meaning of the passive participle, i.e. مصادق (one befriended), with fatḥa on the dāl. The pattern of خلّة is فعلة, with ḍamma then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:255-255.t:
* I'rab:
(الله) the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (لا) the lā of generic negation; (إله) the noun of لا, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative, and the khabar (predicate) of لا is omitted, its implied form being "موجود" (exists); (إلّا) particle of exception; (هو) a pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative as badal (substitute) of the pronoun concealed in the khabar «[Note: Or a badal of the position of لا together with its noun, whose position is nominative.]»; (الحيّ) second khabar, nominative «[Note: Or it is a naʿt (adjective), or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ implied as هو, or it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause لا تأخذه, or it is a badal of هو.. and likewise القيّوم.]»; (القيّوم) third khabar, nominative; (لا) negative; (تأخذ) imperfect verb, nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (سنة) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation; (نوم) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to سنة, nominative like it; (اللام) preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative as a postponed mubtadaʾ; (في السموات) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) like the first, and conjoined to it; (في الأرض) like في السموات; (من) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative as khabar; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative as badal of the demonstrative, or a naʿt «[Note: According to Abū Ḥayyān it is permissible — indeed preferable in his view — that (منذا) be in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the relative, because the meaning is completed by it.]»; (يشفع) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "he"; (عند) adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (يشفع) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun of يشفع.]»; (إلّا) particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (بإذن) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl, i.e. "no one intercedes except being impelled by His permission" or "being permitted" «[Note: It may be attached to (يشفع).]», and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (يعلم) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, implied as "he"; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (بين) adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila of ما; (أيدي) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the implied (muqaddar) kasra, and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) like the previous one, and conjoined to it; (خلف) adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted ṣila of ما, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (لا) negative; (يحيطون) imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بشيء) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يحيطون); (من علم) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of شيء, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (إلّا) particle of exception; (الباء) preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to what the previous prepositional phrase — بشيء — is attached to, because it is a badal of it «[Note: Or attached to an omitted excepted term, its implied form being: "except encompassing what He wills of what He knows."]»; (شاء) past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, implied as "he" «[Note: It is better to take the implied object of شاء as "that they encompass it", since His words ولا يحيطون indicate this.]»; (وسع) past verb; (كرسيّ) fāʿil, nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (السموات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of its accusative is the kasra; (الأرض) maʿṭūf to السموات by the wāw, accusative like it; (الواو) conjunction or circumstantial; (لا) negative; (يؤود) imperfect verb, nominative, and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi in the position of an accusative; (حفظ) fāʿil, nominative; (هما) an attached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (هو) a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; (العليّ) khabar, nominative; (العظيم) second khabar, nominative.
The clause «الله لا إله إلّا هو» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا إله إلّا هو» «[Translator's note: the closing quotation mark is missing in the source.]» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «لا تأخذه سنة» is in the position of a nominative as a fourth khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله) «[Note: Or in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in (القيّوم), i.e. "He maintains the affairs of creation without being heedless."]».
The clause «له ما في السموات..» is in the position of a nominative as a fifth khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «من ذا الذي يشفع ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يشفع» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «يعلم ما بين أيديهم» has no grammatical position: resumptive «[Note: Or in the position of a nominative as another khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).]».
The clause «لا يحيطون» has no grammatical position: resumptive; or it is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in أيديهم.
The clause «شاء» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «وسع كرسيّه» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا يؤوده حفظهما» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the last resumptive clause; or it is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «هو العليّ» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(الحيّ): one of the attributes of Allah; it is a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) from حيي يحيا, of the fourth bāb; its pattern is فعل, with sukūn on the ʿayn and fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(القيّوم): one of the intensive forms (ṣiyagh al-mubālagha); its pattern is فيعول. It contains a weak-letter change by substitution (iʿlāl bi-l-qalb): its origin is قيووم, because it is from قام بالأمر يقوم, when one manages it.. The yāʾ and the wāw came together in the word, the first of them having sukūn, so the wāw was changed into a yāʾ and assimilated into the other yāʾ, and it became القيّوم.
(سنة): it contains a weak-letter change by deletion (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf); it is from the verb وسن يسن, of the bāb ضرب; its fāʾ was dropped in the imperfect and in the maṣdar (verbal noun) سنة, just as one says عدة; its pattern is علة, with kasra on the ʿayn.
(نوم): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb نام ينام, of the bāb فتح; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn. «[Translator's note: the source says bāb فتح; نام ينام is ordinarily classed under bāb فرح (نَوِمَ يَنْوَمُ).]»
(كرسيّ): a non-derived (jāmid) noun. It is said its origin is from things being stacked one on another; from it comes الكرّاسة (booklet), because its leaves are stacked one on another, and the كرسيّ (chair) was so called because its pieces of wood are set one on another.. In al-Miṣbāḥ: "تكرّس فلان احطب «[Translator's note: so in the source; probably الحطب, "the firewood".]» and other things, when he gathered it", and from it comes الكرّاسة with the doubled letter. Its pattern is فعليل, with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(حفظ): it is the maṣdar of حفظ يحفظ, of the bāb فرح; its pattern is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.
(العليّ): a ṣifa mushabbaha from the verb علا يعلو. It contains a weak-letter change by substitution, because its origin is (عليو) with sukūn on the yāʾ; the yāʾ and the wāw came together in the word, the first of them having sukūn, so the wāw was changed into a yāʾ and assimilated into the other yāʾ. Its pattern is فعيل.

* Rhetoric:
Concision (al-ījāz): the Verse of the Throne (Āyat al-Kursī) contains such concision as leaves no hope for imitation or emulation. We may say that the expression has become one with what it expresses in depicting the true sovereignty that none disputes, in the most elegant phrasing and the most precise description. It also contains what is called disjunction (al-faṣl) in the science of meanings (ʿilm al-maʿānī), which is the omission of the conjunction, to indicate that each attribute of this most great «[Translator's note: the source reads العظم, probably for العظيم or الأعظم.]» Sovereign stands independently by itself.
It also contains the utmost concision, in that it comprises seventeen places in which the name of Allah the Exalted occurs — overt in some of them and concealed in others.

safi-cedvel:211-211.t:
* I'rab:
(سل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you); (بني) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ, for it is attached (mulḥaq) to the sound masculine plural; (إسرائيل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote, due to being a proper name and foreign; (كم) an interrogative noun, an allusion (kināya) to "many", indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi placed first because it has the right to head the clause; (آتينا) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (نا) is the fāʿil, and (هم) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi; (من آية) tamyīz (specification) of كم, and من is redundant (zāʾida) [Note: Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī said: When there is a separation between كم and its specifier, it is best to bring (من).]; (بيّنة) naʿt (adjective) of آية, genitive like it. (الواو) resumptive; (من) a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يبدّل) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he); (نعمة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (من بعد) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يبدّل); (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (جاء) past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هي" (it (fem.)); (التاء) the tāʾ of the feminine, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما جاءته) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
(الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (شديد) the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ); (العقاب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «سل بني إسرائيل» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «آتيناهم» has no grammatical position, being explicative or an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: Or it is the second mafʿūl bihi of (سل), even though it is not one of the verbs of the heart, because it is a cause of knowledge, and what is valid for the effect is valid for the cause.].
The clause «من يبدّل» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يبدّل نعمة الله» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من [Note: It is possible that the khabar is the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.].
The clause «جاءته» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «إنّ الله شديد العقاب» is a causal explanation for the implied apodosis, i.e. "whoever changes.. then Allah will punish him, because He is severe in punishment".

* Morphology:
(سل): it contains the deletion of the hamza, the second radical (ʿayn) of the verb, for lightening; its wazn is فل.
(بني): plural of ابن; see the inflection of ابن in ayah (20) of this sūra.
(نعمة): a noun for what is bestowed as a favour on a person, of provision and other things; its wazn is فعلة with kasra then sukūn.

* Benefits:
1- كم comes as interrogative or as declarative (khabariyya), and each has rulings specific to it. In this ayah we can count «من» as redundant, so كم is in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ or in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of the verb «آتينا». But if we take «من» as an explication (bayān) of «كم», then neither of the two preceding parsings is permissible.
Some have permitted the redundancy of «من» and restricted that to after the question with «هل» rather than [Translator's note: the source text breaks off here.]

safi-cedvel:212-212.t:
* I'rab:
(زيّن) passive past verb; (اللام) preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive (majrūr), attached to (mutaʿalliq) (زيّن); (كفروا) past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (الحياة) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (الدنيا) naʿt (adjective) of الحياة, nominative like it, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الواو) conjunction; (يسخرون) imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (من الذين) like للذين, attached to (يسخرون); (آمنوا) past verb and its fāʿil; (الواو) conjunction; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (اتّقوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the omitted alif..
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (فوق) adverb of place, accusative (manṣūb), attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (يوم) adverb of time, accusative, attached to the omitted khabar; (القيامة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (يرزق) imperfect verb, nominative; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (يشاء) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (He); (بغير) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of the maṣdar of يرزق, i.e. "He provides for him a provision bound up with no reckoning"; (حساب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «زيّن ...» الحياة has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «كفروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «يسخرون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause زيّن.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «الذين اتّقوا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «اتّقوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the third relative (الذين).
The clause «الله يرزق..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يرزق من يشاء» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.
The clause «يشاء» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (من), and the referent (ʿāʾid) is omitted together with the object, i.e. "He wills to provide for him".

* Morphology:
(الحياة): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb حيي يحيا, like رضي, and حيّ يحيّ, like عضّ; the alif is changed from a yāʾ; its wazn is فعلة with two fatḥas ... and see ayah (85) of this sūra.
(اتّقوا): it contains a change (iʿlāl) by deletion, following the same course as اشتروا (see ayah 175), and it contains the substitution of tāʾ for the first radical (fāʾ) of the word, as in اتّقى (see ayah 189).

* Rhetoric:
There is a contrast between the clauses in this ayah: the adornment of the life of this world in the eyes of those who disbelieved, and their mocking of the believers, are expressed with verbal clauses, pointing to occurrence (ḥudūth), and that this is a passing matter which soon disappears through various diverting causes.
As for the superiority of those who were God-conscious over them, it is a matter of fixed permanence that undergoes no change.

safi-cedvel:213-213.t:
* I'rab:
(كان) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; (الناس) the noun of kāna, nominative (marfūʿ); (أمّة) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative (manṣūb); (واحدة) naʿt (adjective) of أمة, accusative like it; (الفاء) conjunction; (بعث) past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (النبيّين) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ, and (النون) is in compensation for the tanwīn; (مبشّرين) ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of النبيّين, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (الواو) conjunction; (منذرين) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to مبشّرين, accusative like it, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (الواو) conjunction; (أنزل) past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "He"; (مع) adverb of place, mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنزل) [Note: It may be attached to an omitted ḥāl of الكتاب, i.e. "bringing good tidings and warning, with them".]; (هم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الكتاب) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (بالحقّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of الكتاب, i.e. "bound up with the truth"; (اللام) for causation (taʿlīl); (يحكم) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) (أن) after the lām, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" — i.e. Allah — or the Book [Note: It may refer to each prophet sent.]; (بين) adverb of place, accusative, attached to (يحكم); (الناس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (في) preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to (يحكم); (اختلفوا) past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (في) preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (اختلفوا); (الواو) parenthetical; (ما) negative; (اختلف) past verb; (فيه) like the first, and attached to (اختلف); (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (أوتوا) passive past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (من بعد) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اختلف); (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (جاء) past verb, and (التاء) the tāʾ of the feminine, and (هم) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (البيّنات) fāʿil, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما جاءته البيّنات) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
(بغيا) mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or ḥāl by interpretation as a derived word, i.e. "transgressing"; (بين) like the first, attached to a naʿt of (بغيا), and (هم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (الفاء) conjunction; (هدى) past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الله) fāʿil, nominative; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (آمنوا) like اختلفوا; (اللام) preposition; (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive, attached to (هدى); (اختلفوا) like the first; (فيه) like the previous one, attached to (اختلفوا); (من الحقّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the third-person pronoun in (فيه); (بإذن) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of الذين آمنوا, i.e. "following the truth by His permission" [Note: It may be attached to (هدى), i.e. "He guided them by His command".], and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (يهدي) imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "He"; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (يشاء) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "He", i.e. the Name of Majesty; (إلى صراط) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يهدي); (مستقيم) naʿt of صراط, genitive like it.
The clause «كان الناس أمّة» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «بعث الله» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to an implied clause, i.e. "they differed, so He sent".
The clause «أنزل..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause بعث.
The clause «يحكم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أنّ) [Translator's note: so in the source; the implied particle is أن.].
The clause «اختلفوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما).
The clause «ما اختلف» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical.
The clause «أوتوه» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
The clause «جاءتهم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The clause «هدى الله» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive one.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «اختلفوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «الله يهدي..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يهدي..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «يشاء» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (من).

* Morphology:
(كان - هدى): both contain a change (iʿlāl) by substitution: the first, changing the wāw to alif, and the second, changing the yāʾ to alif, because they came with fatḥa after a fatḥa.
(واحدة): feminine of واحد, a noun on the wazn فاعل indicating a single number, or it comes with something conjoined to it in the numbers from twenty-one to ninety-one (see ayah 61 of this sūra).
(مبشّرين): plural of مبشّر, active participle from the quadriliteral بشّر; its wazn is مفعّل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(منذرين): plural of منذر, active participle from the quadriliteral أنذر; its wazn is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(أوتوا): it contains the change of alif to wāw to suit the ḍamma before it in the passive, and it contains an iʿlāl by deletion.. (see ayah 144).

* Rhetoric:
In this noble ayah there is a device called by the scholars of rhetoric the device of inversion (qalb).
His saying «فَهَدَى اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لِمَا اخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِهِ» means:
"So Allah guided those who believed to the truth in that of the Book of Allah over which those who were given it differed."

* Benefits:
The author of the book al-Naḥw al-Wāfī devoted a chapter to the meanings that the letter «الباء» contains when it is a preposition. He mentioned fifteen meanings for it, namely:
adhesion (ilṣāq), causality, seeking help (istiʿāna), place/time (ẓarfiyya), transitivity (taʿdiya), accompaniment, substitution (badaliyya), exchange (ʿiwaḍ), partition (tabʿīḍ), going beyond (mujāwaza), and superiority (istiʿlāʾ); and in the sense of "to" (إلى), emphasis, and indicating an oath. Each of these meanings has examples and explanations; whoever wishes for more can consult them in the mentioned source.

safi-cedvel:169-169.t:
* I'rab:
(إنما): a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa), with no governing effect. (يأمر): an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and (كم) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (بالسوء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يأمر). (الفحشاء): conjoined (maʿṭūf) to السوء by the conjunction, genitive (majrūr) like it. (الواو): conjunction. (أن): a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative. (تقولوا): an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تقولوا..) is in the position of genitive, conjoined to السوء and الفحشاء, i.e. "بأن تقولوا على الله".
(على الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تقولوا), by making it include the sense of تتقوّلوا (to fabricate sayings).
(ما): a relative noun «[Note: Or an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective, the clause after it being in the position of accusative as its naʿt (adjective).]», indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. (لا): negative. (تعلمون): an imperfect verb, nominative ... the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «يأمركم» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «تقولوا» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «لا تعلمون» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of (ما).

* Morphology:
(الفحشاء): a noun for those sins whose ugliness is severe; its pattern is فعلاء with a fatḥa on the fāʾ; its verb is فحش يفحش of the pattern-class of كرم, and it has no masculine from its own root.

* Rhetoric:
1- The question may arise: how was Satan one who commands, given the words of the Exalted «لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطانٌ»?
I say: his making evil attractive and his incitement to it are likened to the command of one who commands, by way of the dependent explicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya al-tabaʿiyya),
just as you say: "My soul commanded me to do such-and-such". Beneath it is an allusion that you are, in relation to him, in the position of those commanded, because of your obeying him and accepting his whisperings. That is why he said: «وَلَآمُرَنَّهُمْ فَلَيُبَتِّكُنَّ آذانَ الْأَنْعامِ وَلَآمُرَنَّهُمْ فَلَيُغَيِّرُنَّ خَلْقَ اللَّهِ», and Allah the Exalted said «إِنَّ النَّفْسَ لَأَمَّارَةٌ بِالسُّوءِ», since man obeys it and gives it what it desires.
2- Hyperbole (mubālagha): in linking Satan's command to their attributing to Allah what they do not know to have come from Him, the Exalted — not to their attributing to Him what they know not to have come from Him, the Exalted, even though that is their state — for intensifying the deterrence. For warning against the first, although it is less in ugliness and foulness than the second, is a warning against the second in the most eloquent and emphatic way.

safi-cedvel:170-170.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو): conjunction. (إذا): an adverb for future time, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قالوا). (قيل): a passive past verb. (اللام): a preposition, and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (قيل). (اتّبعوا): an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn ... the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). (ما): a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (أنزل): a past verb. (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). (قالوا): a past verb and its fāʿil. (بل): a particle of iḍrāb (digression) and of beginning a new sentence. (نتّبع): an imperfect verb, nominative; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن". (ما): like the first. (ألفى): a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, and (نا) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil. (على): a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi. (آباء): first mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi (second term of the genitive construct). (الهمزة): for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī). (الواو): conjunction, preceded by the hamza because the hamza takes the head of the sentence. (لو): a non-jussive conditional particle. (كان): a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters). (آباء): the noun (ism) of kāna, nominative, and (هم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi. (لا): negative. (يعقلون): an imperfect verb, nominative; the wāw is the fāʿil. (شيئا): mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (الواو): conjunction. (لا يهتدون): like لا يعقلون.
The clause «قيل لهم ... » is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «اتّبعوا ... » is in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) «[Note: This i'rab is further from forced interpretation than any other, because the clause is originally the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) — see verse 11 — [.....]».
The clause «أنزل الله» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of (ما).
The clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.. The object of the saying is implied, i.e. "قالوا لا نتّبع ما أنزل الله".
The clause «نتّبع» has no grammatical position: resumptive «[Note: According to some, it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the implied clause that is the object of the saying, because (بل) for them is a conjunction.. But in truth it does not conjoin clauses. This is the view of Ibn Ḥayyān, i.e.:
"قالوا: لا نتبع ما أنزل الله بل نتبع ما ألفينا عليه آباءنا".]» «[Translator's note: so in the source, "Ibn Ḥayyān"; presumably Abū Ḥayyān is meant.]».
The clause «ألفينا» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second (ما).
The clause «كان آباؤهم ... » is in the position of accusative, conjoined to an implied ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, i.e. "and they follow their fathers in every state, even if they do not understand" «[Note: al-Zamakhsharī said: the wāw is originally of the ḥāl; and al-ʿUkbarī said: it is a conjunction conjoining what follows it to an implied ḥāl clause.]».
The clause «لا يعقلون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of kāna.
The clause «لا يهتدون» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause لا يعقلون..
The apodosis of لو is omitted, its implied form being "لاتّبعوهم".

* Rhetoric:
- «وَإِذا قِيلَ لَهُمُ»: a shift (iltifāt) to the third person, recording the completeness of their misguidance and announcing that the enumeration of what has been mentioned of their crimes requires turning the address away from them and directing it to the rational, and detailing the evils of their states.

* Benefits:
بل is a particle of conjunction and iḍrāb, and iḍrāb is moving and shifting from one ruling to another ruling. In this verse there is a kind of shift (iltifāt), which is one of the means of dialogue.

safi-cedvel:237-237.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction; (إن طلقتم) its i'rab has already been given [Note: In the preceding ayah, 236.], and (الواو) a redundant (zāʾida) letter for lengthening the vowel of the mīm, and (هنّ) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (طلّقتموهنّ); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive-governing particle; (تمسّوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and (هنّ) mafʿūl bihi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تمسّوهنّ) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
(الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (قد) a particle of realization; (فرضتم) a past verb and its fāʿil; (اللام) a preposition and (هنّ) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (فرضتم); (فريضة) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (نصف) a mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ), and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "عليكم" or "لهنّ" [Note: (نصف) may be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: الواجب (what is due) or اللازم (what is binding).]; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (فرضتم) like the first; (إلا) a particle of exception; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive-governing particle; (يعفون) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative..
and (النون) the nūn of the feminine plural, the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يعفون) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, with an omitted muḍāf, and it is excepted from the generality of the state of having fixed a dower, i.e.: then half of what you fixed, in every state except in the state of forgoing.
(أو) a conjunction; (يعفو) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, conjoined to the position of يعفون; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (بيد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (عقدة) a delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (النكاح) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr). (الواو) resumptive or parenthetical; (أن) like the first; (تعفوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تعفوا) is in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, i.e. your forgoing is nearer to piety.
(أقرب) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ — the interpreted maṣdar — nominative; (للتقوى) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أقرب), the sign of the genitive being the implied (muqaddar) kasra; (الواو) resumptive; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing; (تنسوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الفضل) a mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الفضل, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الله) the word of Majesty, the noun of إنّ; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to بصير [Note: Or it is a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar from it and the verb is in the position of genitive by the preposition, attached to بصير.]; (تعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative..
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بصير) the khabar of إنّ, nominative.
The clause «إن طلّقتموهنّ» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to a previous resumptive clause.
The clause «تمسّوهنّ» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «فرضتم ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the agent pronoun or of the object pronoun, i.e.: having fixed for them, or (they) having had (a dower) fixed for them.
The clause «نصف ما فرضتم» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.
The clause «فرضتم (the second)» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (ما), and the clause «يعفون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «يعفو الذي ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause يعفون.
The clause «بيده عقدة النكاح» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «أن تعفوا أقرب» has no grammatical position, being resumptive or parenthetical.
The clause «تعفو» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second particle relative (أن).
The clause «لا تنسوا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «إنّ الله ...» بصير has no grammatical position, being causal (giving the reason).
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the nominal or particle relative.

* Morphology:
(يعفون): the wāw is the final radical of the word, and the nūn is the nūn of the feminine plural; its pattern is يفعلن, built on the sukūn.
(تعفوا): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its original form is تعفووا; two sukūns met in the two wāws, so the weak wāw was deleted, since it is part of the word, and it became تعفوا; its pattern is تفعوا.
(للتقوى): in the word there is ibdāl (letter substitution) ... (see ayah 197).
(تنسوا): in the word there is iʿlāl that proceeded as in اشتروا (see ayah 16 of this sūra).
(أقرب): an elative noun (ism tafḍīl) from قرب يقرب (category كرم); its pattern is أفعل, and the thing surpassed is omitted, i.e. forgoing is nearer to piety than any other deed.

* Benefits:
In these two ayahs there is one of the important rulings in matters of marriage, summarized as follows: the divorced woman with whom her husband has not consummated the marriage: if he named a dower for her, she has half of what was named; and if he did not name one, she has the mutʿa (compensatory gift) and does not have half of the customary dower (mahr al-mithl). The mutʿa differs according to time, place and people's customs; Abū Ḥanīfa held, in his days, that the mutʿa is a shift, a wrap and a head-covering, unless her customary dower is less than the value of the mutʿa, in which case he may choose the lesser.
The mutʿa is obligatory for the woman divorced without contact and without a named dower, and it is recommended for all other divorced women.
- The difference between «الرجال يعفون» and «النساء يعفون» lies in the wāw and the nūn: in the first, the wāw is the fāʿil and the nūn is the sign of the nominative; in the second, the wāw is the final radical of the verb and the nūn is the nūn of the feminine plural, a nominative pronoun, and the verb is built on the implied sukūn.

safi-cedvel:238-238.t:
* I'rab:
(حافظوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (على الصلوات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (حافظوا); (الصلاة) conjoined to الصلوات by the wāw, genitive (majrūr) like it; (الوسطى) a naʿt (adjective) of الصلاة, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الواو) a conjunction; (قوموا) like حافظوا; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun of قوموا, i.e. worshipping Allah [Note: It may be attached to the verb (قوموا), the standing being the standing of prayer; and the preposition may be attached to قانتين, i.e. to the ḥāl that comes after it, as indicated by His saying: كلّ له قانتون.]; (قانتين) a second ḥāl of the pronoun of قوموا, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «حافظوا» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «قوموا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause حافظوا.

* Morphology:
(الوسطى): an elative noun (ism tafḍīl) on the pattern فعلى with ḍamma on the fāʾ; it is the feminine of الأوسط. The word came in the feminine because it has (ال) and is an adjective of الصلاة, which is feminine, so agreement is obligatory.

safi-cedvel:239-239.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) a conjunction; (إن خفتم) like إن طلّقتم [Note: In ayah 236 of this sūra.]; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (رجالا) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb), the implied meaning being "then pray رجالا", i.e. on foot; (أو) a conjunction; (ركبانا) conjoined to (رجالا), accusative like it; (الفاء) a conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the sense of a condition, in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the content of the apodosis; (أمنتم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn..
and (تم) the fāʿil (agent); (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (اذكروا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الله) the word of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الكاف) a preposition of comparison [Note: Or a noun meaning مثل, a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar, i.e. remember Allah with a remembrance like that which He taught you.]; (ما) a relative noun [Note: Or a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive, and the second (ما) is a mafʿūl bihi.] in the position of genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. remember Allah with a remembrance like that which He taught you; (علّم) a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) of the omitted referent pronoun in (علّمكم), i.e.: علّمكم إيّاه [Note: Or a badal of the first (ما), so that it is in the position of genitive; or a mafʿūl bihi of the verb علّمكم, so there is no need to assume إيّاه.]; (لم) a particle of negation, inversion (to the past) and jussive; (تكونوا) a defective imperfect verb (of kāna and its sisters), jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the noun of تكون; (تعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause إن خفتم has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause in the preceding ayah.
The clause «(صلّوا) رجالا» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «أمنتم» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «اذكروا» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «علّمكم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the first relative (ما) [Note: Or it is the ṣila of the particle relative if (ما) is parsed as a maṣdar-forming particle.].
The clause «لم تكونوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «تعلمون» is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of تكونوا.

* Morphology:
(رجالا): plural of راجل, i.e. one walking. راجل also has the plurals رجل (with fatḥa then sukūn), رجّالة (with fatḥa on the rāʾ), رجّال (with ḍamma on the rāʾ), رجالي on the pattern of كسالى (with ḍamma or fatḥa on the rāʾ), and رجلان (with ḍamma on the rāʾ).
(ركبان): plural of راكب, an active participle from ركب يركب (category فرح). Linguistically it is applied to one who rides camels, and it may be applied to one who rides other than them, as in the ayah.

safi-cedvel:282-282.t:
* I'rab:
(يأيّها الذين آمنوا) its i'rab was given shortly before «[Note: in ayah (278) of this sūra.]»; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, in the position of an accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the content of the meaning of the apodosis; (تداينتم) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (تم) is the fāʿil (agent); (بدين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تداينتم); (إلى أجل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تداينتم); (مسمى) naʿt (adjective) of أجل, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اكتبوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) is a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الواو) conjunction; (اللام) the lām of command; (يكتب) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (يكتب), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (كاتب) fāʿil, nominative; (بالعدل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كاتب «[Note: Or attached to the verb يكتب, i.e. let him write with truth and justice.]».
The vocative clause «يأيّها الذين» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «(إذا and the condition and apodosis within its scope)» has no grammatical position; it is the response to the vocative.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «تداينتم» is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «اكتبوه» has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «ليكتب بينكم كاتب» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause اكتبوه.
(الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing; (يأب) an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the weak letter; (كاتب) fāʿil, nominative; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (يكتب) an imperfect verb, accusative, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (he).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يكتب) is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi, governed by يأب.
(الكاف) a preposition «[Note: Or a noun meaning "like" (مثل), in the position of an accusative as naʿt of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: that he write a writing like what Allah taught him.]»; (ما) a relative noun «[Note: Or a maṣdar-forming particle, the interpreted maṣdar being in the position of a genitive, attached to what the relative noun is attached to; or it is an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective (nakira mawṣūfa), in the position of a genitive.]», in the position of a genitive by the kāf, attached to (يكتب) «[Note: Or attached to (لا يأب), the kāf then being causal, i.e. refusal to write is forbidden to him.]»; (علّم) a past verb, and (الهاء) a pronoun, first mafʿūl bihi, and the second object is omitted, and it is the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid), i.e. علّمه إيّاه; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative.
The clause «لا يأب كاتب» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause اكتبوه.
The clause «يكتب» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «علّمه الله» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (ما) «[Note: the nominal and the particle one; or it is in the position of a genitive as naʿt of (ما) as an indefinite qualified noun.]».
(الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (ليكتب) like the first; (الواو) conjunction; (ليملل) like ليكتب, and it was given a kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative as fāʿil; (على) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (الحقّ) a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (ليتّق) like ليكتب, the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the weak letter; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (ربّ) naʿt of the Name of Majesty, accusative like it, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (لا يبخس) like لا يأب, the sign of the jussive being the sukūn, and the agent refers back to the one who owes the debt (الذي عليه الحق); (من) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (يبخس) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (شيئا) — an adjective that has come before the noun it qualifies —]»; (شيئا) mafʿūl bihi.
The clause «ليكتب» is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if the scribe is asked to write, let him write.
The clause «ليملل الذي ...» is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause ليكتب.
The clause «عليه الحقّ» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «ليتّق الله» is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause ليملل.
The clause «لا يبخس ...» is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause ليملل.
(الفاء) conjunction; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (كان) a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (الذي) a relative noun in the position of a nominative as the noun of كان; (عليه الحقّ) like the first one before; (سفيها) khabar of كان, accusative; (أو) a conjunction; (ضعيفا) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (سفيها), accusative like it; (أو) conjunction; (لا) negative; (يستطيع) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", referring back to the relative noun; (أن يملّ) like أن يكتب, and the agent is latent, referring back to the relative; (هو) a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as tawkīd (emphasis) of the agent of يملّ; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (ليملل) like the first; (وليّ) fāʿil, nominative, and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi; (بالعدل) like the first, attached to (يملل).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يملّ) is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi, governed by لا يستطيع.
(الواو) resumptive; (استشهدوا) like اكتبوا; (شهيدين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (من رجال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of شهيدين, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunction; (إن) a conditional particle; (لم) negative; (يكونا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis «[Note: See the i'rab of ayah (279), فإن لم تفعلوا ..., and footnote no. (1).]», the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and (الألف) is the noun of يكون; (رجلين) khabar of يكون, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (رجل) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "the witnesses" (الشهود) «[Note: It is permissible for it to be a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e.: then a man and two women shall bear witness; and making it a mubtadaʾ is valid because it, together with the two women, is qualified by His words «ممن ترضون».]»; (الواو) conjunction; (امرأتان) maʿṭūf to رجل, nominative like it, the sign of the nominative being the alif; (من) a preposition; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt of رجل and امرأتان; (ترضون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (من الشهداء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the omitted object pronoun, i.e. ترضونه من الشهداء; (أن تضلّ) like أن يكتب; (إحدى) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the alif, and (هما) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تضلّ) is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. "for fear that one of them should err" «[Note: Or it is in the position of a genitive by an omitted preposition, i.e. "so that one of them should err", by putting the cause, which is the erring, in the place of what it causes, which is the reminding, i.e. so that one of them may remind the other if she errs. Abū Ḥayyān rejected the interpretation "for fear that she should err" because (تذكّر) is conjoined to (تضلّ), so the meaning would not hold. But what is not valid in first elements may be valid in second elements.]».
(الفاء) conjunction; (تذكّر) an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to (تضلّ); (إحداهما) like the first; (الأخرى) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the implied fatḥa; (الواو) conjunction; (لا يأب الشهداء) like لا يأب كاتب; (إذا) like the first; (ما) redundant (zāʾida); (دعوا) a passive past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ that was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «إن كان الذي ...» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the response to the vocative.
The clause «عليه الحقّ» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «لا يستطيع» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the khabar of كان.
The clause «ليملل وليّه» is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis of the jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يملّ» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «استشهدوا» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the response to the vocative.
The clause «إن لم يكونا رجلين» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause استشهدوا.
The clause «(الشهود) رجل» is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis of the jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «ترضون» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «تضلّ» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «تذكّر» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause تضلّ.
The clause «لا يأب الشهداء» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause استشهدوا.
The clause «دعوا» is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. There is no apodosis for (إذا), because it is stripped of the condition and is attached to the verb يأب.
(الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing; (تسأموا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (تكتبوا) an imperfect verb, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (صغيرا) ḥāl, accusative, of the third-person pronoun; (أو) a conjunction; (كبيرا) maʿṭūf to (صغيرا), accusative like it; (إلى أجل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the third-person pronoun in (تكتبوه) «[Note: Or attached to the verb تكتبوه.]», and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تكتبوه) is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi, governed by تسأموا «[Note: Or in the position of a genitive by an omitted preposition, the implied form being: من أن تكتبوه, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (تسأموا).]».
(ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; (اللام) for distance, and (الكاف) for address, and (الميم) for the masculine plural; (أقسط) khabar, nominative; (عند) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to أقسط; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (أقوم) maʿṭūf to أقسط, nominative like it; (للشهادة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أقوم; (الواو) conjunction; (أدنى) maʿṭūf to أقسط, nominative like it; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (لا) negative; (ترتابوا) like تكتبوا.
The interpreted maṣdar (ألا ترتابوا) is in the position of a genitive by an omitted preposition, i.e.: "closer to your not doubting", the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to أدنى.
(إلّا) a particle of exception; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (تكون) a defective imperfect verb, accusative, and its noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هي" (it), i.e. the sale or the transaction; (تجارة) its khabar, accusative; (حاضرة) naʿt of تجارة, accusative like it.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تكون تجارة) is in the position of an accusative by disjoined exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ) «[Note: Because dealing by sale in trade is other than dealing by debt, so there is no necessity of writing in it.]».
(تديرون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (تديرون), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) resumptive; (ليس) a defective, non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb; (على) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of ليس; (جناح) the postponed noun of ليس, nominative; (ألّا تكتبوا) like ألّا ترتابوا, and (ها) an attached pronoun in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا تكتبوا) is in the position of a genitive by an omitted preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to the omitted khabar, i.e.: there is no blame on you in not writing it.
The clause «لا تسأموا ...» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause لا يأب.
The clause «تكتبوه» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «ذلكم أقسط» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive, giving a reason.
The clause «ترتابوا» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «تكون تجارة» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «تديرونها» is in the position of an accusative as ḥāl of تجارة «[Note: Because the indefinite noun here has been qualified; and it is permissible for the clause to be in the position of an accusative as naʿt of تجارة.]».
The clause «ليس عليكم جناح» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «تكتبوها» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
(الواو) resumptive; (أشهدوا) like اكتبوا; (إذا) an adverb of future time stripped of the condition, attached to (أشهدوا); (تبايعتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing; (يضارّ) an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the sukūn implied because of the doubling, and it is passive — or active —; (كاتب) nāʾib fāʿil, nominative «[Note: The agent understood from the context is the owner of the right. (كاتب) may be the agent of the active verb, i.e.: let neither scribe nor witness harm the owner of the right.]»; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant, for emphasizing the negation; (شهيد) maʿṭūf to كاتب, nominative like it.
The clause «أشهدوا» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «تبايعتم» is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The apodosis — if إذا is taken to contain the meaning of condition — is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: when you trade, take witnesses.
The clause «لا يضارّ كاتب» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive clause.
(الواو) conjunction — or resumptive —; (إن) a conditional particle; (تفعلوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of an accusative as the noun of إنّ; (فسوق) khabar, nominative; (الباء) a preposition, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt of فسوق; (الواو) resumptive; (اتّقوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) resumptive; (يعلّم) an imperfect verb, nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (بكلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عليم; (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; and (عليم) khabar, nominative.
The clause «إن تفعلوا ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive or conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «إنه فسوق» is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis of the jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «اتّقوا الله» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «يعلّمكم الله» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «الله ... عليم» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.

* Morphology:
(دين): an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb دان يدين, of the ضرب pattern; its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(مسمّى): passive participle of the quadriliteral verb سمّى; its wazn is مفعّل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(كاتب): active participle of the verb كتب; its wazn is فاعل.
(العدل): an aurally-transmitted maṣdar of the verb عدل; its wazn is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(يأب): it contains iʿlāl by deletion because of the jussive; its wazn is يفع.
(سفيها): a ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective) from سفه يسفه, of the فرح pattern; its wazn is فعيل.
(ترضون): it contains iʿlāl by deletion: the alif, the lām of the word, was deleted because it came quiescent before the quiescent wāw of the plural, and the letter before the wāw was given a fatḥa to indicate the deleted alif; its wazn is تفعون, with fatḥa on the tāʾ and the ʿayn.
(إحداهما): the feminine of أحد, a noun used as a qualifier; the wazn of إحدى is فعلى, with kasra then sukūn.
(الأخرى): the feminine of الآخر, a derived adjective; its wazn is فعلى, with ḍamma then sukūn.
(دعوا): it contains iʿlāl by vowel-removal (taskīn) and iʿlāl by deletion; its original form is دعيوا, with ḍamma on the yāʾ and kasra on the ʿayn; then the vowel of the yāʾ was moved to the ʿayn, and because of its quiescence and the quiescence of the plural wāw, the yāʾ was deleted, so the verb became دعوا, its wazn being فعوا, with ḍamma on the fāʾ and the ʿayn.
(صغيرا أو كبيرا): both are derived adjectives on the wazn فعيل, the first of the كرم pattern and the second of the فرح pattern and the كرم pattern (and see ayah 217).
(أقسط): an elative (ism tafḍīl) on the wazn أفعل; it is irregular because it is taken from the quadriliteral أقسط, meaning "he acted justly".
(أقوم): an elative on the wazn أفعل; it is either irregular, because it is from the quadriliteral أقام, or regular, taken from the triliteral قام. The wāw was not subjected to iʿlāl and changed to an alif as it was in the verb, because nouns are closer to fixity (jumūd) than verbs.
(أدنى): an elative on the wazn أفعل; it contains iʿlāl by substitution (qalb); its original form is أدنو, with fatḥa on the nūn; the wāw was changed to an alif because it is voweled and the letter before it has a fatḥa (see ayah 61 of this sūra).
(حاضرة): an active participle to which the tāʾ of the feminine has been joined; its wazn is فاعلة.

* Rhetoric:
1- «بدين»: it is mentioned to single out the intended sense of a shared (ambiguous) word and to remove the false impression explicitly, because تداينتم comes with the meaning "you dealt with one another by debt" and with the meaning "you requited one another". It cannot be objected that the context removes the ambiguity, because the discussion concerns explicit statement; moreover, the context may only be noticed by the perceptive. It is also mentioned so that the pronoun may refer back to it, for without it, it would have been said: فاكتبوا الدين (then write the debt).
2- «مسمى»: If you say: why did He say «إِلى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى»? I say: so that it be known that the term must by right be known, such as fixing the time by the year, months and days. If one said: until the harvest, or الرياس [Translator's note: so in the text; perhaps a misprint for الدياس, "the threshing"], or the return of the pilgrims, it would not be permissible, for lack of specification.
3- «فليكتب»: that taught writing — He commanded it after prohibiting refusal of it, to emphasize it. And He took precaution for the matter by commanding him to fear Allah with His words: «وَلْيَتَّقِ اللَّهَ رَبَّهُ».
4- He repeated the Name of Majesty in the three clauses to instill awe and nurture reverence, and to draw attention to the independence of each of them with a meaning of its own: the first is an urging to piety, the second a promise of favour, and the third a glorification of His, the Exalted's, station.

safi-cedvel:188-188.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لا) prohibitive, jussivizing; (تأكلوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (أموال) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (بين) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تأكلوا) «[Note: It is permissible to attach it to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of (أموالكم), i.e. present among you.]», (بالباطل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تأكلوا) «[Note: I.e. do not take it by a false means. It is permissible for it to be attached to an omitted ḥāl of (أموالكم), i.e. extracted by falsehood, or to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of تأكلوا, i.e. seeking the aid of falsehood.]», (الواو) the wāw of accompaniment (wāw al-maʿiyya); (تدلوا) an imperfect verb, accusative «[Note: It is permissible for it to be jussive by conjunction with (تأكلوا), with an omitted prohibitive (لا) understood, i.e. ولا تدلوا (and do not offer) ...]» by an (أن) necessarily implied (muḍmara) after the wāw of accompaniment, the sign of its accusative being the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الباء) a preposition and (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تدلوا), (إلى الحكّام) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تدلوا).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تدلوا ...) is conjoined to a maṣdar cast from the content of the preceding speech, i.e.: let there not be an eating of wealth and an offering of it to the judges.
(اللام) causal (li-l-taʿlīl); (تأكلوا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an (أن) implied after the lām ...
the wāw is the fāʿil; (فريقا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من أموال) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (فريقا), (الناس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), (بالإثم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the pronoun in (تأكلوا), i.e. engaged in sin «[Note: It is permissible to attach it to an omitted ḥāl of (أموال الناس), or it is attached to (تأكلوا).]».
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تأكلوا) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (تدلوا), or to the verb of request: لا تأكلوا ...
(الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (أنتم) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (تعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ)..
And the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «لا تأكلوا..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «تدلوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative.
The clause «تأكلوا فريقا..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative.
The clause «أنتم تعلمون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «تعلمون» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (أنتم).

* Morphology:
(الباطل), active participle from بطل يبطل on the pattern فاعل; then it was used as a noun meaning the opposite of truth.
(تدلوا), it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its origin is تدليوا, with ḍamma on the yāʾ: the ḍamma was deemed heavy on the yāʾ, so it was transferred to the letter before it; two vowelless letters met, so the yāʾ was deleted and the verb became تدلوا, its pattern being تفعوا.
(الحكّام), plural of الحاكم; originally an active participle from حكم يحكم, of the class of نصر, then it became a noun applied to one who judges between people; its pattern is فاعل.

* Benefits:
1- The lām of causation (lām al-taʿlīl) precedes the imperfect verb and it becomes accusative. The grammarians differed about the cause of the accusative, and they have two opinions on it: the first is that it is accusative by an أن optionally implied after the lām, and this is the opinion acted upon today and the opinion of the Basrans; the second, the opinion of the Kufans, is that the verb is accusative by a «كي» optionally implied after the lām. It appears that the first opinion is the preponderant one, «because the governing of «أن», overt and implied, optionally or necessarily, is widespread» «[Note: al-Naḥw al-Wāfī, vol. 4, p. 288..]».
2- Among the wonders of philology (fiqh al-lugha) is that letters on their own indicate meanings specific to them. Of this is that every verb whose fāʾ (first radical) is dāl and whose ʿayn (second radical) is lām indicates movement coupled with dangling down or slipping. Whoever would like more on the properties of letters should refer to the books of philology ...

safi-cedvel:189-189.t:
* I'rab:
(يسألون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عن الأهلّة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يسألون), (قل) an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "you" (أنت); (هي) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (مواقيت) khabar (predicate), nominative; (للناس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of مواقيت; (الحج) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الناس by the wāw, genitive like it; (الواو) conjunction; (ليس) a defective, rigid (jāmid) past verb; (البرّ) the noun of laysa, nominative; (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; (تأتوا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (البيوت) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من ظهور) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تأتوا), since it is made to include the meaning of تدخلوا (enter), and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تأتوا) is in the position of genitive by the redundant particle — this is the near position — and in the position of accusative as the khabar of laysa — this is the far position.
(الواو) conjunction; (لكنّ) a particle of rectification (istidrāk) and accusative-governing; (البرّ) the noun of lākinna, accusative, and it is with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. ذا البرّ (the one possessing righteousness); (من) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as khabar; (اتّقى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو), and it is the referent (al-ʿāʾid); (الواو) resumptive; (ائتوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (البيوت) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من أبواب) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ائتوا), and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (اتّقوا) like ائتوا; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (لعلكم تفلحون) the i'rab of its like has preceded «[Note: In verse (185) of this sūra.]».
The clause «يسألونك..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being an explicative resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «هي مواقيت» is in the position of accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «ليس البرّ بأن تأتوا» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause هي مواقيت «[Note: Or conjoined to the resumptive clause, in which case it has no grammatical position.]».
The clause «لكنّ البرّ من ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause ليس البرّ.
The clause «اتّقى» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «ائتوا البيوت» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «اتّقوا الله» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ائتوا البيوت.
The clause «لعلّكم تفلحون» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تفلحون» is in the position of nominative as khabar of laʿalla.

* Morphology:
(الأهلّة), plural of هلال, a primitive (jāmid) noun.
