So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ held back the caravan, and that weighed heavily on the members of the raiding party, and they said: We will not leave until our repentance is revealed. The Messenger of Allah returned the caravan and the captives, and the ayah was revealed: يَسْئَلُونَكَ عَنِ الشَّهْرِ الْحَرامِ قِتالٍ فِيهِ, to the end of the ayah.

safi-cedvel:218-218.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الذين) a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the noun of inna; (آمنوا) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الواو) conjunction; (الذين) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the first relative, in the position of accusative; (هاجروا) like آمنوا, and likewise (جاهدوا); (في سبيل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جاهدوا); (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; (أولاء) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الكاف) for address; (يرجون) imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ)..
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (رحمة) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (غفور) khabar (predicate), nominative; (رحيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «إنّ الذين آمنوا..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative (الذين).
The clause «هاجروا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
The clause «جاهدوا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause هاجروا.
The clause «أولئك يرجون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of (إنّ).
The clause «يرجون رحمة الله» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
The clause «الله غفور» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(يرجون): it contains a change (iʿlāl) by deletion; its original is يرجوون with two quiescent wāws, so the first wāw was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; its wazn is يفعون.

safi-cedvel:283-283.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive — or conjunction —; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (كنتم) a defective past verb (of kāna and its sisters), indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); and (تم) a pronoun, the noun of كان, in the position of a nominative; (على سفر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of كان; (الواو) conjunction «[Note: It is permissible for the wāw to be circumstantial (ḥāliyya).]»; (لم) a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; (تجدوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and (الواو) is the fāʿil (agent); (كاتبا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (رهان) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: "the security" (الوثيقة); (مقبوضة) naʿt (adjective) of رهان, nominative like it; (الفاء) conjunction; (إن) like the first; (أمن) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of a jussive as the protasis; (بعض) fāʿil, nominative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (بعضا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (اللام) the lām of command; (يؤدّ) an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām of command, the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the weak letter; (الذي) a relative noun in the position of a nominative as fāʿil; (اوتمن) a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and it is the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid); (أمانة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (ليتّق الله ربّه) its i'rab has been given before «[Note: in the preceding ayah (282).]»; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing; (تكتموا) an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الشهادة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) resumptive; (من) a jussive conditional noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; (يكتم) an imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", referring back to the conditional noun; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb, and (الهاء) a pronoun, the noun of إنّ, in the position of an accusative «[Note: It is permissible for the pronoun to be the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), being the noun of إنّ, and the khabar is the nominal clause: آثم قلبه.]»; (آثم) khabar of إنّ, nominative «[Note: Or it is a fronted khabar and قلبه a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the khabar of إنّ.]»; (قلب) fāʿil of the active participle آثم, nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (الباء) a preposition, and (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to عليم «[Note: Or it is a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, attached to عليم, i.e.: Allah is knowing of your doing.]»; (تعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (عليم) khabar of the mubtadaʾ الله.
The clause «إن كنتم على سفر» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive «[Note: Or conjoined to a preceding resumptive clause in the previous ayah.]».
The clause «لم تجدوا كاتبا» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive clause «[Note: Or in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the khabar of كنتم; or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun concealed in the khabar of كنتم.]».
The clause «(الوثيقة) رهان» is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis of the jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «إن أمن بعضكم بعضا» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the first conditional clause.
The clause «ليؤدّ الذي أؤتمن ...» is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis of the second jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «اؤتمن» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «ليتّق الله» is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause ليؤدّ الذي ...
The clause «لا تكتموا ...» is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause ليؤدّ الذي ...
The clause «من يكتمها (the nominal one)» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive, carrying the meaning of giving a reason.
The clause «يكتمها» is in the position of a nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «1» [Translator's note: a footnote marker in the source with no footnote text given].
The clause «إنّه آثم» is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis of the jussive condition, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «الله ... عليم» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the nominal or particle relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(رهان): maṣdar of the quadriliteral راهن, and it is aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) in this wazn; its wazn is فعال, with kasra on the fāʾ; or it is a plural of رهن, which is what is placed as security for a debt.
(مقبوضة): the feminine of مقبوض, which is a passive participle from قبض; its wazn is مفعولة.
(يؤدّ): it contains iʿlāl by deletion because of the jussive; its wazn is يفعّ, with ḍamma on the yāʾ and kasra on the doubled ʿayn.
(آثم): active participle from the triliteral أثم; its wazn is فاعل.

* Rhetoric:
1- «وَإِنْ كُنْتُمْ عَلى سَفَرٍ», i.e. travelling: in it there is a dependent metaphor (istiʿāra tabaʿiyya), in that their being established in travel is likened to the rider's being established on his mount.
2- «فَإِنَّهُ آثِمٌ قَلْبُهُ»: sin is ascribed to the heart because concealment is among what it commits; similar to it is the ascription of fornication to the eye and the ear. Or it is for intensification, because it is the chief of the organs and its acts are the greatest of acts, as if it were said: sin has become established in his soul, has taken possession of the noblest place in it, and has surpassed all his other sins. This is by way of rational metaphor (majāz ʿaqlī).

safi-cedvel:284-284.t:
* I'rab:
(لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a nominative as postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); (في السموات) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما; (الواو) conjunction; (ما في الأرض) like ما في السموات, and it is conjoined to it; (الواو) conjunction; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (تبدوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (في أنفس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila of ما, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أو) a conjunction; (تخفوا) an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to the verb تبدوا and parsed like it, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (يحاسب) an imperfect verb, jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and (كم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الباء) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (يحاسب); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (الفاء) resumptive «[Note: It is a conjunction in the reading of the verb in the jussive, because it is conjoined to the apodosis (يحاسبكم); and it is the fāʾ of causation — according to Ibn Hishām — [in the reading with the accusative] [Translator's note: the bracketed phrase is not in the source; the source simply says "and it is the fāʾ of causation"], so the verb after it is accusative by an implied (أن), and the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a preceding extracted maṣdar.]»; (يغفر) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", i.e. Allah; (اللام) a preposition; (من) a relative noun in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to (يغفر); (يشاء) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is "huwa"; (الواو) conjunction; (يعذّب من يشاء) like يغفر لمن يشاء; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (على كلّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قدير; (شيء) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (قدير) khabar of the mubtadaʾ — الله —, nominative.
The clause «لله ما في السموات» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «إن تبدوا» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «تخفوه» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to تبدوا.
The clause «يحاسبكم به الله» has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of a jussive condition not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يغفر ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive «[Note: The resumption, according to some of them, is a nominal clause with an implied mubtadaʾ, i.e. فهو يغفر لمن يشاء.]».
The clause «يشاء» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «يعذّب ...» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause يغفر.
The clause «يشاء (the second)» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the second relative (من).
The clause «الله ... قدير» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.

* Morphology:
(تخفوه): in it the hamza is deleted for lightness; its original form is تؤخفيوه. The verb also contains iʿlāl by deletion: the yāʾ was deleted — after being made quiescent — because of the meeting of two quiescent letters: the yāʾ and the wāw of the plural. Its wazn is تفعوه, with ḍamma on the tāʾ and the ʿayn. (ayah 271).

safi-cedvel:285-285.t:
[Translator's note: In the source text, the material of ayahs 285 and 286 is jumbled: partway through the i'rab of (من ربّه) the text jumps into the i'rab of ayah 286 (from لها ما كسبت onward), then returns to the i'rab of ayah 285 (المؤمنون ...). The entry for ayah 286 likewise begins with its own opening and then breaks off into clause analyses. The text is translated here exactly in the order in which it appears.]
* I'rab:
(آمن) a past verb; (الرسول) fāʿil (agent), nominative; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun in the position of a genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمن); (أنزل) a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", and it is the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid); (إلى) a preposition; (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (أنزل); (من ربّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أنزل), and (الهاء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunction; in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a nominative as postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) «[Note: It is permissible for (ما) to be a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ, i.e. لها كسبها (to it belongs its earning).]»; (كسب) a past verb, and (التاء) is the tāʾ of the feminine, and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هي", i.e. the soul; (الواو) conjunction; (عليها ما اكتسبت) like لها ما كسبت; (ربّ) the one addressed (munādā), muḍāf, accusative, with the vocative particle omitted, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (لا) prohibitive of supplication, jussive-governing; (تؤاخذ) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you); (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (نسينا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (نا) is the fāʿil; (أو) a conjunction; (أخطأنا) like نسينا; (ربّنا) like the first; (الواو) conjunction; (لا تحمل) like لا تؤاخذ; (على) a preposition, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (تحمل); (إصرا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الكاف) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. a burdening like that which You placed upon those «[Note: Or it is a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of a genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted maṣdar.]»; (حمل) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (التاء) a pronoun, fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (على) a preposition; (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to (حملته); (من قبل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause), and (نا) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; (ربّنا) like the first; (الواو) conjunction; (لا تحمّل) like لا تحمل; (نا) mafʿūl bihi; (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative as second mafʿūl bihi «[Note: It is permissible for it to be an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective (nakira mawṣūfa), in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the clause after it is in the position of an accusative as an adjective.]»; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (طاقة) the noun of لا, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative; (لنا) like لها, attached to the omitted khabar of لا; (الباء) a preposition, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun نا, i.e.: do not burden us with a matter we cannot bear, being tormented by it; (الواو) conjunction in the three places; (اعف) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the weak letter, and it is for supplication, and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنت"; (عن) a preposition, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (اعف); (اغفر) like اعف, indeclinable on the sukūn; (لنا) like عنا, and attached to (اغفر); (ارحم) like اعف, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (نا) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (أنت) an overt detached pronoun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; (مولى) khabar, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) for pure causation «[Note: It is a conjunction of causation according to those who permit conjoining a performative (inshāʾ) to a declarative (khabar) or a declarative to a performative.]»; (انصرنا) like ارحمنا; (على القوم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (انصر); (الكافرين) naʿt (adjective) of القوم, genitive like it, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «لا يكلّف الله ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «لها ما كسبت» has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «كسبت» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the nominal or particle relative (ما).
The clause «عليها ما اكتسبت» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause لها ما كسبت.
The clause «اكتسبت» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the second relative (ما), nominal or particle.
The vocative clause and its response are in the position of an accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb. (المؤمنون) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الرسول, nominative like it «[Note: Or it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause: كلّ آمن بالله.]», the sign of the nominative being the wāw; (كلّ) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and the tanwīn is the tanwīn of compensation, i.e. كلّهم (all of them); (آمن) like the first, and the agent is "huwa"; (بالله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (آمن); (الواو) in the three places is a conjunction; (ملائكته، كتبه، رسله) words conjoined to the Name of Majesty, genitive [Translator's note: the source says "مرفوعة" (nominative), but these nouns are conjoined to the genitive بالله and are genitive] like it, and annexed to its pronoun; (لا) negative; (نفرّق) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن" (we); (بين) an adverb of place, mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), accusative, attached to (نفرّق); (أحد) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (من رسل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of أحد, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) resumptive; (قالوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (سمعنا) a past verb and its agent; (الواو) conjunction; (أطعنا) like سمعنا; (غفران) mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, accusative «[Note: The verb is implied either as اغفر (forgive), so the clause is a request, or as نستغفر (we seek forgiveness), so the clause is declarative. The maṣdar may stand in place of its request verb. Moreover, it is permissible for the maṣdar to be a mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being نطلب (we ask).]», and (الكاف) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ربّ) the one addressed, muḍāf, with the vocative particle omitted, and it is accusative, and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (إلى) a preposition, and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (المصير) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative.
The clause «آمن الرسول» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «أنزل إليه» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun.
The clause «كلّ آمن بالله» has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption.
The clause «آمن بالله» is in the position of a nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ كلّ.
The clause «لا نفرّق ...» is in the position of an accusative as the speech reported of an omitted verb, its implied form being يقولون (they say); and the clause of the implied verb is in the position of an accusative as ḥāl.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «سمعنا» is in the position of an accusative as the speech reported.
The clause «أطعنا» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to the clause سمعنا.
The clause «غفرانك» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The vocative clause «ربّنا» has no grammatical position; it is parenthetical.
The clause «إليك المصير» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to an implied resumptive clause, i.e.: from You is the beginning and to You is the return.

* Morphology:
(أطعنا): it contains iʿlāl by deletion because of being indeclinable on the sukūn: the ʿayn of the verb was deleted; its wazn is أفلنا.
(غفرانك): an aurally-transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb غفر يغفر, of the ضرب pattern; its wazn is فعلان, with ḍamma on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:286-286.t:
[Translator's note: As noted under ayah 285, the source text of ayahs 285 and 286 is jumbled; the beginning of this entry breaks off mid-sentence and continues with the clause analyses of ayah 286. It is translated as it stands.]
* I'rab:
(لا) negative; (يكلّف) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative; (نفسا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (إلا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (وسع) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (ها) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (اللام) a preposition, and (ها) a pronoun in ... its implied form being يقولون (they say) or قولوا (say).
The clause «لا تؤاخذنا» has no grammatical position; it is the response to the vocative.
The clause «إن نسينا» has no grammatical position; it has the status of giving a reason. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what preceded, i.e.: if we forget or err, then do not take us to task.
The clause «أخطأنا» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause نسينا.
The vocative clause «ربّنا» has no grammatical position; it is parenthetical, to show additional humble entreaty.
The clause «لا تحمل علينا إصرا» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause لا تؤاخذنا.
The clause «حملته» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the nominal or particle relative (ما).
The clause «لا تحمّلنا ...» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause لا تؤاخذنا.
The clause «لا طاقة لنا به» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative noun (ما) «[Note: Or it is in the position of an accusative as naʿt (adjective) of (ما) as an indefinite qualified noun.]».
The clause «اعف عنّا» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause لا تؤاخذنا.
The clause «اغفر لنا» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause اعف or لا تؤاخذ.
The clause «ارحمنا» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause اعف or لا تؤاخذ.
The clause «أنت مولانا» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive, giving a reason.
The clause «انصرنا ...» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive, caused by a cause «[Note: It is permissible for it to be conjoined to the clause (أنت مولانا), even though the two clauses differ as declarative and performative.]».

* Morphology:
(وسعها): with ḍamma on the wāw — and it may take fatḥa and kasra — the noun from وسع, or it is a maṣdar of it (ayah 233).
(إصرا): maṣdar of أصر يأصر, of the ضرب pattern; its wazn is فعل, with kasra then sukūn.
(الطاقة): maṣdar of طاق يطوق, and likewise الطوق; its wazn is فعلة with two fatḥas. It contains iʿlāl by substitution (qalb): the wāw was changed to an alif because it is voweled and the letter before it has a fatḥa.
(اعف): it contains iʿlāl by deletion because of the indeclinability; its wazn is افع, with ḍamma on the ʿayn.
(مولى): its wazn is مفعل, with fatḥa on the ʿayn. It is originally a mīmī maṣdar, used as a name for the one who disposes of matters of harm and benefit, or the master, or the helper, or the paternal cousin, so it came to have the status of a ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective). Its verb is ولي يلي, of the وثق pattern. It contains iʿlāl of the yāʾ, changing it to an alif because the letter before it has a fatḥa; its original form is مولي, with fatḥa on the lām.

* Rhetoric:
1- «لَها ما كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْها مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ», i.e. the good it has earned benefits it and the evil it has acquired harms it. As we notice, there is antithesis (ṭibāq) between لها and عليها, and between كسبت and اكتسبت: the first verb is specific to good and the second verb specific to evil.
2- A beautiful ending (ḥusn al-khitām): it is the right of Sūrat al-Baqara — having comprised numerous rulings and contained clear legislation — that its ending should treat of thanks to the Bestower of favour who has favoured man with intellect so that he may reflect; and it is the right of the one favoured to acknowledge, to the One who granted him the blessings, his duty to give thanks for them, and to bear witness to Him of might and power and of uniqueness in the Oneness that is manifest upon the hearts of the believers.

safi-cedvel:194-194.t:
* I'rab:
(الشهر) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (الحرام) naʿt (adjective) of الشهر, nominative like it; (بالشهر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), its implied form being مقابل (in exchange for); (الحرام) naʿt of الشهر, genitive like it; (الواو) conjunction; (الحرمات) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (قصاص) khabar, nominative; (الفاء) conjunction; (من) a jussivizing conditional noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (اعتدى) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (اعتدى), (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اعتدوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (عليه) like عليكم, attached to (اعتدوا), (بمثل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اعتدوا), (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle «[Note: Or a relative noun, with the referent omitted, its implied form being اعتدى عليكم به (with which he transgressed against you), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.]», (اعتدى) like the first; (عليكم) like the first, attached to (اعتدى).
The interpreted maṣdar formed from ما and the verb is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
(الواو) resumptive; (اتّقوا) like اعتدوا; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunction; (اعلموا) like اعتدوا; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الله) the noun of anna, accusative; (مع) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to an omitted khabar of anna; (المتّقين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar formed from (أنّ), its noun and its khabar fills the place of the two objects of اعلموا.
The clause «الشهر الحرام بالشهر..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «الحرمات قصاص» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «من اعتدى..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «اعتدى عليكم» is in the position of nominative as khabar of (من) «[Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]».
The clause «اعتدوا عليه» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «اعتدى عليكم» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative.
The clause «اتّقوا الله» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «اعلموا..» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause اتّقوا الله.

* Morphology:
(الحرمات), plural of حرمة, a noun for what must be respected.
It may also be a maṣdar (verbal noun) meaning awe and sanctity. Its pattern is فعلة, with ḍamma then sukūn, or with two ḍammas, or with ḍamma then fatḥa.
(القصاص), see verse (178) of this sūra.
(اعتدى), see verse (178) of this sūra.
(اعتدوا), see verse (192) of this sūra.

* Rhetoric:
The loose metonymy (al-majāz al-mursal): in His saying, Exalted is He, «فَمَنِ اعْتَدى عَلَيْكُمْ فَاعْتَدُوا عَلَيْهِ بِمِثْلِ مَا اعْتَدى عَلَيْكُمْ».
He expressed it with His saying فاعتدوا عليه (so transgress against him), while it is not in reality a transgression; it is only a punishment expressed with the word "transgression", because the transgression is the cause of the punishment. So the relation of this figure is causality (al-sababiyya).

* Benefits:
1- فَمَنِ اعْتَدى عَلَيْكُمْ فَاعْتَدُوا عَلَيْهِ بِمِثْلِ مَا اعْتَدى عَلَيْكُمْ..
a- In this verse the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and its apodosis occur as «two past verbs». The fact is that the protasis and its apodosis are either two imperfect verbs, or two past verbs, or two different verbs, one of them imperfect and the other past. In this verse they occur as two past verbs, each of them in the position of jussive.
b- The grammarians have an opinion, recorded in the chapter on the relative, to the effect that «من is for rational beings», and it may occur for others figuratively: if the relation of the figure is likening, it is a metaphor (istiʿāra), and if its relation is other than likening, it is a loose metonymy (majāz mursal), as in the poet's saying:
أسرب القطا هل من يعير جناحه ... لعليّ الى من قد هويت أطير
(O flock of sandgrouse, is there one who will lend his wing, that I might fly to the one I have come to love?)
Some grammarians have preferred to say that «من» is for the knowing (al-ʿālim) instead of the rational (al-ʿāqil).
When «من and ما» do not include the meaning of condition, they are not conditional; rather they are relative or interrogative.
c- The scholars of jurisprudence and ijtihād have persisted in explaining and clarifying the verses of jihad and the aim at which this ruling among the rulings of Islam is directed. They said: jihad is for the sake of the creed, to protect it from siege and to protect it from persecution (fitna), and to protect its method and its law in life, and to establish its banner on earth so that whoever intends to attack it is in awe of it, and so that everyone who desires it may take refuge in it, fearing no power and prevented by no persecution. This is the jihad that Islam commands and rewards, and it considers the one killed in its way a martyr ...
His saying, Exalted is He, defines it: وَقاتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ الَّذِينَ يُقاتِلُونَكُمْ وَلا تَعْتَدُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يُحِبُّ الْمُعْتَدِينَ ...
Here is some of what has been reported from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ defining the etiquette of jihad in the way of Allah.
The two Shaykhs (al-Bukhārī and Muslim) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the killing of women and children.
And from Ibn Masʿūd, may Allah be pleased with him: "The most restrained of people in killing are the people of faith", i.e. the believing fighters. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to counsel the raiders with his saying: «Raid in the name of Allah, in the way of Allah; fight those who disbelieve in Allah; raid, and do not act treacherously, do not mutilate, and do not kill a child ... !

safi-cedvel:195-195.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (أنفقوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (في سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أنفقوا), (الله) the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, jussivizing; (تلقوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بأيدي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تلقوا), since it is made to include the meaning of ترموا بأيديكم (throw with your hands) «[Note: According to Ibn Hishām the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and أيدي is genitive in form and accusative in position, as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb تلقوا.]», and the sign of the genitive is the implied (muqaddar) kasra, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إلى التهلكة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb تلقوا; (الواو) conjunction; (أحسنوا) like أنفقوا; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb); (يحبّ) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (المحسنين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «أنفقوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause اتّقوا الله in the previous verse.
The clause «لا تلقوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause أنفقوا.
The clause «أحسنوا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause أنفقوا, or resumptive.
The clause «إنّ الله يحبّ ...» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يحبّ المحسنين» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of inna.

* Morphology:
(تلقوا), it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion, in the same way as تدلوا in verse (188) of this sūra.
(أيدي), plural of يد, a primitive (jāmid) noun.. It has the deletion of the lām (third radical) of the word; its origin is يدو or يدي.. If it is يدو, then its plural is أيدو with kasra on the dāl; then the wāw was converted into a yāʾ because of the kasra before it, and it was said أيدي (see verse 79 of this sūra).
(التهلكة), a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb هلك يهلك, of the class of ضرب. التهلكة is one of the rare maṣdars and is not of those that follow the regular pattern.
(المحسنين), plural of المحسن, active participle from the quadriliteral أحسن, on the pattern of its imperfect, with the imperfect prefix replaced by a mīm with ḍamma and kasra on the letter before the last (see verse 112 of this sūra).

* Rhetoric:
«وَلا تُلْقُوا بِأَيْدِيكُمْ», i.e. and do not cast yourselves with your own hands. It was also said:
«بأيديكم» means "yourselves", by way of the loose metonymy (al-majāz al-mursal): He expressed it with "the hands", which are the part, and meant "the selves", which are the whole. So the relation is partiality (juzʾiyya).

* Benefits:
1- The exegetes have many sayings on the meaning of His saying, Exalted is He: «وَلا تُلْقُوا بِأَيْدِيكُمْ إِلَى التَّهْلُكَةِ».
I am pleased to present one of them to the readers:
Abū Ayyūb al-Anṣārī said: We know this verse best; it was revealed concerning us. We accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and supported him, witnessed the battles with him, and preferred him over our families, our wealth and our children. When the war laid down its burdens, we returned to our families, our children and our wealth to set them right and stay among them. So the destruction (al-tahluka) was staying among family and wealth and abandoning jihad. «This is how the text was reported».
I have cited this opinion and this report because of how far we have gone and plunged into absorption in the pursuit of material things, not investigating their source, nor their outcome, nor their origin, nor where they are spent — something that has turned us away from the means of glory and the seeking of lofty things, and has made every covetous one covet us. As a result, we have indeed cast ourselves with our own hands into destruction.

safi-cedvel:244-244.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) a conjunction; (قاتلوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (في سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قاتلوا), the attachment being figurative [Note: Or it is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of قاتلوا.]; (الله) the word of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (الواو) a conjunction; (اعلموا) like قاتلوا; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the word of Majesty, the noun of أنّ, accusative (manṣūb); (سميع) a khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ); (عليم) a second khabar, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar from (أنّ), its noun and its khabar stands in place of the two objects of اعلموا.

* Morphology:
(سميع): one of the intensive patterns — فعيل — and it is an adjective indicating constancy and permanence, so it is an adjective resembling the active participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) (see ayah 127 of this sūra).
(عليم): its ruling is like that of سميع in pattern and morphology (see ayah 29 of this sūra).
I'rab
The i'rab of the clauses of ayah 244:
The clause «قاتلوا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to an implied resumptive clause [Note: That is: do not flee from death as some of them fled, for that did not benefit them; rather stand firm and fight.. (the Ḥāshiya of al-Jamal on the Jalālayn). Or: so obey and fight.. Or: so do not beware of death as those before you were wary of it, and their wariness did not benefit them (al-ʿUkbarī).].
The clause «اعلموا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause قاتلوا.

safi-cedvel:245-245.t:
* I'rab:
(من) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) [Note: (منذا) may be parsed — as a single word — as an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is the relative — contrary to al-ʿUkbarī.]; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as a badal (substitute) of ذا or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); (يقرض) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو", referring to من or الذي; (الله) the word of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. the servants of Allah; (قرضا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative [Note: القرض may mean the money lent, in which case it is a mafʿūl bihi.]; (حسنا) a naʿt (adjective) of (قرضا), accusative like it; (الفاء) the fāʾ of causation; (يضاعف) an imperfect verb, subjunctive by a concealed (أن) after the fāʾ of causation, and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", i.e. Allah.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يضاعفه) is conjoined to a maṣdar formed from the content of the speech before it, i.e. is there a loan to Allah, and then a multiplying from Him for you?
(اللام) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يضاعف); (أضعافا) a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, of the hāʾ in يضاعفه [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, because it shares its derivation; Abū Ḥayyān permitted it to be a mafʿūl bihi if يضاعفه is made to include the meaning of يصيّره (makes it become).]; (كثيرة) a naʿt of أضعاف, accusative like it; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the word of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (يقبض) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; (الواو) a conjunction; (يبسط) like يقبض; (الواو) a conjunction; (إليه) like له, attached to (ترجعون), which is a passive imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The clause «من ذا الذي..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يقرض..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
The clause «يضاعفه» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the concealed particle relative (أن).
The clause «الله يقبض» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يقبض» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.
The clause «يبسط» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يقبض.
The clause «إليه ترجعون» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the second resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(قرضا): a noun of maṣdar (ism maṣdar); the verb is أقرض, whose maṣdar is إقراض.
القرض may also mean the money lent (al-muqraḍ, with fatḥa on the rāʾ).
(حسنا): a ṣifa mushabbaha (adjective resembling the participle); its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas, and it is taken from حسن يحسن (category كرم) (see ayah 201).
(أضعافا): plural of ضعف with kasra on the ḍād, which is the like of a thing in quantity, or its like plus an unlimited increase; or the plural of ضعف with kasra on the ḍād, which is a noun of maṣdar of the verb ضاعف, whose maṣdar is مضاعفة.
(كثيرة): feminine of كثير, which is a ṣifa mushabbaha, not [Translator's note: so in the source; لا here is apparently a slip for من, "from"] of the verb كثر يكثر (category كرم); its pattern is فعيل (see ayah 26).

* Rhetoric:
1- «مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ»: lending to Allah the Exalted is a figure for offering immediate deeds seeking a deferred reward. What is meant here is either jihad, which consists of giving one's life and wealth in the way of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, seeking His pleasure, or righteous deeds in general, which include it primarily. This is by way of explicit metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya): the thing likened, namely righteous deeds, has been omitted, and the thing it is likened to, namely what is lent of money and the like, has been kept.
2- In the ayah there is ṭibāq (antithesis) between يقبض and يبسط.

safi-cedvel:246-246.t:
* I'rab:
(ألم تر) its i'rab has passed [Note: In ayah (243).]; (إلى الملأ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تر); (من بني) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الملأ, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, for it is treated like the sound masculine plural; (إسرائيل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, for it is a diptote because it is a proper name and foreign; (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second ḥāl of الملأ [Note: This من is for the beginning of the extent, and the first من is partitive.]; (موسى) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (إذ) an adverb of past time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative, attached to an omitted ḥāl of الملأ, but with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. the story of the chiefs, or the account of the chiefs, at the time of their saying ... etc.; (قالوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (لنبيّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قالوا); (اللام) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of نبيّ; (ابعث) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت"; (لنا) like لهم, attached to an omitted ḥāl [Note: Or attached to the verb (ابعث), the lām being causal, i.e. for our sake.] of (ملكا), which is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (نقاتل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the request, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن"; (في سبيل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نقاتل) [Note: Or to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of نقاتل.]. (الله) the word of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The clause «ألم تر إلى الملأ» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «قالوا..» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «ابعث..» is in the position of accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «نقاتل..» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, not joined with the fāʾ. (قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو", i.e. the prophet; (هل) an interrogative particle; (عسيتم) an inflexible (jāmid), defective past verb.. and (تم) a pronoun in the position of nominative as the noun of عسى; (إن) a jussive-governing conditional particle; (كتب) a passive past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (على) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (كتب); (القتال) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (أن) a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive-governing particle; (لا) negating; (تقاتلوا) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, the sign of the subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا تقاتلوا) is in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of عسى.
(قالوا) like the first; (الواو) redundant (zāʾida), for linking [Note: Or a conjunction, conjoining the clause ما لنا.. to an implied clause that is the object of saying, i.e. they said: we will fight, and why should we not fight.]; (ما) an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (اللام) a preposition and (نا) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar; (ألّا) like the first; (نقاتل) an imperfect verb, subjunctive, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "نحن"; (في سبيل الله) like the first, its preposition attached to (نقاتل).
The interpreted maṣdar (ألّا نقاتل) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, its implied form being (في), attached to the omitted khabar, i.e.: what is there for us in abandoning fighting?
(الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (قد) a particle of realization; (أخرجنا) a passive past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and (نا) the nāʾib fāʿil; (من ديار) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أخرجنا), and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) a conjunction; (أبنائنا) muḍāf and muḍāf ilayhi, conjoined to ديارنا.
The clause «قال..» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «هل عسيتم..» is in the position of accusative as the object of saying.
The clause «إن كتب.. القتال» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical, and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "لا تقاتلوا" ...
The clause «لا تقاتلوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «قالوا..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «ما لنا ألّا نقاتل» is in the position of accusative as the object of saying.
The clause «لا نقاتل» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second particle relative (أن).
The clause «قد أخرجنا» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
(الفاء) resumptive; (لمّا) temporal (ḥīniyya), containing the sense of a condition, attached to (تولّوا); (كتب) like the first; (عليهم القتال) like عليكم القتال in i'rab and attachment; (تولّوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two sukūns. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (إلّا) a particle of exception; (قليلا) excepted by (إلّا), accusative, and (من) a preposition; (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt of (قليلا) [Note: (قليلا) is originally a naʿt of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. except a small number of them.. and the preposition and its genitive noun after it is a qualification.]; (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the word of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (عليم) a khabar, nominative; (بالظالمين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (عليم), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «كتب عليهم القتال» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «تولّوا» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «الله عليم..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(الملأ): a collective noun (ism jamʿ) with no singular from its own root-form, derived from the verb ملأ (to fill), because it is a notion indicating filling hearts with awe. Its plural is أملاء, like سبب and أسباب; its pattern is فعل with two fatḥas. al-Farrāʾ said: الملأ means the men throughout the Qur'an, and likewise القوم, الرهط and النفر.
(ملكا): a ṣifa mushabbaha (adjective resembling the participle) from the verb ملك يملك (category ضرب); its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then kasra.
(تولّوا): see ayah (177).
(قليلا): a ṣifa mushabbaha from the verb قلّ يقلّ (category ضرب); its pattern is فعيل (see ayah 41 of this sūra).

safi-cedvel:260-260.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (إذ) an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر" (remember); (قال) past verb; (إبراهيم) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ), barred from tanwīn because it is a proper name and foreign; (ربّ) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb), and the sign of its accusative is the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ, which was dropped for lightness, and it [the yāʾ] is muḍāf ilayhi; (أر) imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and (النون) for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "you"; (كيف) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); (تحيي) imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, implied as "you"; (الموتى) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and the sign of the accusative is the implied fatḥa on the alif; (قال) like the first, and the fāʿil is Allah; (الهمزة) for interrogation of affirmation (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī); (الواو) conjunction; (لم) a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and jussive; (تؤمن) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, implied as "you"; (قال) like the first; (بلى) an answer particle affirming [what follows] a negation; (الواو) conjunction; (لكن) a particle of rectification (istidrāk); (اللام) the lām of causation; (يطمئنّ) imperfect verb, subjunctive by an implied (أن) after the lām; (قلب) fāʿil, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the implied ḍamma on the bāʾ, for harmony with the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يطمئنّ قلبي) is in the position of a genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "أسأل" (I ask); and the rectification and the verb after it are conjoined to something implied, i.e.:
"Yes, I have believed, and I did not ask as a non-believer, but I asked so that my heart may be at rest."
(قال) like the first, and the fāʿil is Allah; (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (خذ) imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, implied as "you"; (أربعة) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (من الطير) tamyīz (specification) of the number «[Note: When the thing counted is a collective noun (ism jamʿ) — as in the verse — the tamyīz may be put in the genitive with من or in the genitive by annexation, as in His words تسعة رهط. The prepositional phrase may also be attached to (خذ), with the tamyīz omitted, i.e. "take from the birds four birds."]»; (الفاء) conjunction; (صر) like خذ, and (هنّ) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (إلى) preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (صرهنّ); (ثمّ) conjunction; (اجعل) like خذ; (على كلّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb اجعل by its being made to include (taḍmīn) the meaning of ألق (cast) «[Note: Or attached to an omitted second object, if the verb means صيّر (make into).]»; (جبل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (من) preposition and (هنّ) an attached pronoun in the position of a genitive, attached to (اجعل) «[Note: Or attached to a ḥāl of (جزءا).]»; (جزءا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (ثمّ ادع) like ثمّ اجعل, and (هنّ) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (يأتين) imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of a jussive as the answer to the command ... and (النون) is the fāʿil, and (الكاف) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (سعيا) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl «[Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, because it is synonymous with it.]»; (الواو) resumptive; (اعلم) like اجعل; (أنّ الله عزيز) like أنّ الله قدير — in the previous verse; (حكيم) second khabar (predicate), nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله عزيز) is in the position of an accusative, standing in place of the two objects of اعلم.
The clause «قال إبراهيم» is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «النداء وصلتها» (the vocative and its complement) is in the position of an accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «أرني» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative (resumptive).
The clause «تحيي..» is in the position of an accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of the verb أر «[Note: رأى of seeing with the eyes, on which the hamza of transitivity has entered.]».
The clause «قال ... (the second)» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أو لم تؤمن؟» is in the position of an accusative, conjoined to an implied clause which is the speech reported, i.e. "Do you ask, and have you not believed?"
The clause «قال.. (the third)» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The implied clause «بلى آمنت» is in the position of an accusative as the speech reported.
The clause «يطمئنّ قلبي» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the implied particle relative أن.
The clause «قال ... (the fourth)» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «خذ أربعة ...» is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "If you want that, then take.." and the implied conditional clause is in the position of an accusative as the speech reported.
The clause «صرهنّ» إليك is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause خذ أربعة.
The clause «اجعل» is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause صرهنّ.
The clause «ادعهنّ» is in the position of a jussive, conjoined to the clause اجعل.
The clause «اعلم» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(أرني): it contains a weak-letter change by deletion (iʿlāl bi-l-ḥadhf). Its origin is أرئيني; the yāʾ was dropped for the indeclinable [imperative] form, so it became أرئني; then the vowel of the hamza was transferred to the rāʾ and [the hamza] was dropped for lightness, so it became أرني. Its pattern is أفني, with the ʿayn of the word dropped, and its lām «[Translator's note: the source has the typo ولأمها for ولامها.]» — [that is,] the hamza and the yāʾ (see verse 128 of this sūra).
(الطير): a collective noun (ism jamʿ) like ركب; it is also said to be the plural of طائر.
(صرهنّ): imperative of صاره يصيره or يصوره, meaning he cut it or inclined it. It contains a weak-letter change by deletion, because it is hollow (ajwaf), so its ʿayn was dropped; its pattern is فلهنّ.
(سعيا): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar of the verb سعى يسعى, of the bāb فتح; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- In this verse there is concision by omission (ījāz bi-l-ḥadhf), since He, glory be to Him, related His commands and omitted the rest of the story, and did not deal «[Translator's note: the source reads يعترض, apparently for يتعرّض.]» with Ibrāhīm's (peace be upon him) compliance with them, because that is grasped self-evidently.

safi-cedvel:261-261.t:
* I'rab:
(مثل) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (الذين) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and it is on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "the likeness of the spending (نفقة) of those who.." or "the expending (إنفاق) of those who"; (ينفقون) imperfect verb, nominative, and the sign of the nominative is the retention of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (أموال) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (في سبيل) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb (ينفقون) «[Note: It may be attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of أموالهم.]»; (الله) the Divine Name, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الكاف) preposition; (مثل) a noun in the genitive by the kāf, and the prepositional phrase is attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ مثل; (حبة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (أنبت) past verb, and (التاء) the tāʾ of the feminine, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as "it" (feminine); (سبع) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (سنابل) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the fatḥa, since it is a diptote, being on the pattern of the ultimate plural (ṣīghat muntahā al-jumūʿ); (في كلّ) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (سنبلة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (مائة) postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (حبّة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الواو) conjunction; (الله) the Divine Name, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (يضاعف) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, implied as "He"; (اللام) preposition; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of a genitive, attached to (يضاعف); (يشاء) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "He", i.e. Allah; (الواو) conjunction; (الله) mubtadaʾ, nominative; (واسع) khabar, nominative; (عليم) second khabar.
The clause «مثل الذين..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ينفقون» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «أنبتت» is in the position of a genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of حبة.
The clause «في كلّ سنبلة مائة حبّة» is in the position of an accusative as a naʿt of سبع سنابل.
The clause «الله يضاعف..» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يضاعف..» is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله). The clause «يشاء» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «الله واسع» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the second resumptive clause.

* Morphology:
(سنابل): plural of سنبلة, on the pattern فنعلة, with ḍamma on the fāʾ and the ʿayn..
In al-Miṣbāḥ: "سنبل الزرع (the ears of the crop), the singular being سنبلة; and السبل, like it, the singular being سبلة, like قصب and قصبة. And سنبل الزرع means it put forth its ear, and أسبل, with the alif, means it put forth its ears (سبله)."
(حبّة): singular of الحبّ (grain), a non-derived (jāmid) noun; its pattern is فعلة, with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
1- «كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ»: their likeness is like that of one who sows a grain; were it not for that, the comparison would not be sound..
2- Attributing the growing to the grain is a figurative usage (majāz), because it is a cause of the growing — while the one who causes growth in reality is Allah the Exalted. This comparison is a depiction of the multiplying as though it were present before the eyes of the beholder, so it is a likening of the intelligible to the perceptible (tashbīh al-maʿqūl bi-l-maḥsūs).

safi-cedvel:219-219.t:
* I'rab:
(يسألونك عن الخمر) like يسألونك عن الشهر [Note: In ayah (217) of this sūra.]; (الميسر) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الخمر by the conjunction, genitive (majrūr) like it; (قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you); (في) preposition and (هما) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; (إثم) postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (كبير) naʿt (adjective) of إثم, nominative like it; (الواو) conjunction; (منافع) maʿṭūf to إثم, nominative like it; (للناس) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt of منافع; (الواو) parenthetical or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (إثم) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (هما) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أكبر) khabar, nominative; (من نفع) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أكبر, and (هما) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (يسألونك) its i'rab has already been given [Note: In ayah (217) of this sūra.]; (ماذا) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Note: This i'rab agrees with the reading with the accusative in the word (العفو) that comes next.. and there is another, less preferred way: that (ما) be an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, and (ذا) a relative noun, khabar; the interrogative nominal clause is explicative, and the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.], placed first; (ينفقون) imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (قل) like the first; (العفو) mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "spend". (الكاف) a preposition of comparison; (ذا) a demonstrative in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "an explaining like that", and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (يبيّن) imperfect verb, nominative; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (اللام) preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يبيّن); (الآيات) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the kasra; (لعلّ) a particle resembling the verb, for hope, and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of laʿalla; (تتفكرون) imperfect verb, nominative, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «يسألونك» عن الخمر has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «فيهما إثم» is in the position of accusative as the speech reported by the verb "say" (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «إثمهما أكبر» is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial), or it has no grammatical position, being parenthetical.
The clause «يسألونك (the second)» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the first clause يسألونك.
The clause «ينفقون» is the mafʿūl bihi of (يسألون), which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.
The clause «قل (the second)» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption.
The clause «(أنفقوا) العفو» is in the position of accusative as maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «يبيّن الله» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لعلّكم تتفكرون» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «تتفكّرون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of laʿalla.

* Morphology:
(الخمر): a noun for the intoxicating drink; it was so named because it "mingles with" (تخامر) the mind, i.e. mixes with it, or covers and conceals it, because خمر in the language means covering; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(الميسر): a mīm-maṣdar like الموعد; it is derived either from اليسر (ease), because in it wealth is taken with ease, or from اليسار (affluence), because it is a cause of it.
(منافع): plural of منفعة, a mīm-maṣdar from نفع; its wazn is مفعلة with fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn, the tāʾ being for intensification; the wazn of منافع is مفاعل.
(نفعهما): an aurally transmitted (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb نفع, of the pattern (bāb) فتح; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(العفو): a noun for what is surplus to need; its wazn is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Benefits:
Four ayahs were revealed about wine, all of them in Mecca [Translator's note: so in the source; of the ayahs usually cited on wine, only al-Naḥl 67 is Meccan, while this ayah and those in al-Nisāʾ and al-Māʾida are Medinan.]. Each ayah has its occasion. The Noble Qur'an followed the method of gradualness in prohibiting it, because of its hold on the souls of the people. People were giving up drinking it gradually, until Saʿd ibn Abī Waqqāṣ, at one of the banquets, recited poetry satirizing the Anṣār while he was drunk, and one of the Anṣār struck him with the jawbone — a bone — of a camel and wounded his head. Saʿd complained of him to the Messenger ﷺ, and this ayah was revealed prohibiting it decisively. [Translator's note: so in the source; this incident is usually linked to the decisive prohibition in al-Māʾida 90–91 rather than to this ayah.]

safi-cedvel:220-220.t:
* I'rab:
(في الدنيا) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تتفكرون) in the previous ayah, on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "you reflect on the matter of this world"; (الآخرة) maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الدنيا by the wāw, genitive (majrūr) like it; (الواو) conjunction; (يسألونك) its i'rab has already been given [Note: In ayah (215) of this sūra.]; (عن اليتامى) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يسألون), the sign of the genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (قل) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you); (إصلاح) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (اللام) preposition and (هم) an attached pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of إصلاح, or to إصلاح; (خير) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الواو) conjunction; (إن) a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive; (تخالطوا) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (هم) an attached pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إخوان) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هم" (they), and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. (الواو) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (يعلم) imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (He); (المفسد) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (من المصلح) preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of المفسد, i.e. "distinguished from the one who sets right" [Note: Or attached to (يعلم) by its implying the meaning of "distinguishes".]; (الواو) conjunction; (لو) a particle of impossibility due to impossibility, containing the meaning of condition; (شاء) past verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (اللام) connecting the apodosis; (أعنت) past verb, and (كم) an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "هو" (He); (إن) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of inna, accusative; (عزيز) the khabar of inna, nominative; (حكيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «يسألونك عن اليتامى» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause يسألونك عن الخمر in the previous ayah.
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «إصلاح لهم خير» is the mafʿūl bihi of (قل), in the position of accusative.
The clause «إن تخالطوهم» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause إصلاح..
The clause «(هم) إخوانكم» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined to the fāʾ.
The clause «الله يعلم..» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يعلم..» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الله).
The clause «لو شاء الله» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause الله يعلم.
The clause «أعنتكم» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «إنّ الله عزيز» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(إصلاح): the regular (qiyāsī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the quadriliteral verb أصلح; its wazn is إفعال with kasra on the hamza.
(إخوانكم): plural of أخ, a noun whose third radical (lām) has been dropped; its original is أخو, because its dual is أخوان; its wazn is فع.
(المفسد): active participle from the quadriliteral أفسد; its wazn is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(المصلح): active participle from the quadriliteral أصلح; its wazn is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:196-196.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (أتموا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (الحجّ) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (العمرة) conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الحج by the wāw, accusative like it; (لله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أتمّوا) (الفاء) conjunction; (إن) a jussivizing particle of condition; (أحصرتم) a past verb in the passive, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of jussive as protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (تم) a pronoun in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (ما) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being واجب عليكم (is incumbent upon you) «[Note: Or in the position of nominative as khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: الواجب ما استيسر (what is incumbent is whatever is easy).. It is also permissible for ما to be in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being اهدوا (offer) or أدّوا (render).]», (استيسر) a past verb, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "it" (هو); (من الهدي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of استيسر; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, jussivizing; (تحلقوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (رؤوس) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (حتّى) a particle of limit and a preposition; (يبلغ) an imperfect verb, accusative by an (أن) implied (muḍmara) after حتّى; (الهدي) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the overt ḍamma; (محلّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يبلغ ...) is in the position of genitive, attached to (تحلقوا).
The clause «أتمّوا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «أحصرتم» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause أتمّوا ...
The clause «(واجب عليكم) ما استيسر» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «استيسر» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما).
The clause «لا تحلقوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يبلغ الهدى ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle-relative أن.
(الفاء) conjunction; (من) a jussivizing conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (كان) a defective past verb in the position of jussive as protasis, and its noun is a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (من) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the noun of kāna; (مريضا) the khabar of kāna, accusative; (أو) a conjunction; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar; (أذى) a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif; (من رأس) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أذى, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis; (فدية) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and its khabar is omitted, its implied form being عليه فدية (upon him is a ransom); (من صيام) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of فدية; (أو) a conjunction; (صدقة) conjoined to صيام, genitive like it, and likewise (نسك).
The clause «من كان منكم مريضا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause لا تحلقوا..
The clause «كان منكم مريضا» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «[Note: It is permissible for the khabar to be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together.]». The clause «به أذى» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the khabar of kāna.
The clause «(عليه) فدية» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
(الفاء) conjunction; (إذا) an adverb of future time including the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to the apodosis, which is the meaning of settledness (al-istiqrār), i.e. فعليه ما استيسر (then upon him is whatever is easy), i.e. the offering is settled upon him; (أمنتم) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn..
and (تم) a pronoun, fāʿil; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of the condition إذا; (من) a jussivizing conditional noun «[Note: Abū al-Baqāʾ al-ʿUkbarī allows it to be taken as a relative noun, with the khabar being the clause ما استيسر من الهدي, the fāʾ being redundant.]» in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (تمتّع) a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive as protasis, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (بالعمرة) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تمتّع), (إلى الحجّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl of the fāʿil of تمتّع, i.e. he enjoyed, continuing in the enjoyment until the Hajj; (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of the condition من; (ما استيسر من الهدي) like the first in the same verse; (الفاء) conjunction; (من) like the first; (لم) a particle of negation «[Note: It is better for (لم) to be for negation only, so that the future sense remains, encompassing the condition, and the jussive is the effect of the conditional noun.]», (يجد) an imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he" (هو); (الفاء) connecting the apodosis of the condition من; (صيام) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being عليه صيام (upon him is a fast); (ثلاثة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (أيّام) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (في الحجّ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to صيام; (الواو) conjunction; (سبعة) conjoined to ثلاثة, genitive like it; (إذا) an adverb of future time, stripped of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to صيام; (رجعتم) a past verb and its fāʿil.
The clause «إذا أمنتم ...», consisting of the condition, its protasis and its apodosis, has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause من كان منكم مريضا..
The clause «أمنتم» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «من تمتّع..» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussivizing condition, namely إذا.
The clause «تمتّع بالعمرة» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «1».
The clause «(عليه) ما استيسر..» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of the condition (من), joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «من لم يجد» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the conditional clause فمن تمتّع, and the clause «لم يجد» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «2».
The clause «(عليه) صيام..» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «رجعتم» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
(تي) a demonstrative, indeclinable on the sukūn appearing on the yāʾ that is deleted because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (عشرة) khabar, nominative; (كاملة) naʿt of عشرة, nominative like it; (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, and the reference is to the ruling mentioned, and (اللام) for distance and (الكاف) for address; (اللام) a preposition; (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ذا; (لم) a particle of negation, inversion (to the past) and jussive; (يكن) a defective imperfect verb, jussive; (أهل) the noun of yakun, nominative, and (الهاء) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (حاضري) the khabar of yakun, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ, and the nūn was deleted because of the construct; (المسجد) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الحرام) naʿt of المسجد, genitive like it.
The clause «تلك عشرة كاملة» has no grammatical position, being parenthetical.
The clause «ذلك لمن لم يكن..» has no grammatical position, being an explicative resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لم يكن أهله..» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative «[Note: Or in the position of genitive as naʿt of (من), on the view that it is an indefinite noun qualified by an adjective.]».
(الواو) resumptive; (اتّقوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (اعلموا) like اتّقوا; (أنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of anna, accusative; (شديد) khabar, nominative; (العقاب) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar formed from (أنّ), its noun and its khabar fills the place of the two objects of اعلموا.
The clause «اتّقوا الله» has no grammatical position, being resumptive «[Note: It is permissible to conjoin it to the clause أتموا الحجّ at the opening of the verse.]».
The clause «اعلموا» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause اتّقوا الله.

* Morphology:
(العمرة), a maṣdar, or a noun for the acts of the lesser pilgrimage; its pattern is فعلة, with ḍamma on the fāʾ and sukūn on the ʿayn.
(الهدي), plural of هدية, on the measure of تمرة; a noun for the animal that the pilgrim or the one performing ʿumra drives as a gift to the people of the Sanctuary; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(رؤوس), plural of رأس, a primitive (jāmid) noun for what lies above the neck, at its top or front; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn. There are other plurals: أرؤس, روس and آراس. The pattern of رؤوس is فعول, with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(محلّه), a noun of place — or time — from حلّ يحلّ, of the class of ضرب, i.e. to come out of the state of iḥrām.
(أذى), a heard (samāʿī) maṣdar (verbal noun) of the verb أذي يأذى, of the class of فرح. It contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by qalb (conversion): the yāʾ was converted into an alif because it came after a fatḥa; its origin is أذي with a vowelled yāʾ at its end. Its alif is deleted in pronunciation because of the tanwīn, since it is a noun ending in alif maqṣūra (ism maqṣūr). Its pattern is فعل, with two fatḥas.
(صدقة), a noun for what is given seeking reward; its pattern is فعلة, with two fatḥas.
(نسك), a heard maṣdar of the verb نسك ينسك, of the class of نصر; its pattern is فعل, with two ḍammas. There are other maṣdars of the verb: نسك with ḍamma, fatḥa or kasra on the nūn and sukūn on the sīn; نسوك with ḍamma on the nūn; نسكة with fatḥa then sukūn; and منسك on the measure مفعل, with fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn.
(يجد), it contains iʿlāl by deletion: its fāʾ (first radical) was deleted, since it is a mithāl (initial-weak) verb with kasra on the ʿayn in the imperfect. Its pattern is يعل, with kasra on the ʿayn.
(ثلاثة), see verse (7) of Sūrat al-Wāqiʿa.
(سبعة), see verse (23) of Sūrat al-Kahf.
(عشرة), a numeral noun, and it is the first of the decades. The shīn in it is given fatḥa because the thing counted is masculine, namely the days. Its plural is عشرات.
(كاملة), feminine of كامل, active participle from كمل يكمل, of the class of نصر, the class of كرم and the class of فرح; its pattern is فاعل.
(أهل), a collective noun (ism jamʿ) that has no singular from its own letters; it is pluralised as أهلين, assimilated to the sound masculine plural. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn (see verse 105 of this sūra).
(حاضري), plural of حاضر, active participle from حضر يحضر, of the class of نصر; its pattern is فاعل.
(العقاب), a heard maṣdar of the quadriliteral verb عاقب; its pattern is فعال, with kasra on the fāʾ. As for its regular maṣdar, it is المعاقبة.

* Rhetoric:
1- «تلك عشرة كاملة»: the reference is to the three and the seven.
So that the number is known in total just as it was known in detail, and it is thus grasped from two angles and the knowledge is confirmed. Among their proverbs is (two knowledges are better than one), especially as most of the Arabs were not good at arithmetic.
